import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server'
import { isDemo, hasServiceRole, SITE_URL } from '@/lib/env'
import { tradeinServiceClient as serviceClient } from '@/features/tradein/server/client'
import { MAX_PHOTO_BYTES, PHOTO_BUCKET, parsePhotos, ticketSchema } from '@/features/tradein/domain'
import { tokenHash, tradeinError } from '@/features/tradein/server/submissions'
import { boundedFormData, imageMime } from '@/features/tradein/server/photo-validation'
export const runtime = 'nodejs'
export const maxDuration = 30
const json = (body: object, status = 200) => NextResponse.json(body, { status, headers: { 'Cache-Control': 'no-store' } })
export async function POST(request: Request) {
  const origin = request.headers.get('origin')
  if (origin && origin !== new URL(request.url).origin && origin !== new URL(SITE_URL).origin) return json({error:'Yêu cầu không hợp lệ.'},403)
  if (isDemo || !hasServiceRole) return json({error:'Tải ảnh hiện chưa khả dụng.'},503)
  const ticket = ticketSchema.safeParse({id:request.headers.get('x-tradein-id'),token:request.headers.get('x-tradein-token')})
  const rawSlot = request.headers.get('x-tradein-slot') ?? ''
  if (!ticket.success || !/^(?:[0-9]|1[0-3])$/.test(rawSlot)) return json({error:'Phiên tải ảnh không hợp lệ.'},400)
  try {
    const sb = serviceClient(); const hash = tokenHash(ticket.data.token)
    const {data:session,error} = await sb.from('tradein_upload_sessions').select('manifest,expires_at,completed_code').eq('id',ticket.data.id).eq('token_hash',hash).maybeSingle()
    if (error || !session || session.completed_code || Date.parse(session.expires_at) <= Date.now()) return json({error:'Phiên tải ảnh đã hết hạn. Vui lòng gửi lại.',code:'UPLOAD_EXPIRED'},410)
    const photo = parsePhotos(session.manifest).find(p => p.slot === Number(rawSlot))
    if (!photo) return json({error:'Ảnh vượt số lượng đã đăng ký.'},400)
    const form = await boundedFormData(request); const entries = [...form.entries()]; const file = form.get('file')
    if (entries.length !== 1 || !(file instanceof File) || file.size < 1 || file.size > MAX_PHOTO_BYTES || file.size !== photo.size) return json({error:'Mỗi lần chỉ gửi một ảnh, tối đa 2 MB.'},413)
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(await file.arrayBuffer()); const mime = imageMime(bytes)
    if (!mime || mime !== photo.mime || mime !== file.type || createHash('sha256').update(bytes).digest('hex') !== photo.sha256) return json({error:'Nội dung ảnh không khớp hoặc định dạng không được hỗ trợ.'},415)
    const bucket = sb.storage.from(PHOTO_BUCKET)
    const upload = await bucket.upload(photo.path,bytes,{contentType:mime,upsert:false,cacheControl:'3600'})
    if (upload.error) {
      const previous = await bucket.download(photo.path)
      if (!previous.data || createHash('sha256').update(new Uint8Array(await previous.data.arrayBuffer())).digest('hex') !== photo.sha256) return json({error:'Chưa tải được ảnh. Vui lòng thử lại.'},503)
    }
    const ready = await sb.rpc('mark_tradein_photo_ready',{p_session:ticket.data.id,p_token_hash:hash,p_slot:photo.slot})
    if (ready.error) return json({error:tradeinError(ready.error)},409)
    return json({ok:true,slot:photo.slot})
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof Error && error.message === 'PHOTO_TOO_LARGE') return json({error:'Ảnh vượt 2 MB.'},413)
    return json({error:'Chưa tải được ảnh. Ảnh đã chọn được giữ để bạn thử lại.'},503)
  }
}

File: src/app/api/webhooks/bank/route.ts

import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from 'next/server'
import { revalidateTag } from 'next/cache'
import { timingSafeEqual } from 'node:crypto'
import { hasServiceRole, isDemo } from '@/lib/env'
import { serviceClient } from '@/lib/supabase/admin'

/**
 * Webhook đối soát chuyển khoản (SePay, Casso hoặc dịch vụ tương tự).
 * Cấu hình dịch vụ gửi header: Authorization: Apikey <BANK_WEBHOOK_SECRET> (hoặc Bearer).
 * Body tối thiểu: { "content": "DP100123 NGUYEN VAN A", "transferAmount": 3380000, "id": "mã giao dịch", "transferType": "in" }
 */
function authorized(req: NextRequest) {
  const secret = process.env.BANK_WEBHOOK_SECRET
  if (!secret) return false
  const header = req.headers.get('authorization') ?? ''
  const token = header.replace(/^(Apikey|Bearer)\s+/i, '')
  const a = Buffer.from(token)
  const b = Buffer.from(secret)
  return a.length === b.length && timingSafeEqual(a, b)
}

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  if (isDemo || !hasServiceRole) return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: 'not_configured' }, { status: 503 })
  if (!authorized(req)) return NextResponse.json({ ok: false }, { status: 401 })

  const body = (await req.json().catch(() => null)) as Record<string, unknown> | null
  if (!body) return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: 'bad_json' }, { status: 400 })
  if (String(body.transferType ?? 'in').toLowerCase() !== 'in') return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, skipped: 'outgoing' })

  const content = String(body.content ?? body.description ?? '')
  const amount = Math.round(Number(body.transferAmount ?? body.amount ?? 0))
  const ref = String(body.id ?? body.referenceCode ?? body.tid ?? '')
  const code = content.toUpperCase().match(/DP\d{6,}/)?.[0]
  if (!code || !amount || !ref) return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, skipped: 'no_order_code' })

  const { data, error } = await serviceClient().rpc('mark_order_paid', { p_code: code, p_amount: amount, p_ref: ref })
  if (error) return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: 'db' }, { status: 500 })
  revalidateTag('admin-orders', 'max')
  return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, result: data, code })
}

================
File: src/app/api/webhooks/scrydex/route.ts
================
import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from 'next/server'
import { revalidateTag } from 'next/cache'
import { EXPANSION_ID, scrydexExpansionTag } from '@/features/card-library/server/scrydex'
import { verifyScrydexSignature } from '@/features/card-library/server/scrydex-signature'

export const runtime = 'nodejs'
export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'

/**
 * Scrydex webhook (https://scrydex.com/docs/getting-started/webhooks).
 * Header: X-Scrydex-Signature: t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256("<t>.<raw body>", SCRYDEX_WEBHOOK_SECRET)>
 * Events: pokemon.expansions.prices.raw_updated | prices.graded_updated | pop_reports.updated
 * Body: { "id": "evt_…", "name": "<event>", "data": { "expansion_ids": ["sv1", …] } }
 * The handler only expires cache tags, so repeated deliveries are harmless.
 */
const MAX_BODY = 64 * 1024
const EVENTS = new Set(['pokemon.expansions.prices.raw_updated', 'pokemon.expansions.prices.graded_updated', 'pokemon.expansions.pop_reports.updated'])

export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  const secret = process.env.SCRYDEX_WEBHOOK_SECRET?.trim()
  if (!secret) return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: 'not_configured' }, { status: 503 })
  const length = Number(request.headers.get('content-length') ?? 0)
  if (length > MAX_BODY) return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: 'too_large' }, { status: 413 })

  // Verify against the exact bytes Scrydex signed; never re-serialise the JSON first.
  const raw = await request.text()
  if (raw.length > MAX_BODY) return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: 'too_large' }, { status: 413 })
  if (!verifyScrydexSignature(raw, request.headers.get('x-scrydex-signature'), secret)) return NextResponse.json({ ok: false }, { status: 401 })

  let event: { id?: unknown; name?: unknown; data?: { expansion_ids?: unknown } }
  try { event = JSON.parse(raw) } catch { return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: 'bad_json' }, { status: 400 }) }
  const name = typeof event.name === 'string' ? event.name : ''
  if (!EVENTS.has(name)) return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, skipped: 'event_not_used' })

  const ids = (Array.isArray(event.data?.expansion_ids) ? event.data.expansion_ids : [])
    .filter((id): id is string => typeof id === 'string' && EXPANSION_ID.test(id)).slice(0, 500)
  // Expire immediately: the next visitor to an affected card gets fresh prices.
  for (const id of new Set(ids.map((value) => value.toLowerCase()))) revalidateTag(scrydexExpansionTag(id), { expire: 0 })
  return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, event: typeof event.id === 'string' ? event.id.slice(0, 80) : null, revalidated: ids.length })
}

import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from 'next/server'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server'

/** Google trả về đây kèm mã đăng nhập. Khu quản trị chỉ cho email đã được mời. */
export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const url = req.nextUrl
  const code = url.searchParams.get('code')
  const rawNext = url.searchParams.get('next') ?? '/tai-khoan'
  const next = rawNext.startsWith('/') && !rawNext.startsWith('//') ? rawNext : '/tai-khoan'
  const isAdmin = next.startsWith('/admin') || next.startsWith('/pos')
  const fail = new URL(isAdmin ? '/admin/dang-nhap?error=oauth' : '/dang-nhap?error=oauth', url.origin)
  if (!code) return NextResponse.redirect(fail)

  const sb = await createClient()
  const { error } = await sb.auth.exchangeCodeForSession(code)
  if (error) return NextResponse.redirect(fail)

  if (isAdmin) {
    const { data: role } = await sb.rpc('claim_staff')
    if (!role) {
      await sb.auth.signOut()
      return NextResponse.redirect(new URL('/admin/dang-nhap?error=not_invited', url.origin))
    }
  }
  return NextResponse.redirect(new URL(next, url.origin))
}

import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from 'next/server'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server'
import { isDemo } from '@/lib/env'

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  if (!isDemo) {
    const sb = await createClient()
    await sb.auth.signOut()
  }
  const to = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get('to') === 'admin' ? '/admin/dang-nhap' : '/'
  return NextResponse.redirect(new URL(to, req.nextUrl.origin), { status: 303 })
}

import type { Metadata, Viewport } from 'next'
import localFont from 'next/font/local'
import { Analytics } from '@vercel/analytics/next'
import { SpeedInsights } from '@vercel/speed-insights/next'
const inter=localFont({src:'../../node_modules/@fontsource-variable/inter/files/inter-latin-wght-normal.woff2',variable:'--font-inter',weight:'400 750',display:'swap',adjustFontFallback:false})
const interVi=localFont({src:'../../node_modules/@fontsource-variable/inter/files/inter-vietnamese-wght-normal.woff2',variable:'--font-inter-vi',weight:'400 750',display:'swap',adjustFontFallback:false})

File: src/app/sitemap.ts

import type { MetadataRoute } from 'next'
import { SITE_URL } from '@/lib/env'
import { getCatalogMeta, getFeaturedSlugs } from '@/lib/catalog'

export const revalidate = 3600

export default async function sitemap(): Promise<MetadataRoute.Sitemap> {
  const [meta, slugs] = await Promise.all([getCatalogMeta(), getFeaturedSlugs(5000)])
  return [
    { url: SITE_URL, changeFrequency: 'daily', priority: 1 },
    { url: `${SITE_URL}/san-pham`, changeFrequency: 'daily', priority: 0.9 },
    { url: `${SITE_URL}/pre-order`, changeFrequency: 'daily', priority: 0.8 },
    { url: `${SITE_URL}/thu-mua`, changeFrequency: 'monthly', priority: 0.5 },
    ...meta.categories.filter((c) => c.visible).map((c) => ({ url: `${SITE_URL}/danh-muc/${c.slug}`, changeFrequency: 'daily' as const, priority: 0.8 })),
    ...slugs.map((s) => ({ url: `${SITE_URL}/san-pham/${s}`, changeFrequency: 'weekly' as const, priority: 0.7 }))
  ]
}

File: src/components/admin/action-button.tsx

'use client'
import { useState, useTransition } from 'react'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { AlertTriangle, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react'
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogDescription, DialogTitle } from '@/components/ui/dialog'
import type { ActionResult } from '@/lib/types'
interface Props { action: () => Promise<ActionResult<unknown>>; children: React.ReactNode; className?: string; confirm?: { title: string; text: string; confirmLabel: string; danger?: boolean }; ariaLabel?: string; onDone?: () => void }
export function ActionButton({ action, children, className = 'btn btn-secondary', confirm, ariaLabel, onDone }: Props) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const [open,setOpen] = useState(false)
  const [pending,start] = useTransition()
  const [msg,setMsg] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const run = () => start(async () => {
    setMsg(null)
    try { const r = await action(); if (!r.ok) { setMsg(r.error); return }; setOpen(false); onDone?.(); router.refresh() }
    catch { setMsg('Chưa kết nối được máy chủ. Kiểm tra mạng rồi thử lại.') }
  })
  return <><button type="button" className={className} disabled={pending} aria-busy={pending} aria-label={ariaLabel} onClick={() => confirm ? (setMsg(null), setOpen(true)) : run()}>{pending ? <Loader2 size={16} className="animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" /> : null}{children}</button>{msg && !confirm ? <span role="alert" className="text-sm text-bad">{msg}</span> : null}{confirm ? <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={(v) => { if (!pending) setOpen(v) }}><DialogContent><span className={`mb-4 flex size-11 items-center justify-center rounded-xl ${confirm.danger ? 'bg-bad-bg text-bad' : 'bg-brand-subtle text-brand'}`}><AlertTriangle size={22} aria-hidden="true" /></span><DialogTitle className="pr-5 text-lg font-semibold">{confirm.title}</DialogTitle><DialogDescription className="mt-3 text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted">{confirm.text}</DialogDescription>{msg ? <p role="alert" className="mt-4 rounded-lg bg-bad-bg p-3 text-sm text-bad">{msg}</p> : null}<div className="mt-6 flex flex-wrap justify-end gap-2"><button type="button" className="btn btn-secondary" disabled={pending} onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>Quay lại</button><button type="button" className={`btn ${confirm.danger ? 'btn-danger' : 'btn-primary'}`} disabled={pending} onClick={run}>{pending ? <Loader2 size={16} className="animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" /> : null}{confirm.confirmLabel}</button></div></DialogContent></Dialog> : null}</>
}

export function AdminTabs({ badges }: { badges: Record<string, number> }) {
  const path = usePathname()
  const tabs = [

  ]
  return <nav className="admin-bottomnav" aria-label="Quản trị nhanh">{tabs.map((t) => <Link key={t.href} href={t.href} prefetch={false} aria-current={(t.href === '/admin/them' ? !tabs.slice(0,4).some((x) => isOn(path,x.href)) : isOn(path,t.href)) ? 'page' : undefined}><t.icon size={21} strokeWidth={1.7} aria-hidden="true" /><span>{t.label}</span>{badges[t.href] ? <span className="admin-mobile-badge">{badges[t.href]! > 99 ? '99+' : badges[t.href]}</span> : null}</Link>)}</nav>
}

'use client'
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { Camera, CameraOff } from 'lucide-react'
interface Detector { detect(source:HTMLVideoElement):Promise<{rawValue:string}[]> }
interface DetectorConstructor { new(options:{formats:string[]}):Detector; getSupportedFormats():Promise<string[]> }
export default function BarcodeScanner({onScan}:{onScan:(value:string)=>void}) {
  const video=useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null)
  const callback=useRef(onScan); callback.current=onScan
  const [message,setMessage]=useState('Đang mở camera…')
  const [failed,setFailed]=useState(false)
  useEffect(()=>{
    let cancelled=false;let stream:MediaStream|undefined;let frame=0;let working=false
    const stop=()=>{cancelled=true;cancelAnimationFrame(frame);stream?.getTracks().forEach((t)=>t.stop())}
    async function start() {
      try {
        const Constructor=(window as unknown as {BarcodeDetector?:DetectorConstructor}).BarcodeDetector
        if(!Constructor || !navigator.mediaDevices?.getUserMedia)throw new Error('Trình duyệt này chưa hỗ trợ quét camera. Hãy nhập SKU vào ô tìm kiếm hoặc dùng máy quét mã vạch.')
        const formats=(await Constructor.getSupportedFormats()).filter((f)=>['ean_13','ean_8','code_128','code_39','upc_a','upc_e','qr_code'].includes(f))
        if(!formats.length)throw new Error('Camera chưa hỗ trợ loại mã cần dùng. Bạn có thể nhập SKU hoặc dùng máy quét.')
        const detector=new Constructor({formats})
        stream=await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({video:{facingMode:{ideal:'environment'}},audio:false})
        if(cancelled){stream.getTracks().forEach(t=>t.stop());return}
        if(!video.current)return
        video.current.srcObject=stream;await video.current.play();setMessage('Đưa mã vạch vào giữa khung hình.')
        const scan=async()=>{
          if(cancelled)return
          if(!working && video.current && video.current.readyState>=2){working=true;try {const found=await detector.detect(video.current);if(!cancelled && found[0]?.rawValue){const value=found[0].rawValue.slice(0,60);stop();callback.current(value);return}}catch{/* Retry next frame; video can briefly be unreadable. */}finally{working=false}}
          if(!cancelled)frame=requestAnimationFrame(scan)
        }
        frame=requestAnimationFrame(scan)
      } catch(e){if(!cancelled){setFailed(true);setMessage(e instanceof Error && e.name==='NotAllowedError'?'Bạn chưa cho phép camera. Bật quyền camera của trình duyệt hoặc nhập SKU bằng tay.':e instanceof Error?e.message:'Chưa mở được camera. Hãy nhập SKU bằng tay.')}}
    }
    void start();return stop
  },[])
  return <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">{failed?<CameraOff size={32} className="text-muted" aria-hidden="true"/>:<><video ref={video} className="aspect-[4/3] w-full rounded-xl bg-ink object-cover" muted playsInline/><span className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-muted"><Camera size={16} aria-hidden="true"/>Chỉ đọc mã trên thiết bị, không tải video lên.</span></>}<p role="status" className="text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted">{message}</p></div>
}

'use client'
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { WifiOff } from 'lucide-react'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/browser'

/** A single table subscription per mounted admin shell; no customer-side channel. */
export function AdminConnection({ demo, table = 'orders' }: { demo: boolean; table?: 'orders' | 'variants' }) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const [online, setOnline] = useState(true)
  const [changed, setChanged] = useState(false)
  useEffect(() => {
    const update = () => setOnline(navigator.onLine)
    update()
    window.addEventListener('online', update); window.addEventListener('offline', update)
    if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production' && 'serviceWorker' in navigator && (location.protocol === 'https:' || location.hostname === 'localhost')) navigator.serviceWorker.register('/admin-sw.js', { scope: '/' }).catch(() => {})
    return () => { window.removeEventListener('online', update); window.removeEventListener('offline', update) }
  }, [])
  useEffect(() => {
    if (demo || !online) return
    const sb = createClient()
    const ch = sb.channel(`admin-${table}`).on('postgres_changes', { event: '*', schema: 'public', table }, () => setChanged(true)).subscribe()
    return () => { void sb.removeChannel(ch) }
  }, [demo, online, table])
  if (!online) return <div role="status" className="admin-offline flex items-center gap-2"><WifiOff size={17} className="shrink-0" aria-hidden="true" />Mất kết nối. Giữ cửa sổ này mở; kết nối lại trước khi lưu hoặc thanh toán.</div>
  return changed ? <div role="status" className="admin-demo justify-between"><span>Có dữ liệu mới. Tải lại khi bạn đã hoàn tất thao tác.</span><button type="button" className="btn btn-secondary btn-sm" onClick={() => { router.refresh(); setChanged(false) }}>Cập nhật</button></div> : null
}

'use client'
import { useActionState, useState } from 'react'
import { Eye, EyeOff, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react'
import { adminLogin } from '@/lib/actions/auth'

export function AdminLoginForm({ next }: { next: string }) {
  const [state, action, pending] = useActionState(adminLogin, null)
  const [show, setShow] = useState(false)
  return (
    <form action={action} className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <input type="hidden" name="next" value={next} />
      <label className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
        <span className="label">Email</span>
        <input name="email" type="email" required autoComplete="username" className="input" placeholder="ten@darkpoke.vn" autoCapitalize="none" spellCheck={false} />
      </label>
      <label className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
        <span className="label">Mật khẩu</span>
        <span className="input gap-2 px-0 pl-3">
          <input name="password" type={show ? 'text' : 'password'} required minLength={6} placeholder="Nhập mật khẩu" autoComplete="current-password" className="min-w-0 flex-1 bg-transparent outline-none" />
          <button type="button" className="btn btn-ghost btn-icon min-h-10" aria-label={show ? 'Ẩn mật khẩu' : 'Hiện mật khẩu'} onClick={() => setShow((s) => !s)}>
            {show ? <EyeOff size={18} aria-hidden="true" /> : <Eye size={18} aria-hidden="true" />}
          </button>
        </span>
      </label>
      {state?.error ? <p role="alert" className="text-sm text-bad">{state.error}</p> : null}
      <button type="submit" className="btn btn-primary btn-lg" disabled={pending}>
        {pending ? <Loader2 size={18} className="animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" /> : null}Đăng nhập
      </button>
      <p className="text-center text-xs text-muted">Quên mật khẩu? Nhờ chủ shop gửi lại email mời ở mục Nhân viên.</p>
    </form>
  )
}

  const [receipt, setReceipt] = useState<{ code: string; lines: Line[]; total: number; discount: number; pay: Pay; at: string; change: number } | null>(null)
  const [showCart, setShowCart] = useState(false)
  const input = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null)

  useEffect(()=>{
    const update=()=>setOnline(navigator.onLine);update();window.addEventListener('online',update);window.addEventListener('offline',update)
    if(window.matchMedia('(min-width:1024px)').matches)input.current?.focus()
    return()=>{window.removeEventListener('online',update);window.removeEventListener('offline',update)}
  },[])
  useEffect(()=>{
    if(isDemo)return
    const sb=createClient()
    const channel=sb.channel('pos-visible-stock').on('postgres_changes',{event:'UPDATE',schema:'public',table:'variants'},(payload)=>{
      const row=payload.new as {id?:string;stock?:number}
      if(row.id && typeof row.stock==='number')setLines((s)=>s.map((l)=>l.variant_id===row.id?{...l,stock:row.stock!}:l))
      setInventoryTick((n)=>n+1)
    }).subscribe()
    return()=>{void sb.removeChannel(channel)}
  },[])
  useEffect(() => {
    const term=q.trim();let cancelled=false
    if(term.length<2)return
    const timer=setTimeout(()=>startSearch(async()=>{
      try { const result=await posSearch(term);if(!cancelled){setHits(result);setLoadedQuery(term);setSearchError(null)} }
      catch {if(!cancelled)setSearchError('Chưa tìm được sản phẩm. Kiểm tra mạng rồi thử lại.')}
    }),220)
    return()=>{cancelled=true;clearTimeout(timer)}
  },[q,inventoryTick])
  const hits=q.trim().length>=2 && loadedQuery===q.trim() ? rawHits : []
  const subtotal = lines.reduce((s, l) => s + l.price * l.qty, 0)
  const disc = Math.min(Number(discount) || 0, subtotal)
  const total = subtotal - disc
  const overLimit = (role === 'cashier' || role === 'staff') && disc > (subtotal * maxDiscountPct) / 100
  const change = pay === 'cash' && given ? Number(given) - total : 0

  function add(h: Hit) {
    setLines((s) => {
      const f = s.find((l) => l.variant_id === h.variant_id)
      if (f) return s.map((l) => (l.variant_id === h.variant_id ? { ...l, qty: Math.min(l.qty + 1, Math.max(l.stock, 1)) } : l))
      return [...s, { ...h, qty: 1 }]
    })
    setQ('')
    input.current?.focus()
  }

  function checkout() {
    if(!online || !lines.length || pending || overLimit)return
    setError(null)
    start(async () => {
      try {
      const r = await posCheckout({ items: lines.map((l) => ({ variant_id: l.variant_id, qty: l.qty })), payment: pay, discount: disc, customer })
      if (!r.ok) { setError(r.error); return }
      setReceipt({ code: r.data?.code ?? '', lines, total, discount: disc, pay, at: new Date().toISOString(), change })
      setLines([]); setDiscount(''); setGiven(''); setCustomer({ name: '', phone: '' }); setShowCart(false)
      } catch {setError('Chưa nhận được xác nhận từ máy chủ. Tra đơn hàng và kiểm tra thanh toán trước khi thử lại.')}
    })
  }

  if (receipt) {
    return (
      <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-md flex-col gap-4 p-4 py-8">
        <div className="card flex flex-col gap-3 p-5 font-mono text-sm" id="receipt">
          <p className="text-center font-sans text-lg font-bold">{shopName}</p>
          <p className="text-center">{isDemo ? 'ĐƠN MẪU · chưa lưu dữ liệu' : 'Hóa đơn'} {receipt.code}<br />{formatDateTime(receipt.at)} · {cashier}</p>
          <hr className="border-dashed border-ctl" />
          {receipt.lines.map((l) => (
            <div key={l.variant_id} className="flex justify-between gap-3"><span>{l.name}{l.title !== 'Mặc định' ? ` (${l.title})` : ''} × {l.qty}</span><span>{formatVND(l.price * l.qty)}</span></div>
          ))}
          <hr className="border-dashed border-ctl" />
          {receipt.discount ? <div className="flex justify-between"><span>Giảm giá</span><span>-{formatVND(receipt.discount)}</span></div> : null}
          <div className="flex justify-between text-base font-bold"><span>Tổng</span><span>{formatVND(receipt.total)}</span></div>
          <div className="flex justify-between"><span>Thanh toán</span><span>{receipt.pay === 'cash' ? 'Tiền mặt' : receipt.pay === 'card' ? 'Thẻ' : 'Chuyển khoản'}</span></div>
          {receipt.change > 0 ? <div className="flex justify-between"><span>Tiền thối</span><span>{formatVND(receipt.change)}</span></div> : null}
          <p className="text-center">Cảm ơn bạn. Hunt - Trade - Collect</p>
        </div>
        <div className="no-print flex gap-2">
          <button type="button" className="btn btn-secondary flex-1" onClick={() => window.print()}><Printer size={18} aria-hidden="true" />In hóa đơn</button>
          <button type="button" className="btn btn-primary flex-1" onClick={() => setReceipt(null)}>Đơn mới</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    )
  }

  const qrUrl = pay === 'bank_transfer' && total > 0 && !isPlaceholder(bank.account_no)
    ? `https://img.vietqr.io/image/${bank.bank_bin}-${bank.account_no}-compact2.png?amount=${total}&addInfo=${encodeURIComponent('POS ' + shopName)}&accountName=${encodeURIComponent(bank.account_name)}`
    : null

  const cart = (
    <div className="flex h-full flex-col gap-4">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between"><h2 className="font-display text-lg font-bold">Đơn tại quầy</h2>{lines.length ? <button type="button" className="btn btn-ghost btn-sm text-bad" onClick={() => setLines([])}>Xóa hết</button> : null}</div>
      {lines.some(l=>l.qty>l.stock)?<p role="alert" className="rounded-xl bg-warn-bg p-3 text-xs text-warn">Tồn kho vừa thay đổi. Giảm số lượng trong đơn trước khi thanh toán.</p>:null}
      {lines.length === 0 ? <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-3 rounded-xl bg-surface px-4 py-8 text-center"><ShoppingBag size={28} strokeWidth={1.5} className="text-muted" aria-hidden="true"/><p className="text-sm font-semibold">Đơn hàng đang trống</p><p className="text-xs text-muted">Quét mã hoặc tìm sản phẩm để bắt đầu.</p></div> : (
        <ul className="flex flex-col divide-y divide-line">
          {lines.map((l) => (
            <li key={l.variant_id} className="flex items-center gap-2 py-2">
              <span className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col"><b className="line-clamp-1 text-sm">{l.name}</b><span className="text-xs text-muted">{l.title !== 'Mặc định' ? `${l.title} · ` : ''}{formatVND(l.price)}</span></span>
              <button type="button" className="btn btn-ghost btn-icon min-h-10 w-10" aria-label="Giảm" onClick={() => setLines((s) => s.map((x) => (x.variant_id === l.variant_id ? { ...x, qty: Math.max(1, x.qty - 1) } : x)))}><Minus size={16} aria-hidden="true" /></button>
              <span className="w-6 text-center font-bold tabular-nums">{l.qty}</span>
              <button type="button" className="btn btn-ghost btn-icon min-h-10 w-10" aria-label="Tăng" disabled={l.qty >= l.stock} onClick={() => setLines((s) => s.map((x) => (x.variant_id === l.variant_id ? { ...x, qty: x.qty + 1 } : x)))}><Plus size={16} aria-hidden="true" /></button>
              <button type="button" className="btn btn-ghost btn-icon min-h-10 w-10 text-muted" aria-label={`Bỏ ${l.name}`} onClick={() => setLines((s) => s.filter((x) => x.variant_id !== l.variant_id))}><Trash2 size={16} aria-hidden="true" /></button>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
      <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
        <label className="flex flex-col gap-1"><span className="label">Khách (không bắt buộc)</span><input className="input" value={customer.name} onChange={(e) => setCustomer({ ...customer, name: e.target.value })} placeholder="Tên" /></label>
        <label className="flex flex-col gap-1"><span className="label">Số điện thoại</span><input className="input" inputMode="tel" value={customer.phone} onChange={(e) => setCustomer({ ...customer, phone: e.target.value })} /></label>
      </div>
      <label className="flex flex-col gap-1"><span className="label">Giảm giá (₫)</span>
        <input className="input" inputMode="numeric" value={discount} onChange={(e) => setDiscount(e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, ''))} placeholder="0" />
        {overLimit ? <span className="text-sm text-warn">Vượt {maxDiscountPct}%: cần tài khoản quản lý thực hiện.</span> : null}
      </label>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2" aria-label="Hình thức thanh toán">
        {([['cash', 'Tiền mặt', Banknote], ['bank_transfer', 'Chuyển khoản', Landmark], ['card', 'Thẻ', CreditCard]] as const).map(([k, l, Icon]) => (
          <button key={k} type="button" aria-pressed={pay === k} onClick={() => setPay(k)} className={`flex min-h-16 flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1 rounded-xl border text-sm font-semibold ${pay === k ? 'border-ink bg-ink text-white' : 'border-line bg-raised'}`}>
            <Icon size={20} aria-hidden="true" />{l}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
      {pay === 'cash' ? (
        <label className="flex flex-col gap-1"><span className="label">Khách đưa</span>
          <input className="input" inputMode="numeric" value={given} onChange={(e) => setGiven(e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, ''))} />
          <span className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 pt-1">{[total, Math.ceil(total / 100000) * 100000, Math.ceil(total / 500000) * 500000].filter((x, i, a) => x > 0 && a.indexOf(x) === i).map((x) => <button key={x} type="button" className="chip" onClick={() => setGiven(String(x))}>{formatVND(x)}</button>)}</span>
          {given ? <span className={`text-sm font-semibold ${change < 0 ? 'text-bad' : 'text-ok'}`}>{change < 0 ? `Còn thiếu ${formatVND(-change)}` : `Tiền thối ${formatVND(change)}`}</span> : null}
        </label>
      ) : null}
      {qrUrl ? (
        // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
        <img src={qrUrl} alt={`VietQR ${formatVND(total)}`} width={180} height={180} className="size-44 self-center" />
      ) : null}
      <div className="mt-auto flex flex-col gap-2 border-t border-line pt-3">
        <div className="flex justify-between text-sm"><span className="text-muted">Tạm tính</span><span className="tabular-nums">{formatVND(subtotal)}</span></div>
        <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between"><span className="font-semibold">Khách cần trả</span><span className="font-sans text-2xl font-bold tabular-nums">{formatVND(total)}</span></div>
        {error ? <p role="alert" className="rounded-lg bg-bad-bg p-2.5 text-sm text-bad">{error}</p> : null}
        <button type="button" className="btn btn-primary btn-lg" disabled={!online || overLimit || lines.some(l=>l.qty>l.stock) || !lines.length || pending || (pay === 'cash' && !!given && change < 0)} onClick={checkout}>
          {pending ? <Loader2 size={18} className="animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" /> : null}{isDemo ? 'Hoàn tất đơn mẫu' : 'Thu tiền và hoàn tất'}
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  )

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-dvh flex-col">
      <AdminConnection demo={isDemo} />
      <header className="flex min-h-16 items-center gap-3 border-b border-line bg-raised px-4 text-ink">
        <Link href="/admin" className="btn btn-ghost btn-icon" aria-label="Về trang quản trị"><ArrowLeft size={20} aria-hidden="true" /></Link>
        <b>Bán tại quầy</b>{isDemo ? <span className="pill pill-brand">Demo</span> : null}
        <span className="ml-auto text-xs text-muted">{cashier}</span>
      </header>
      <div className="grid flex-1 lg:grid-cols-[1fr_420px]">
        <section className="flex flex-col gap-4 p-4">
          <label className="input gap-2 bg-raised">
            <ScanLine size={20} className="flex-none text-muted" aria-hidden="true" />
            <input ref={input} value={q} onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)} placeholder="Quét mã vạch hoặc gõ tên, SKU" aria-label="Tìm sản phẩm" className="min-w-0 flex-1 bg-transparent outline-none"
              onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter' && hits[0]) { e.preventDefault(); add(hits[0]) } }} />
            {searching ? <Loader2 size={18} className="animate-spin text-muted" aria-hidden="true" /> : <Search size={18} className="text-muted" aria-hidden="true" />}
          </label>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3"><p className="text-xs text-muted">Tìm theo tên, SKU hoặc máy quét mã vạch.</p><button type="button" className="btn btn-secondary btn-sm" onClick={()=>setScanner(true)}><Camera size={17} aria-hidden="true"/>Quét camera</button></div>
          {searchError ? <p role="alert" className="rounded-xl bg-bad-bg p-3 text-sm text-bad">{searchError}</p> : null}
          {hits.length ? (
            <ul className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4">
              {hits.map((h) => (
                <li key={h.variant_id}>
                  <button type="button" onClick={() => add(h)} disabled={h.stock <= 0} className="card flex w-full flex-col overflow-hidden text-left hover:border-ink disabled:opacity-50">
                    <ProductImage src={h.image} alt="" sizes="200px" />
                    <span className="flex flex-col gap-0.5 p-2.5"><b className="line-clamp-2 text-sm">{h.name}</b><span className="text-xs text-muted">{h.title !== 'Mặc định' ? `${h.title} · ` : ''}{h.sku}</span><span className="flex justify-between text-sm"><b className="tabular-nums">{formatVND(h.price)}</b><span className={h.stock > 0 ? 'text-muted' : 'text-bad'}>Tồn {h.stock}</span></span></span>
                  </button>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          ) : <p className="text-sm text-muted">{q.trim().length >= 2 && !searching ? 'Không tìm thấy sản phẩm.' : 'Nhập ít nhất 2 ký tự để tìm. Bạn có thể quét mã bằng camera hoặc máy quét gắn ngoài.'}</p>}
        </section>
        <aside className="hidden border-l border-line bg-raised p-4 lg:block">{cart}</aside>
      </div>
      <div className="sticky bottom-0 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 border-t border-line bg-raised p-3 pb-[max(12px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom))] lg:hidden">
        <span className="flex flex-col"><span className="text-xs text-muted">{lines.reduce((s, l) => s + l.qty, 0)} món</span><b className="tabular-nums">{formatVND(total)}</b></span>
        <button type="button" className="btn btn-primary ml-auto" onClick={() => setShowCart(true)}>Xem đơn và thu tiền</button>
      </div>
      <Dialog open={showCart} onOpenChange={setShowCart}><DialogContent className="pos-cart-dialog"><DialogTitle className="mb-6 pr-10 text-lg font-semibold">Giỏ hàng & thanh toán</DialogTitle><DialogDescription className="sr-only">Kiểm tra sản phẩm và xác nhận thanh toán tại quầy</DialogDescription>{cart}</DialogContent></Dialog>
      <Dialog open={scanner} onOpenChange={setScanner}><DialogContent><DialogTitle className="mb-4 pr-8 text-lg font-semibold">Quét mã sản phẩm</DialogTitle><DialogDescription className="sr-only">Cho phép camera để đọc mã vạch, hoặc nhập mã bằng tay trong ô tìm kiếm.</DialogDescription>{scanner?<BarcodeScanner onScan={(value)=>{setQ(value);setScanner(false)}}/>:null}</DialogContent></Dialog>
    </div>
  )
}

'use client'
import Link from 'next/link'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { useMemo, useRef, useState, useTransition } from 'react'
import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form'
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod'
import { productSchema } from '@/lib/schemas/product'
import { ArrowDown, ArrowUp, ImagePlus, Loader2, Plus, Trash2, X } from 'lucide-react'
import { ActionButton } from '@/components/admin/action-button'
import { ProductImage } from '@/components/shop/product-image'
import { deleteProduct, saveProduct, type ProductInput } from '@/lib/actions/admin'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/browser'
import { slugify } from '@/lib/utils'
import type { CatalogMeta } from '@/lib/catalog'
import type { ProductDetail, ProductStatus } from '@/lib/types'

type VariantRow = { id?: string; sku: string; title: string; option_values: string[]; price: string; stock: string; active: boolean }
type Opt = { name: string; values: string[]; draft: string }

const num = (s: string) => (s.trim() === '' ? null : Number(s.replace(/\D/g, '')))
const str = (n: number | null | undefined) => (n === null || n === undefined ? '' : String(n))

function cartesian(opts: { values: string[] }[]): string[][] {
  return opts.reduce<string[][]>((acc, o) => acc.flatMap((a) => o.values.map((v) => [...a, v])).slice(0,101), [[]])
}

export function ProductForm({ meta, product, defaultTypeCode, canUpload, readOnly = false }: { meta: CatalogMeta; product: ProductDetail | null; defaultTypeCode?: string; canUpload: boolean; readOnly?: boolean }) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const [pending, start] = useTransition()
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const fileRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null)
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false)

  const initialType = product?.type_id ?? meta.types.find((t) => t.code === defaultTypeCode)?.id ?? meta.types[0]?.id ?? ''
  const [typeId, setTypeId] = useState(initialType)
  const type = meta.types.find((t) => t.id === typeId)
  const attrDefs = meta.attributes.filter((a) => a.type_id === typeId).sort((a, b) => a.sort - b.sort)

  const [f, setF] = useState({
    name: product?.name ?? '',
    slug: product?.slug ?? '',
    sku: product?.sku ?? '',
    description: product?.description ?? '',
    unit: product?.unit ?? 'Cái',
    brand_id: product?.brand_id ?? '',
    category_id: product?.category_id ?? '',
    price: str(product?.price),
    compare_at_price: str(product?.compare_at_price),
    cost: str(product?.cost),
    stock: str(product?.variants.length === 1 ? product.variants[0]?.stock : product?.stock_total ?? 0),
    min_stock: str(product?.min_stock ?? 0),
    purchase_limit: str(product?.purchase_limit),
    weight_g: str(product?.weight_g),
    status: (product?.status ?? 'active') as ProductStatus,
    online: product?.online ?? true,
    pos: product?.pos ?? true,
    is_featured: product?.is_featured ?? false,
    tags: (product?.tags ?? []).join(', '),
    allow_preorder: product?.allow_preorder ?? false,
    preorder_deposit_pct: str(product?.preorder_deposit_pct),
    preorder_release_date: product?.preorder_release_date ?? '',
    preorder_slots: str(product?.preorder_slots),
    preorder_closes_at: product?.preorder_closes_at?.slice(0, 10) ?? '',
    seo_title: product?.seo_title ?? '',
    seo_description: product?.seo_description ?? ''
  })
  const [slugTouched, setSlugTouched] = useState(!!product)
  const [attrs, setAttrs] = useState<Record<string, string | number | boolean>>(product?.attrs ?? {})
  const [images, setImages] = useState(product?.images.map((i) => ({ url: i.url, alt: i.alt })) ?? [])
  const [imgUrl, setImgUrl] = useState('')
  const [collections, setCollections] = useState<string[]>(product?.collection_ids ?? [])

  const startVariants = (product?.options.length ?? 0) > 0
  const [useVariants, setUseVariants] = useState(startVariants)
  const [options, setOptions] = useState<Opt[]>(product?.options.map((o) => ({ name: o.name, values: o.values, draft: '' })) ?? [{ name: 'Màu sắc', values: [], draft: '' }])
  const [variantData, setVariantData] = useState<Record<string, VariantRow>>(() =>
    Object.fromEntries((product?.variants ?? []).filter((v) => v.option_values.length).map((v) => [v.option_values.join(' / '), { id: v.id, sku: v.sku, title: v.title, option_values: v.option_values, price: str(v.price), stock: String(v.stock), active: v.active }]))
  )
  const defaultVariantId = product?.variants.find((v) => !v.option_values.length)?.id

  const variants: VariantRow[] = useMemo(() => {
    if (!useVariants) return []
    const filled = options.filter((o) => o.name.trim() && o.values.length)
    if (!filled.length) return []
    return cartesian(filled).map((combo, i) => {
      const key = combo.join(' / ')
      return variantData[key] ?? { sku: `${f.sku || 'SKU'}-${i + 1}`, title: key, option_values: combo, price: '', stock: '0', active: true }
    })
  }, [useVariants, options, variantData, f.sku])

  const set = <K extends keyof typeof f>(k: K, v: (typeof f)[K]) => setF((s) => ({ ...s, [k]: v }))
  const setVariant = (key: string, patch: Partial<VariantRow>) => {
    const cur = variants.find((v) => v.option_values.join(' / ') === key)
    if (cur) setVariantData((d) => ({ ...d, [key]: { ...cur, ...patch } }))
  }

  const cats = useMemo(() => {
    const out: { id: string; label: string }[] = []
    const walk = (parent: string | null, prefix: string) =>
      meta.categories.filter((c) => c.parent_id === parent).sort((a, b) => a.sort - b.sort).forEach((c) => {
        out.push({ id: c.id, label: prefix + c.name })
        walk(c.id, `${prefix}${c.name} › `)
      })
    walk(null, '')
    return out
  }, [meta.categories])

  async function upload(files: FileList | null) {
    if (!files?.length) return
    setUploading(true)
    setError(null)
    const sb = createClient()
    for (const file of Array.from(files).slice(0, 10)) {
      if (file.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024) { setError('Ảnh tối đa 5MB.'); continue }
      const path = `${crypto.randomUUID()}.${(file.name.split('.').pop() ?? 'jpg').toLowerCase()}`
      const { error: e } = await sb.storage.from('products').upload(path, file, { cacheControl: '31536000', contentType: file.type })
      if (e) { setError('Tải ảnh chưa được: tài khoản cần quyền quản lý.'); continue }
      const { data } = sb.storage.from('products').getPublicUrl(path)
      setImages((s) => [...s, { url: data.publicUrl, alt: f.name }])
    }
    setUploading(false)
  }

  const payload: ProductInput = {
    id: product?.id,
    type_id: typeId,
    category_id: f.category_id,
    brand_id: f.brand_id,
    name: f.name,
    slug: f.slug || slugify(f.name),
    sku: f.sku,
    description: f.description,
    unit: f.unit,
    price: num(f.price) ?? 0,
    compare_at_price: num(f.compare_at_price),
    cost: num(f.cost),
    stock: num(f.stock) ?? 0,
    status: f.status,
    online: f.online,
    pos: f.pos,
    is_featured: f.is_featured,
    attrs: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(attrs).filter(([k, v]) => v !== '' && attrDefs.some((a) => a.code === k))),
    tags: f.tags.split(',').map((t) => t.trim()).filter(Boolean),
    images,
    options: useVariants ? options.filter((o) => o.name.trim() && o.values.length).map((o) => ({ name: o.name.trim(), values: o.values })) : [],
    variants: useVariants
      ? variants.map((v) => ({ id: v.id, sku: v.sku.trim(), title: v.title, option_values: v.option_values, price: num(v.price), stock: num(v.stock) ?? 0, active: v.active }))
      : [{ id: defaultVariantId, sku: f.sku.trim(), title: 'Mặc định', option_values: [], price: null, stock: num(f.stock) ?? 0, active: true }],
    collection_ids: collections,
    min_stock: num(f.min_stock) ?? 0,
    purchase_limit: num(f.purchase_limit),
    weight_g: num(f.weight_g),
    allow_preorder: !!type?.allow_preorder && f.allow_preorder,
    preorder_deposit_pct: num(f.preorder_deposit_pct),
    preorder_release_date: f.preorder_release_date || null,
    preorder_slots: num(f.preorder_slots),
    preorder_closes_at: f.preorder_closes_at ? `${f.preorder_closes_at}T23:59:59+07:00` : null,
    seo_title: f.seo_title,
    seo_description: f.seo_description
  }
  const { handleSubmit, formState: { errors } } = useForm<ProductInput>({ values: payload, resolver: zodResolver(productSchema) })
  function submit(e: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    setError(null); setSaved(null)
    void handleSubmit((validated) => start(async () => {
      try {
        const r = await saveProduct(validated)
        if (!r.ok) { setError(r.error); return }
        setSaved('Đã lưu sản phẩm.')
        if (!product && r.data?.id) router.replace(`/admin/san-pham/${r.data.id}`)
        else router.refresh()
      } catch { setError('Chưa kết nối được máy chủ. Dữ liệu đang nhập vẫn được giữ để bạn thử lại.') }
    }), (issues) => {
      const first = Object.values(issues).find((v) => typeof v?.message === 'string')
      setError(String(first?.message ?? 'Kiểm tra các trường bắt buộc và số lượng biến thể (tối đa 100).'))
      document.getElementById('product-validation')?.scrollIntoView({ block:'center', behavior:'auto' })
    })(e)
  }

  const inputCls = 'input !pr-10'
  return (
    <form onSubmit={submit} className="flex flex-col gap-5 pb-24" noValidate>
      {readOnly ? <p className="admin-notice">Bạn đang xem sản phẩm. Chủ shop và quản lý có thể chỉnh sửa.</p> : null}
      <nav className="admin-form-index" aria-label="Đi đến phần nhập sản phẩm">{['Loại sản phẩm','Thông tin chung','Hình ảnh','Giá và kho','Phân loại','Hiển thị và bán'].map((label) => <a key={label} href={`#product-${slugify(label)}`}>{label}</a>)}</nav>
      <div id="product-validation" role="alert" aria-live="polite">{error ? <p className="rounded-xl bg-bad-bg p-4 text-sm text-bad">{error}</p> : null}</div>
      <fieldset disabled={readOnly || pending} className="contents">
      <Card title="Loại sản phẩm">
        <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-[1fr_auto] md:items-end">
          <Field label="Loại sản phẩm *" hint="Loại quyết định các thuộc tính và cách bán bên dưới.">
            <select className={inputCls} value={typeId} onChange={(e) => { setTypeId(e.target.value); setUseVariants(false) }}>
              {meta.types.map((t) => <option key={t.id} value={t.id}>{t.name}</option>)}
            </select>
          </Field>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 pb-7">
            {type?.has_variants ? <span className="pill pill-brand">Có biến thể</span> : null}
            {type?.is_unique ? <span className="pill pill-brand">Món duy nhất</span> : type?.track_inventory ? <span className="pill pill-brand">Theo dõi tồn kho</span> : null}
            {type?.allow_preorder ? <span className="pill pill-brand">Cho pre-order</span> : <span className="pill pill-neu">Không pre-order</span>}
            {type ? <Link href={`/admin/loai-san-pham/${type.id}`} className="btn btn-ghost btn-sm">Sửa loại này</Link> : null}
          </div>
        </div>
      </Card>

      <Card title="Thông tin chung">
        <Field label="Tên sản phẩm *">
          <input {...{name: 'name'}} aria-invalid={!!errors.name} className={inputCls} value={f.name} required onChange={(e) => { set('name', e.target.value); if (!slugTouched) set('slug', slugify(e.target.value)) }} />
        </Field>
        {errors.name ? <p className="text-xs text-bad">{errors.name.message}</p> : null}
        <Grid>
          <Field label="SKU *" hint={useVariants ? 'SKU biến thể nối thêm hậu tố' : 'Mã quét ở quầy'}><input className={`${inputCls} font-mono`} value={f.sku} onChange={(e) => set('sku', e.target.value.toUpperCase())} /></Field>
          <Field label="Thương hiệu">
            <select className={inputCls} value={f.brand_id} onChange={(e) => set('brand_id', e.target.value)}>
              <option value="">Không có</option>
              {meta.brands.map((b) => <option key={b.id} value={b.id}>{b.name}</option>)}
            </select>
          </Field>
          <Field label="Đơn vị tính"><input className={inputCls} value={f.unit} onChange={(e) => set('unit', e.target.value)} /></Field>
        </Grid>
        <Field label="Mô tả"><textarea className={inputCls} rows={4} value={f.description} onChange={(e) => set('description', e.target.value)} /></Field>
      </Card>

      <Card title="Hình ảnh">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 xs:grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 xl:grid-cols-5">
          {images.map((im, i) => (
            <div key={`${im.url}-${i}`} className="relative overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-line">
              <ProductImage src={im.url} alt={im.alt} sizes="160px" />
              {i === 0 ? <span className="pill pill-brand absolute top-1.5 left-1.5">Ảnh chính</span> : null}
              <div className="absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 flex justify-end gap-0.5 bg-white/85 p-1">
                <button type="button" className="btn btn-ghost btn-icon min-h-8 w-8" aria-label="Đưa lên trước" disabled={i === 0} onClick={() => setImages((s) => { const n = [...s]; [n[i - 1], n[i]] = [n[i]!, n[i - 1]!]; return n })}><ArrowUp size={14} aria-hidden="true" /></button>
                <button type="button" className="btn btn-ghost btn-icon min-h-8 w-8" aria-label="Đưa xuống sau" disabled={i === images.length - 1} onClick={() => setImages((s) => { const n = [...s]; [n[i + 1], n[i]] = [n[i]!, n[i + 1]!]; return n })}><ArrowDown size={14} aria-hidden="true" /></button>
                <button type="button" className="btn btn-ghost btn-icon min-h-8 w-8 text-bad" aria-label="Xóa ảnh" onClick={() => setImages((s) => s.filter((_, j) => j !== i))}><X size={14} aria-hidden="true" /></button>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
          <button type="button" disabled={!canUpload || uploading} onClick={() => fileRef.current?.click()} className="flex aspect-square flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1 rounded-xl border-2 border-dashed border-ctl text-sm text-muted hover:bg-surface disabled:opacity-50">
            {uploading ? <Loader2 size={22} className="animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" /> : <ImagePlus size={22} aria-hidden="true" />}
            {uploading ? 'Đang tải' : 'Tải ảnh'}
          </button>
        </div>
        <input ref={fileRef} type="file" accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp,image/avif" multiple className="sr-only" onChange={(e) => upload(e.target.files)} />
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <input className={inputCls} value={imgUrl} onChange={(e) => setImgUrl(e.target.value)} placeholder="Hoặc dán đường dẫn ảnh (https://… hoặc /art/box1.svg)" aria-label="Đường dẫn ảnh" />
          <button type="button" className="btn btn-secondary" onClick={() => { if (imgUrl.trim()) { setImages((s) => [...s, { url: imgUrl.trim(), alt: f.name }]); setImgUrl('') } }}>Thêm</button>
        </div>
        <p className="hint">Ảnh vuông, tối thiểu 1000×1000 px, tối đa 5MB. Ảnh đầu tiên là ảnh chính.{canUpload ? '' : ' Tải ảnh lên cần cấu hình Supabase.'}</p>
      </Card>

      <Card title="Giá và kho">
        <Grid>
          <Field label="Giá bán *" suffix="₫"><input className={inputCls} inputMode="numeric" value={f.price} onChange={(e) => set('price', e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, ''))} /></Field>
          <Field label="Giá gốc (gạch ngang)" suffix="₫"><input className={inputCls} inputMode="numeric" value={f.compare_at_price} placeholder="Để trống nếu không giảm" onChange={(e) => set('compare_at_price', e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, ''))} /></Field>
          <Field label="Giá vốn" hint="Chỉ nội bộ" suffix="₫"><input className={inputCls} inputMode="numeric" value={f.cost} onChange={(e) => set('cost', e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, ''))} /></Field>
          {!useVariants ? (
            <Field label={type?.is_unique ? 'Tồn kho (món duy nhất: 0 hoặc 1)' : 'Tồn kho'}><input className={inputCls} inputMode="numeric" value={f.stock} onChange={(e) => set('stock', e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, ''))} /></Field>
          ) : null}
          <Field label="Tồn tối thiểu" hint="Cảnh báo khi dưới mức này"><input className={inputCls} inputMode="numeric" value={f.min_stock} onChange={(e) => set('min_stock', e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, ''))} /></Field>
          <Field label="Giới hạn mua mỗi đơn"><input className={inputCls} inputMode="numeric" value={f.purchase_limit} placeholder="Không giới hạn" onChange={(e) => set('purchase_limit', e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, ''))} /></Field>
        </Grid>
      </Card>

      {type?.has_variants ? (
        <Card title="Biến thể" action={variants.length ? <span className="pill pill-brand">{variants.length} biến thể</span> : null}>
          <label className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
            <span className="flex flex-col"><span className="label">Sản phẩm có nhiều lựa chọn</span><span className="hint">Ví dụ màu sắc, kích cỡ. Mỗi biến thể có SKU, giá, tồn kho riêng.</span></span>
            <input type="checkbox" className="switch" checked={useVariants} onChange={(e) => setUseVariants(e.target.checked)} />
          </label>
          {useVariants ? (
            <>
              <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">
                {options.map((o, i) => (
                  <div key={i} className="flex flex-col gap-2 rounded-xl border border-line p-3">
                    <div className="flex gap-2">
                      <input className={inputCls} value={o.name} aria-label={`Tên tùy chọn ${i + 1}`} placeholder="Tên tùy chọn, ví dụ Kích cỡ" onChange={(e) => setOptions((s) => s.map((x, j) => (j === i ? { ...x, name: e.target.value } : x)))} />
                      <button type="button" className="btn btn-ghost btn-icon text-bad" aria-label="Xóa tùy chọn" onClick={() => setOptions((s) => s.filter((_, j) => j !== i))}><Trash2 size={18} aria-hidden="true" /></button>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                      {o.values.map((v) => (
                        <span key={v} className="chip">{v}<button type="button" aria-label={`Xóa ${v}`} onClick={() => setOptions((s) => s.map((x, j) => (j === i ? { ...x, values: x.values.filter((y) => y !== v) } : x)))}><X size={14} aria-hidden="true" /></button></span>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                    <input
                      className={inputCls}
                      value={o.draft}
                      placeholder="Gõ giá trị rồi nhấn Enter"
                      aria-label={`Thêm giá trị cho ${o.name || 'tùy chọn'}`}
                      onChange={(e) => setOptions((s) => s.map((x, j) => (j === i ? { ...x, draft: e.target.value } : x)))}
                      onKeyDown={(e) => {
                        if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ',') {
                          e.preventDefault()
                          const v = o.draft.trim()
                          if (v && !o.values.includes(v)) setOptions((s) => s.map((x, j) => (j === i ? { ...x, values: [...x.values, v], draft: '' } : x)))
                        }
                      }}
                    />
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
              {options.length < 3 ? <button type="button" className="btn btn-secondary self-start" onClick={() => setOptions((s) => [...s, { name: '', values: [], draft: '' }])}><Plus size={18} aria-hidden="true" />Thêm tùy chọn</button> : null}
              {variants.length > 100 ? <p role="alert" className="rounded-xl bg-warn-bg p-3 text-sm text-warn">Tối đa 100 biến thể. Giảm số giá trị tùy chọn trước khi lưu.</p> : null}
              {variants.length ? (
                <div className="table-wrap rounded-xl border border-line">
                  <table className="tbl">
                    <thead><tr><th>Biến thể</th><th>SKU</th><th className="num">Giá (trống = giá mặc định)</th><th className="num">Tồn</th><th>Bán</th></tr></thead>
                    <tbody>
                      {variants.map((v) => {
                        const key = v.option_values.join(' / ')
                        return (
                          <tr key={key}>
                            <td className="font-semibold whitespace-nowrap">{key}</td>
                            <td><input className="input min-h-9 min-w-40 font-mono text-sm" value={v.sku} aria-label={`SKU ${key}`} onChange={(e) => setVariant(key, { sku: e.target.value.toUpperCase() })} /></td>
                            <td className="num"><input className="input min-h-9 w-32 text-right" inputMode="numeric" value={v.price} placeholder={f.price} aria-label={`Giá ${key}`} onChange={(e) => setVariant(key, { price: e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, '') })} /></td>
                            <td className="num"><input className="input min-h-9 w-20 text-right" inputMode="numeric" value={v.stock} aria-label={`Tồn ${key}`} onChange={(e) => setVariant(key, { stock: e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, '') })} /></td>
                            <td><input type="checkbox" className="switch" checked={v.active} aria-label={`Bán ${key}`} onChange={(e) => setVariant(key, { active: e.target.checked })} /></td>
                          </tr>
                        )
                      })}
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                </div>
              ) : <p className="hint">Thêm giá trị cho tùy chọn để tạo bảng biến thể.</p>}
            </>
          ) : null}
        </Card>
      ) : null}

      {attrDefs.length ? (
        <Card title={`Thuộc tính loại ${type?.name ?? ''}`}>
          <p className="hint">Các trường do loại sản phẩm quy định. Muốn thêm, bớt trường thì sửa ở Loại sản phẩm.</p>
          <Grid>
            {attrDefs.map((a) => {
              const val = attrs[a.code]
              const label = `${a.name}${a.required ? ' *' : ''}`
              const hint = a.filterable ? 'Hiện ở bộ lọc cửa hàng' : undefined
              if (a.kind === 'select') return (
                <Field key={a.id} label={label} hint={hint}>
                  <select className={inputCls} value={String(val ?? '')} onChange={(e) => setAttrs((s) => ({ ...s, [a.code]: e.target.value }))}>
                    <option value="">Chọn</option>
                    {a.options.map((o) => <option key={o}>{o}</option>)}
                  </select>
                </Field>
              )
              if (a.kind === 'boolean') return (
                <label key={a.id} className="flex min-h-11 items-center justify-between gap-3 self-end"><span className="label">{label}</span>
                  <input type="checkbox" className="switch" checked={val === true} onChange={(e) => setAttrs((s) => ({ ...s, [a.code]: e.target.checked }))} /></label>
              )
              return (
                <Field key={a.id} label={label} hint={hint}>
                  <input className={inputCls} type={a.kind === 'date' ? 'date' : 'text'} inputMode={a.kind === 'number' ? 'numeric' : undefined} value={String(val ?? '')}
                    onChange={(e) => setAttrs((s) => ({ ...s, [a.code]: a.kind === 'number' ? (e.target.value === '' ? '' : Number(e.target.value.replace(/[^\d.]/g, ''))) : e.target.value }))} />
                </Field>
              )
            })}
          </Grid>
        </Card>
      ) : null}

      <Card title="Phân loại">
        <Grid>
          <Field label="Danh mục chính" hint="Dùng cho menu và đường dẫn">
            <select className={inputCls} value={f.category_id} onChange={(e) => set('category_id', e.target.value)}>
              <option value="">Chưa chọn</option>
              {cats.map((c) => <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>{c.label}</option>)}
            </select>
          </Field>
          <Field label="Thẻ (tag)" hint="Cách nhau bằng dấu phẩy"><input className={inputCls} value={f.tags} onChange={(e) => set('tags', e.target.value)} /></Field>
        </Grid>
        {meta.collections.length ? (
          <fieldset className="flex flex-col gap-2">
            <legend className="label mb-1">Bộ sưu tập</legend>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
              {meta.collections.map((c) => (
                <button key={c.id} type="button" className="chip" aria-pressed={collections.includes(c.id)} onClick={() => setCollections((s) => (s.includes(c.id) ? s.filter((x) => x !== c.id) : [...s, c.id]))}>{c.name}</button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </fieldset>
        ) : null}
      </Card>

      <Card title="Hiển thị và bán">
        <Grid>
          <Field label="Trạng thái">
            <select className={inputCls} value={f.status} onChange={(e) => set('status', e.target.value as ProductStatus)}>
              <option value="active">Đang bán</option><option value="draft">Nháp</option><option value="hidden">Ẩn</option><option value="archived">Lưu trữ</option>
            </select>
          </Field>
          <Field label="Đường dẫn (slug)"><input className={`${inputCls} font-mono text-sm`} value={f.slug} onChange={(e) => { setSlugTouched(true); set('slug', slugify(e.target.value)) }} /></Field>
        </Grid>
        <Toggle label="Hiển thị trên cửa hàng online" hint="Tắt để ẩn, sản phẩm vẫn giữ trong kho." checked={f.online} onChange={(v) => set('online', v)} />
        <Toggle label="Bán tại quầy (POS)" hint="Cho phép thu ngân tìm và bán sản phẩm này." checked={f.pos} onChange={(v) => set('pos', v)} />
        <Toggle label="Nổi bật ở trang chủ" checked={f.is_featured} onChange={(v) => set('is_featured', v)} />
        {type?.allow_preorder ? (
          <>
            <Toggle label="Cho đặt trước (pre-order có đặt cọc)" hint="Khách đặt cọc giữ suất, không trừ tồn kho." checked={f.allow_preorder} onChange={(v) => set('allow_preorder', v)} />
            {f.allow_preorder ? (
              <Grid>
                <Field label="Tỷ lệ cọc" hint="Trống = theo Cài đặt" suffix="%"><input className={inputCls} inputMode="numeric" value={f.preorder_deposit_pct} onChange={(e) => set('preorder_deposit_pct', e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, ''))} /></Field>
                <Field label="Tổng số suất" hint="Hết suất thì tự khóa đặt"><input className={inputCls} inputMode="numeric" value={f.preorder_slots} onChange={(e) => set('preorder_slots', e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, ''))} /></Field>
                <Field label="Ngày hàng về dự kiến"><input className={inputCls} type="date" value={f.preorder_release_date} onChange={(e) => set('preorder_release_date', e.target.value)} /></Field>
                <Field label="Đóng đặt vào"><input className={inputCls} type="date" value={f.preorder_closes_at} onChange={(e) => set('preorder_closes_at', e.target.value)} /></Field>
              </Grid>
            ) : null}
          </>
        ) : null}
        <Grid>
          <Field label="Tiêu đề SEO"><input className={inputCls} value={f.seo_title} placeholder={f.name} onChange={(e) => set('seo_title', e.target.value)} /></Field>
          <Field label="Mô tả SEO"><input className={inputCls} value={f.seo_description} onChange={(e) => set('seo_description', e.target.value)} /></Field>
        </Grid>
      </Card>

      </fieldset>
      {!readOnly ? <div className="admin-savebar">
        <div className="admin-savebar-inner">
          {product ? (
            <ActionButton
              action={deleteProduct.bind(null, product.id)}
              className="btn btn-danger-outline"
              confirm={{ title: `Xóa "${product.name}"?`, text: 'Sản phẩm, biến thể và ảnh sẽ bị xóa. Đơn hàng cũ vẫn giữ tên và giá đã bán. Nên dùng Lưu trữ nếu chỉ muốn ngừng bán.', confirmLabel: 'Xóa sản phẩm', danger: true }}
              onDone={() => router.push('/admin/san-pham')}
            >
              <Trash2 size={16} aria-hidden="true" />Xóa
            </ActionButton>
          ) : null}
          <span role="status" className="min-w-0 flex-1 text-sm">{error ? <span className="text-bad">{error}</span> : saved ? <span className="text-ok">{saved}</span> : null}</span>
          <Link href="/admin/san-pham" className="btn btn-ghost">Hủy</Link>
          <button type="submit" className="btn btn-primary" disabled={pending || uploading || variants.length > 100}>{pending ? <Loader2 size={16} className="animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" /> : null}Lưu sản phẩm</button>
        </div>
      </div> : null}
    </form>
  )
}

function Card({ title, action, children }: { title: string; action?: React.ReactNode; children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <section id={`product-${slugify(title)}`} className="card admin-form-section overflow-hidden">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-line px-4 py-3.5 sm:px-5"><h2 className="font-display text-lg font-bold">{title}</h2>{action}</div>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 p-4 sm:p-5">{children}</div>
    </section>
  )
}

function Grid({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return <div className="grid items-start gap-5 sm:grid-cols-2">{children}</div>
}

function Field({ label, hint, suffix, children }: { label: string; hint?: string; suffix?: string; children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <label className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
      <span className="label min-h-5">{label}</span>
      {suffix ? <span className="relative flex items-center">{children}<span className="pointer-events-none absolute right-3 text-sm text-muted">{suffix}</span></span> : children}
      {hint ? <span className="hint">{hint}</span> : null}
    </label>
  )
}

function Toggle({ label, hint, checked, onChange }: { label: string; hint?: string; checked: boolean; onChange: (v: boolean) => void }) {
  return (
    <label className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 border-t border-line pt-4 first:border-t-0 first:pt-0">
      <span className="flex flex-col"><span className="label">{label}</span>{hint ? <span className="hint">{hint}</span> : null}</span>
      <input type="checkbox" className="switch" checked={checked} onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.checked)} />
    </label>
  )
}

  })

'Ẩn khỏi cửa hàng' : 'Mở bán sản phẩm'}</DropdownMenuItem></> : null}</DropdownMenuContent></DropdownMenu>
  const stock = (p:AdminProductRow) => {
    const t = types[p.type_id]
    const low = p.status === 'active' && !p.allow_preorder && t?.track_inventory && !t.is_unique && p.stock_total <= p.min_stock
    return <span className={low ? 'font-semibold text-bad' : 'text-muted'}>{p.allow_preorder ? `${p.preorder_slots ?? '∞'} suất đặt trước` : `${p.stock_total} có sẵn`}{p.variant_count > 1 ? <small className="block text-[11px] font-normal text-muted">{p.variant_count} biến thể</small> : null}</span>

    {selected.length ? <div className="admin-bulkbar"><b>Đã chọn {selected.length} / {rows.length}</b><span className="text-muted">trên trang này</span><div className="ml-auto flex flex-wrap gap-1"><button type="button" className="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" disabled={pending} onClick={() => changeStatus(selected.map((p) => p.id),'active')}><Eye size={15} aria-hidden="true" />Mở bán</button><button type="button" className="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" disabled={pending} onClick={() => changeStatus(selected.map((p) => p.id),'hidden')}><EyeOff size={15} aria-hidden="true" />Ẩn</button><button type="button" className="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" onClick={download}><Download size={15} aria-hidden="true" />Xuất CSV</button><button type="button" className="btn btn-ghost btn-icon" onClick={() => setSelection({})} aria-label="Bỏ chọn"><X size={17} aria-hidden="true" /></button></div></div> : null}

'use client'
import { useId, useState } from 'react'
import { Table2 } from 'lucide-react'
import { formatVND } from '@/lib/utils'
export function RevenueChart({ data }: { data:{day:string;total:number}[] }) {
  const [active,setActive] = useState<number | null>(null)
  const [table,setTable] = useState(false)
  const uid = useId().replaceAll(':','')
  const max = Math.max(...data.map((d) => d.total),1)
  const ceiling = Math.max(1_000_000,Math.ceil(max/5_000_000)*5_000_000)
  const width=900, height=230, left=62, right=30, top=16, bottom=36
  const plotHeight=height-top-bottom; const step=(width-left-right)/Math.max(data.length,1)
  const date=(day:string) => `${day.slice(8,10)}/${day.slice(5,7)}`
  const focus=active === null ? null : data[active]
  return <div><div className="mb-5 flex flex-wrap items-end justify-between gap-3"><div><p className="text-xs text-muted">Tổng 7 ngày, theo ngày tạo đơn đã thanh toán</p><p className="mt-2 font-sans text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight">{formatVND(data.reduce((s,d) => s+d.total,0))}</p></div><button type="button" className="btn btn-secondary btn-sm" aria-pressed={table} onClick={() => setTable(!table)}><Table2 size={15} aria-hidden="true" />{table ? 'Biểu đồ' : 'Bảng số liệu'}</button></div>
    {table ? <div className="table-wrap"><table className="tbl"><caption className="sr-only">Doanh thu bảy ngày</caption><thead><tr><th>Ngày</th><th className="num">Doanh thu</th></tr></thead><tbody>{data.map((d) => <tr key={d.day}><td>{date(d.day)}</td><td className="num">{formatVND(d.total)}</td></tr>)}</tbody></table></div> : <div className="admin-chart" onPointerLeave={() => setActive(null)}>
      <svg viewBox={`0 0 ${width} ${height}`} role="img" aria-label="Doanh thu 7 ngày. Dùng nút Bảng số liệu để đọc toàn bộ giá trị.">
        <defs><pattern id={`pattern-${uid}`} patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse" width="6" height="6" patternTransform="rotate(45)"><rect width="2" height="6" fill="currentColor" /></pattern></defs>
        {[0,.25,.5,.75,1].map((ratio) => {const y=top+plotHeight*(1-ratio);return <g key={ratio}><line x1={left} x2={width-right} y1={y} y2={y} stroke="#e8ecf3" strokeWidth="1" /><text x={left-12} y={y+4} textAnchor="end" fill="#56657c" fontSize="11">{Math.round(ceiling*ratio/1_000_000)}tr</text></g>})}
        {data.map((d,i) => { const x=left+step*(i+.5); const h=d.total/ceiling*plotHeight; const y=top+plotHeight-h;return <g key={d.day} tabIndex={0} role="button" aria-label={`${date(d.day)}: ${formatVND(d.total)}`} onFocus={() => setActive(i)} onBlur={() => setActive(null)} onPointerEnter={() => setActive(i)} onPointerDown={() => setActive(i)} onKeyDown={(e) => {if(e.key==='Escape')setActive(null)}} style={{outline:'none'}}>
          <rect x={x-step/2+2} y={top} width={step-4} height={plotHeight+bottom-6} fill="transparent" />
          {d.total > 0 ? <path d={`M ${x-12} ${top+plotHeight} V ${y+Math.min(4,h)} Q ${x-12} ${y} ${x-8} ${y} H ${x+8} Q ${x+12} ${y} ${x+12} ${y+Math.min(4,h)} V ${top+plotHeight} Z`} fill="#1b4fe0" opacity={active === null || active === i ? 1 : .45} /> : null}
          {active === i ? <rect x={x-18} y={top-4} width={36} height={plotHeight+8} fill="none" stroke="#8591a5" rx={4} /> : null}
          <text x={x} y={height-9} textAnchor="middle" fill="#56657c" fontSize="11">{date(d.day)}</text>
        </g>})}
      </svg>
      {focus ? <div className="admin-chart-tooltip" role="status" style={{left:`clamp(0px, ${((active!+.5)/data.length)*100}%, calc(100% - 175px))`}}><span className="text-muted">Ngày {date(focus.day)}</span><strong>{formatVND(focus.total)}</strong></div> : null}
    </div>}
  </div>
}

function SettingSection({def,value,readOnly}:{def:(typeof SECTIONS)[number];value:Record<string,unknown>;readOnly:boolean}) {
  const [pending,start]=useTransition()
  const [msg,setMsg]=useState<{ok:boolean;text:string}|null>(null)
  const {register,handleSubmit,reset,formState:{errors,isDirty}}=useForm<Record<string,unknown>>({defaultValues:value,resolver:zodResolver(settingSchemas[def.key]) as unknown as Resolver<Record<string,unknown>>})
  return <form className="card overflow-hidden" onSubmit={handleSubmit((data)=>start(async()=>{
    setMsg(null)
    try { const r=await saveSetting(def.key,data);setMsg(r.ok?{ok:true,text:r.message??'Đã lưu'}:{ok:false,text:r.error});if(r.ok)reset(data) }
    catch {setMsg({ok:false,text:'Chưa kết nối được máy chủ. Hãy kiểm tra mạng rồi lưu lại.'})}
  }))} noValidate>
    <div className="admin-section-head"><div><h2>{def.title}</h2>{def.desc?<p className="hint mt-2 max-w-3xl">{def.desc}</p>:null}</div>{readOnly?<span className="pill pill-neu">Chỉ xem</span>:null}</div>
    <fieldset disabled={readOnly||pending} className="admin-section-body">
      <div className="grid items-start gap-5 sm:grid-cols-2">{def.fields.filter((f)=>f.kind!=='bool').map((f)=>{
        const id=`setting-${def.key}-${f.k}`;const error=errors[f.k]?.message
        return <label htmlFor={id} key={f.k} className={`flex flex-col gap-2 ${f.wide?'sm:col-span-2':''}`}><span className="label">{f.label}</span><span className="relative"><input id={id} {...register(f.k,f.kind==='number'?{setValueAs:(v:unknown)=>v===''?(f.k==='free_over'?null:NaN):Number(v)}:undefined)} type={f.kind==='number'?'number':'text'} min={f.kind==='number'?0:undefined} className={`input ${f.suffix?'!pr-16':''}`} inputMode={f.kind==='number'?'numeric':undefined} aria-invalid={!!error} aria-describedby={error?`${id}-error`:f.hint?`${id}-hint`:undefined}/>{f.suffix?<span className="pointer-events-none absolute top-3 right-3 text-sm text-muted">{f.suffix}</span>:null}</span>{f.hint?<span id={`${id}-hint`} className="hint">{f.hint}</span>:null}{error?<span id={`${id}-error`} role="alert" className="text-xs text-bad">{String(error)}</span>:null}</label>
      })}</div>
      {def.fields.filter((f)=>f.kind==='bool').map((f)=><label key={f.k} className="flex min-h-16 items-center justify-between gap-4 border-b border-line py-3 last:border-0"><span className="label">{f.label}</span><input type="checkbox" className="switch" {...register(f.k)}/></label>)}
    </fieldset>
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 border-t border-line bg-surface/50 px-5 py-4">{!readOnly?<><span className="mr-auto text-xs text-muted">{isDirty?'Chưa lưu thay đổi. Lưu trước khi chuyển nhóm.':'Các thay đổi đã được lưu.'}</span><button className="btn btn-primary" type="submit" disabled={pending||!isDirty}>{pending?<Loader2 size={16} className="animate-spin" aria-hidden="true"/>:<Save size={16} aria-hidden="true"/>}Lưu thay đổi</button></>:<p className="text-xs text-muted">Liên hệ chủ shop để cập nhật cài đặt.</p>}{msg?<p role={msg.ok?'status':'alert'} className={`flex w-full items-center gap-2 text-sm ${msg.ok?'text-ok':'text-bad'}`}>{msg.ok?<Check size={16} aria-hidden="true"/>:null}{msg.text}</p>:null}</div>
  </form>

'use client'
import { useState, useTransition } from 'react'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { Loader2 } from 'lucide-react'
import { ActionButton } from '@/components/admin/action-button'
import { deleteStaff, inviteStaff, updateStaff } from '@/lib/actions/admin'
import { ROLE_LABEL } from '@/lib/labels'
import type { Staff, StaffRole } from '@/lib/types'

export function StaffRowActions({ s, isMe }: { s: Staff; isMe: boolean }) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const [pending, start] = useTransition()
  const [err, setErr] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const run = (patch: Parameters<typeof updateStaff>[1]) => start(async () => { const r = await updateStaff(s.id, patch); setErr(r.ok ? null : r.error); if (r.ok) router.refresh() })
  return (
    <span className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
      <select className="input min-h-9 w-auto py-0 text-sm" value={s.role} disabled={pending || isMe} aria-label={`Vai trò của ${s.email}`} onChange={(e) => run({ role: e.target.value as StaffRole })}>
        {(Object.keys(ROLE_LABEL) as StaffRole[]).map((r) => <option key={r} value={r}>{ROLE_LABEL[r]}</option>)}
      </select>
      <button type="button" className="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" disabled={pending} onClick={() => run({ allow_google: !s.allow_google })}>{s.allow_google ? 'Tắt Google' : 'Cho Google'}</button>
      {!isMe ? <button type="button" className="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" disabled={pending} onClick={() => run({ active: !s.active })}>{s.active ? 'Khóa' : 'Mở khóa'}</button> : null}
      {!isMe ? (
        <ActionButton action={deleteStaff.bind(null, s.id)} className="btn btn-ghost btn-sm text-bad" confirm={{ title: `Xóa nhân viên ${s.email}?`, text: 'Người này sẽ không vào được trang quản trị. Lịch sử đơn vẫn giữ.', confirmLabel: 'Xóa nhân viên', danger: true }}>Xóa</ActionButton>
      ) : null}
      {pending ? <Loader2 size={16} className="animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" /> : null}
      {err ? <span role="alert" className="text-sm text-bad">{err}</span> : null}
    </span>
  )
}
