'use client'
import { useMemo, useState, useTransition } from 'react'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { Loader2, Pencil, Plus, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react'
import { ActionButton } from '@/components/admin/action-button'
import { deleteTaxonomy, saveCategory, saveSimple } from '@/lib/actions/admin'
import { slugify } from '@/lib/utils'
import type { Category } from '@/lib/types'

type Draft = { id?: string; name: string; slug: string; parent_id: string | null; sort: number; visible: boolean }

export function CategoryManager({ categories, counts }: { categories: Category[]; counts: Record<string, number> }) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const [pending, start] = useTransition()
  const [edit, setEdit] = useState<Draft | null>(null)
  const [msg, setMsg] = useState<{ ok: boolean; text: string } | null>(null)
  const empty: Draft = { name: '', slug: '', parent_id: null, sort: 0, visible: true }
  const [d, setD] = useState<Draft>(empty)

  const tree = useMemo(() => {
    const out: (Category & { level: number })[] = []
    const walk = (p: string | null, level: number) => categories.filter((c) => c.parent_id === p).sort((a, b) => a.sort - b.sort).forEach((c) => { out.push({ ...c, level }); walk(c.id, level + 1) })
    walk(null, 0)
    return out
  }, [categories])

  const save = (draft: Draft, after: () => void) =>
    start(async () => {
      const r = await saveCategory({ ...draft, slug: draft.slug || slugify(draft.name) })
      setMsg(r.ok ? { ok: true, text: 'Đã lưu.' } : { ok: false, text: r.error })
      if (r.ok) { after(); router.refresh() }
    })

  return (
    <>
      <section className="card overflow-hidden">
        <ul className="divide-y divide-line">
          {tree.map((c) => (
            <li key={c.id} className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 sm:px-5" style={{ paddingLeft: `${16 + c.level * 14}px` }}>
              {edit?.id === c.id ? (
                <form className="flex flex-1 flex-wrap items-center gap-2" onSubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); save(edit, () => setEdit(null)) }}>
                  <input className="input min-h-10 flex-[1_1_200px]" value={edit.name} aria-label="Tên danh mục" onChange={(e) => setEdit({ ...edit, name: e.target.value })} />
                  <input className="input min-h-10 w-20" inputMode="numeric" value={edit.sort} aria-label="Thứ tự" onChange={(e) => setEdit({ ...edit, sort: Number(e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, '')) || 0 })} />
                  <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-semibold"><input type="checkbox" className="switch" checked={edit.visible} onChange={(e) => setEdit({ ...edit, visible: e.target.checked })} />Hiển thị</label>
                  <button type="button" className="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" onClick={() => setEdit(null)}>Hủy</button>
                  <button type="submit" className="btn btn-primary btn-sm" disabled={pending}>Lưu</button>
                </form>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <span className={`min-w-[120px] flex-1 break-words ${c.level === 0 ? 'font-bold' : ''}`}>{c.name} <span className="code text-xs text-muted">/{c.slug}</span></span>
                  {!c.visible ? <span className="pill pill-neu">Ẩn</span> : null}
                  <span className="w-20 text-right text-sm text-muted tabular-nums">{counts[c.id] ?? 0} SP</span>
                  <span className="flex">
                    {c.level < 2 ? <button type="button" className="btn btn-ghost btn-icon" aria-label={`Thêm danh mục con của ${c.name}`} onClick={() => setD({ ...empty, parent_id: c.id })}><Plus size={18} aria-hidden="true" /></button> : null}
                    <button type="button" className="btn btn-ghost btn-icon" aria-label={`Sửa ${c.name}`} onClick={() => setEdit({ id: c.id, name: c.name, slug: c.slug, parent_id: c.parent_id, sort: c.sort, visible: c.visible })}><Pencil size={18} aria-hidden="true" /></button>
                    <ActionButton action={deleteTaxonomy.bind(null, 'categories', c.id)} className="btn btn-ghost btn-icon text-bad" ariaLabel={`Xóa ${c.name}`}
                      confirm={{ title: `Xóa danh mục "${c.name}"?`, text: 'Sản phẩm trong danh mục sẽ chuyển thành chưa phân loại. Danh mục còn danh mục con thì chưa xóa được.', confirmLabel: 'Xóa danh mục', danger: true }}>
                      <Trash2 size={18} aria-hidden="true" />
                    </ActionButton>
                  </span>
                </>
              )}
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      </section>

      <section className="card flex flex-col gap-4 p-4 sm:p-5">
        <h2 className="font-display text-lg font-bold">Thêm danh mục</h2>
        <form className="grid items-end gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-[1fr_1fr_1fr_auto]" onSubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); save(d, () => setD(empty)) }}>
          <label className="flex flex-col gap-1.5"><span className="label">Tên danh mục *</span><input className="input" value={d.name} onChange={(e) => setD({ ...d, name: e.target.value, slug: slugify(e.target.value) })} /></label>
          <label className="flex flex-col gap-1.5"><span className="label">Danh mục cha</span>
            <select className="input" value={d.parent_id ?? ''} onChange={(e) => setD({ ...d, parent_id: e.target.value || null })}>
              <option value="">Cấp cao nhất</option>
              {tree.filter((c) => c.level < 2).map((c) => <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>{'— '.repeat(c.level)}{c.name}</option>)}
            </select></label>
          <label className="flex flex-col gap-1.5"><span className="label">Đường dẫn</span><input className="input font-mono text-sm" value={d.slug} onChange={(e) => setD({ ...d, slug: slugify(e.target.value) })} /></label>
          <button type="submit" className="btn btn-primary" disabled={pending || !d.name.trim()}>{pending ? <Loader2 size={16} className="animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" /> : <Plus size={18} aria-hidden="true" />}Thêm</button>
        </form>
        <p className="hint">Danh mục lồng tối đa 3 cấp. Mỗi sản phẩm có 1 danh mục chính, dùng cho menu và đường dẫn.</p>
        {msg ? <p role="status" className={`text-sm ${msg.ok ? 'text-ok' : 'text-bad'}`}>{msg.text}</p> : null}
      </section>
    </>
  )
}

export function SimpleManager({ table, rows, noun, hint }: { table: 'collections' | 'brands'; rows: { id: string; name: string; slug: string }[]; noun: string; hint: string }) {

  const [pending, start] = useTransition()
  const [d, setD] = useState({ name: '', slug: '' })
  const [edit, setEdit] = useState<{ id: string; name: string; slug: string } | null>(null)
  const [msg, setMsg] = useState<{ ok: boolean; text: string } | null>(null)
  const save = (v: { id?: string; name: string; slug: string }, after: () => void) =>
    start(async () => {
      const r = await saveSimple(table, { ...v, slug: v.slug || slugify(v.name) })
      setMsg(r.ok ? { ok: true, text: 'Đã lưu.' } : { ok: false, text: r.error })
      if (r.ok) { after(); router.refresh() }
    })
  return (
    <>
      <section className="card overflow-hidden">
        {rows.length === 0 ? <p className="p-6 text-center text-muted">Chưa có {noun} nào.</p> : (
          <ul className="divide-y divide-line">
            {rows.map((r) => (
              <li key={r.id} className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 sm:px-5">
                {edit?.id === r.id ? (
                  <form className="flex flex-1 flex-wrap gap-2" onSubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); save(edit, () => setEdit(null)) }}>

                    <input className="input min-h-10 flex-[1_1_160px] font-mono text-sm" value={edit.slug} aria-label="Đường dẫn" onChange={(e) => setEdit({ ...edit, slug: slugify(e.target.value) })} />
                    <button type="button" className="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" onClick={() => setEdit(null)}>Hủy</button>
                    <button type="submit" className="btn btn-primary btn-sm" disabled={pending}>Lưu</button>
                  </form>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <span className="min-w-[120px] flex-1 break-words font-semibold">{r.name} <span className="code text-xs font-normal text-muted">/{r.slug}</span></span>
                    <button type="button" className="btn btn-ghost btn-icon" aria-label={`Sửa ${r.name}`} onClick={() => setEdit(r)}><Pencil size={18} aria-hidden="true" /></button>
                    <ActionButton action={deleteTaxonomy.bind(null, table, r.id)} className="btn btn-ghost btn-icon text-bad" ariaLabel={`Xóa ${r.name}`}
                      confirm={{ title: `Xóa ${noun} "${r.name}"?`, text: 'Sản phẩm không bị xóa, chỉ bỏ liên kết.', confirmLabel: 'Xóa', danger: true }}>
                      <Trash2 size={18} aria-hidden="true" />
                    </ActionButton>
                  </>
                )}
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
      </section>
      <section className="card flex flex-col gap-4 p-4 sm:p-5">
        <h2 className="font-display text-lg font-bold">Thêm {noun}</h2>
        <form className="grid items-end gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-[1fr_1fr_auto]" onSubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); save(d, () => setD({ name: '', slug: '' })) }}>
          <label className="flex flex-col gap-1.5"><span className="label">Tên *</span><input className="input" value={d.name} onChange={(e) => setD({ name: e.target.value, slug: slugify(e.target.value) })} /></label>
          <label className="flex flex-col gap-1.5"><span className="label">Đường dẫn</span><input className="input font-mono text-sm" value={d.slug} onChange={(e) => setD({ ...d, slug: slugify(e.target.value) })} /></label>

'use client'
import { useState, useTransition } from 'react'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { Loader2 } from 'lucide-react'
import { updateTradein } from '@/lib/actions/admin'
import { TRADEIN_STATUS } from '@/lib/labels'
import { formatDateTime } from '@/lib/utils'
import type { TradeinRequest, TradeinStatus } from '@/lib/types'

export function TradeinEditor({ t }: { t: TradeinRequest }) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const [pending, start] = useTransition()
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<TradeinStatus>(t.status === 'new' ? 'quoted' : t.status)
  const [quote, setQuote] = useState(t.quoted_total ? String(t.quoted_total) : '')
  const [note, setNote] = useState(t.staff_note ?? '')
  const [msg, setMsg] = useState<{ ok: boolean; text: string } | null>(null)
  return (
    <form
      className="grid items-end gap-3 border-t border-line pt-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-[1fr_1fr_2fr_auto]"
      onSubmit={(e) => {
        e.preventDefault()
        start(async () => {
          const r = await updateTradein(t.id, { status, quoted_total: quote ? Number(quote) : null, staff_note: note })
          setMsg(r.ok ? { ok: true, text: 'Đã cập nhật.' } : { ok: false, text: r.error })
          if (r.ok) router.refresh()
        })
      }}
    >
      <label className="flex flex-col gap-1.5"><span className="label">Báo giá</span><input className="input" inputMode="numeric" value={quote} onChange={(e) => setQuote(e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, ''))} placeholder="Tổng tiền ₫" /></label>
      <label className="flex flex-col gap-1.5"><span className="label">Trạng thái</span>
        <select className="input" value={status} onChange={(e) => setStatus(e.target.value as TradeinStatus)}>
          {(Object.keys(TRADEIN_STATUS) as TradeinStatus[]).map((s) => <option key={s} value={s}>{TRADEIN_STATUS[s].label}</option>)}
        </select></label>
      <label className="flex flex-col gap-1.5"><span className="label">Ghi chú nội bộ</span><input className="input" value={note} onChange={(e) => setNote(e.target.value)} placeholder="Tình trạng thực tế, lý do giá" /></label>
      <button type="submit" className="btn btn-primary" disabled={pending}>{pending ? <Loader2 size={16} className="animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" /> : null}Lưu</button>
      {t.quote_expires_at ? <p className="text-sm text-muted sm:col-span-2 xl:col-span-4">Báo giá hiệu lực tới {formatDateTime(t.quote_expires_at)}</p> : null}
      {msg ? <p role="status" className={`text-sm sm:col-span-2 xl:col-span-4 ${msg.ok ? 'text-ok' : 'text-bad'}`}>{msg.text}</p> : null}
    </form>
  )
}

export type TypeDraft = Omit<ProductTypeInput, 'attributes'> & { attributes: (Omit<ProductTypeInput['attributes'][number], 'kind'> & { kind: AttrKind })[] }

const KIND: Record<AttrKind, string> = { text: 'Văn bản', number: 'Số', select: 'Danh sách chọn', boolean: 'Có hoặc không', date: 'Ngày' }
const BEHAVIORS: { k: keyof Omit<TypeDraft, 'attributes' | 'id' | 'code' | 'name' | 'description'>; t: string; d: string }[] = [

]

export function TypeForm({ draft, inUse }: { draft: TypeDraft; inUse: number }) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const [t, setT] = useState(draft)
  const [pending, start] = useTransition()
  const [msg, setMsg] = useState<{ ok: boolean; text: string } | null>(null)
  const [optDraft, setOptDraft] = useState<Record<number, string>>({})

  const setAttr = (i: number, patch: Partial<TypeDraft['attributes'][number]>) => setT((s) => ({ ...s, attributes: s.attributes.map((a, j) => (j === i ? { ...a, ...patch } : a)) }))
  const move = (i: number, d: -1 | 1) => setT((s) => { const n = [...s.attributes]; const j = i + d; if (j < 0 || j >= n.length) return s; [n[i], n[j]] = [n[j]!, n[i]!]; return { ...s, attributes: n } })

  function submit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault()
    setMsg(null)
    start(async () => {
      const r = await saveProductType(t as ProductTypeInput)
      if (!r.ok) { setMsg({ ok: false, text: r.error }); return }
      setMsg({ ok: true, text: 'Đã lưu loại sản phẩm.' })
      if (!t.id && r.data?.id) router.replace(`/admin/loai-san-pham/${r.data.id}`)
      else router.refresh()
    })
  }

  return (
    <form onSubmit={submit} className="flex flex-col gap-5 pb-24">
      <section className="card flex flex-col gap-4 p-4 sm:p-5">
        <h2 className="font-display text-lg font-bold">Thông tin loại</h2>
        <div className="grid items-start gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
          <label className="flex flex-col gap-1.5"><span className="label">Tên loại *</span>
            <input required className="input" value={t.name} onChange={(e) => setT((s) => ({ ...s, name: e.target.value, code: s.id ? s.code : slugify(e.target.value) }))} /></label>
          <label className="flex flex-col gap-1.5"><span className="label">Mã loại</span>
            <input className="input font-mono text-sm" value={t.code} disabled={!!t.id} onChange={(e) => setT((s) => ({ ...s, code: slugify(e.target.value) }))} />
            <span className="hint">{t.id ? 'Không đổi được sau khi tạo (dùng khi nhập Excel, đường dẫn bộ lọc).' : 'Tự tạo từ tên.'}</span></label>
        </div>
        <label className="flex flex-col gap-1.5"><span className="label">Mô tả nội bộ</span><input className="input" value={t.description} onChange={(e) => setT((s) => ({ ...s, description: e.target.value }))} /></label>
      </section>

      <section className="card flex flex-col gap-0 p-4 sm:p-5">
        <h2 className="mb-3 font-display text-lg font-bold">Cách bán</h2>
        {BEHAVIORS.map((b) => (
          <label key={b.k} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 border-t border-line py-3.5 first-of-type:border-t-0">
            <span className="flex flex-col"><span className="label">{b.t}</span><span className="hint">{b.d}</span></span>
            <input type="checkbox" className="switch" checked={!!t[b.k]} onChange={(e) => setT((s) => ({ ...s, [b.k]: e.target.checked }))} />
          </label>
        ))}
      </section>

      <section className="card flex flex-col gap-4 p-4 sm:p-5">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <h2 className="font-display text-lg font-bold">Thuộc tính</h2>
          <button type="button" className="btn btn-secondary" onClick={() => setT((s) => ({ ...s, attributes: [...s.attributes, { code: '', name: '', kind: 'text', options: [], required: false, filterable: false, visible: true }] }))}><Plus size={18} aria-hidden="true" />Thêm thuộc tính</button>
        </div>
        {inUse ? (
          <p className="flex gap-2 rounded-xl bg-warn-bg p-3 text-sm text-warn"><AlertTriangle size={18} className="flex-none" aria-hidden="true" />{inUse} sản phẩm đang dùng loại này. Thêm thuộc tính bắt buộc không chặn sản phẩm cũ, nhưng khi sửa sản phẩm sẽ cần nhập đủ.</p>
        ) : null}
        {t.attributes.length === 0 ? <p className="hint">Chưa có thuộc tính. Sản phẩm loại này chỉ có tên, giá, tồn kho, ảnh.</p> : null}
        {t.attributes.map((a, i) => (
          <div key={a.id ?? `new-${i}`} className="flex flex-col gap-3 rounded-xl border border-line p-3 sm:p-4">
            <div className="grid items-start gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3">
              <label className="flex flex-col gap-1.5"><span className="label">Tên thuộc tính *</span>
                <input required className="input" value={a.name} onChange={(e) => setAttr(i, { name: e.target.value, code: a.id ? a.code : slugify(e.target.value).replace(/-/g, '_') })} /></label>
              <label className="flex flex-col gap-1.5"><span className="label">Mã</span>
                <input className="input font-mono text-sm" value={a.code} disabled={!!a.id} onChange={(e) => setAttr(i, { code: slugify(e.target.value).replace(/-/g, '_') })} /></label>
              <label className="flex flex-col gap-1.5"><span className="label">Kiểu dữ liệu</span>
                <select className="input" value={a.kind} onChange={(e) => setAttr(i, { kind: e.target.value as AttrKind })}>
                  {(Object.keys(KIND) as AttrKind[]).map((k) => <option key={k} value={k}>{KIND[k]}</option>)}
                </select></label>
            </div>
            {a.kind === 'select' ? (
              <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
                <span className="label">Giá trị</span>
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                  {a.options.map((o) => <span key={o} className="chip">{o}<button type="button" aria-label={`Xóa ${o}`} onClick={() => setAttr(i, { options: a.options.filter((x) => x !== o) })}>×</button></span>)}
                </div>
                <input className="input" placeholder="Gõ giá trị rồi nhấn Enter" value={optDraft[i] ?? ''} aria-label={`Thêm giá trị cho ${a.name}`}
                  onChange={(e) => setOptDraft((s) => ({ ...s, [i]: e.target.value }))}
                  onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ',') { e.preventDefault(); const v = (optDraft[i] ?? '').trim(); if (v && !a.options.includes(v)) setAttr(i, { options: [...a.options, v] }); setOptDraft((s) => ({ ...s, [i]: '' })) } }} />
              </div>
            ) : null}
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-5 gap-y-2">
              {([['required', 'Bắt buộc'], ['filterable', 'Lọc ở cửa hàng'], ['visible', 'Hiện ở trang sản phẩm']] as const).map(([k, l]) => (
                <label key={k} className="flex min-h-11 items-center gap-2 text-sm font-semibold"><input type="checkbox" className="switch" checked={a[k]} onChange={(e) => setAttr(i, { [k]: e.target.checked })} />{l}</label>
              ))}
              <span className="ml-auto flex">
                <button type="button" className="btn btn-ghost btn-icon" aria-label="Đưa lên" onClick={() => move(i, -1)}><ArrowUp size={18} aria-hidden="true" /></button>
                <button type="button" className="btn btn-ghost btn-icon" aria-label="Đưa xuống" onClick={() => move(i, 1)}><ArrowDown size={18} aria-hidden="true" /></button>
                <button type="button" className="btn btn-ghost btn-icon text-bad" aria-label={`Xóa thuộc tính ${a.name}`} onClick={() => setT((s) => ({ ...s, attributes: s.attributes.filter((_, j) => j !== i) }))}><Trash2 size={18} aria-hidden="true" /></button>
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </section>

      <div className="admin-savebar">
        <div className="admin-savebar-inner">
          {t.id ? (
            inUse ? <span className="text-sm text-muted">Không xóa được: đang có {inUse} sản phẩm</span> : (
              <ActionButton action={deleteProductType.bind(null, t.id)} className="btn btn-danger-outline" onDone={() => router.push('/admin/loai-san-pham')}
                confirm={{ title: `Xóa loại "${t.name}"?`, text: 'Thuộc tính của loại này cũng bị xóa.', confirmLabel: 'Xóa loại', danger: true }}>Xóa</ActionButton>
            )
          ) : null}
          <span role="status" className="min-w-0 flex-1 text-sm">{msg ? <span className={msg.ok ? 'text-ok' : 'text-bad'}>{msg.text}</span> : null}</span>
          <Link href="/admin/loai-san-pham" className="btn btn-ghost">Hủy</Link>
          <button type="submit" className="btn btn-primary" disabled={pending}>{pending ? <Loader2 size={16} className="animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" /> : null}Lưu loại sản phẩm</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </form>
  )
}

export function Tabs({ items }: { items: { href: string; label: string; count?: number; on: boolean }[] }) {

}
export function Pager({ page, pages, href, count, pageSize = 20 }: { page: number; pages: number; href: (p: number) => string; count?: number; pageSize?: number }) {
  const n = Math.max(1,pages)
  const slots = [...new Set([1,page-1,page,page+1,n])].filter((p) => p > 0 && p <= n).sort((a,b) => a-b)
  return <nav className="admin-pager" aria-label="Phân trang"><span>{count === undefined ? `Trang ${page} / ${n}` : count === 0 ? '0 kết quả' : `${Math.min((page-1)*pageSize+1,count)}–${Math.min(page*pageSize,count)} / ${new Intl.NumberFormat('vi-VN').format(count)} kết quả`}</span>{n > 1 ? <div className="admin-pager-pages">{page > 1 ? <Link href={href(page-1)} aria-label="Trang trước"><ChevronLeft size={17} aria-hidden="true" /></Link> : null}{slots.map((p,i) => <span key={p} className="!p-0">{i > 0 && p > slots[i-1]! + 1 ? <span aria-hidden="true">…</span> : null}<Link href={href(p)} aria-current={p === page ? 'page' : undefined} aria-label={`Trang ${p}`}>{p}</Link></span>)}{page < n ? <Link href={href(page+1)} aria-label="Trang sau"><ChevronRight size={17} aria-hidden="true" /></Link> : null}</div> : null}</nav>
}
export function Empty({ title, text, action }: { title: string; text?: string; action?: React.ReactNode }) { return <div className="admin-empty"><span className="admin-empty-icon"><PackageSearch size={26} strokeWidth={1.5} aria-hidden="true" /></span><p className="font-semibold">{title}</p>{text ? <p className="max-w-md text-sm text-muted">{text}</p> : null}{action}</div> }
export function SearchForm({ placeholder, defaultValue, hidden }: { placeholder: string; defaultValue?: string; hidden?: Record<string,string> }) {

export function GoogleButton({ next, label = 'Tiếp tục với Google', disabled }: { next: string; label?: string; disabled?: boolean }) {
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false)
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
      <button
        type="button"
        className="btn btn-secondary btn-lg w-full border-line bg-raised"
        disabled={disabled || pending}
        onClick={async () => {
          setPending(true)
          setError(null)
          const { error } = await createClient().auth.signInWithOAuth({
            provider: 'google',
            options: { redirectTo: `${window.location.origin}/auth/callback?next=${encodeURIComponent(next)}` }
          })
          if (error) {
            setError('Chưa kết nối được Google, vui lòng thử lại.')
            setPending(false)
          }
        }}
      >
        {pending ? <Loader2 size={20} className="animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" /> : G}
        {label}
      </button>
      {error ? <p role="alert" className="text-sm text-bad">{error}</p> : null}
    </div>
  )
}

interface Props {product:{id:string;slug:string;name:string;price:number;thumbnail:string|null;allow_preorder:boolean;purchase_limit:number|null;compare_at_price:number|null;preorder_slots?:number|null};variants:Variant[];options:ProductOption[];isUnique:boolean;trackInventory:boolean;depositPct?:number}
export function AddToCart({product,variants,options,isUnique,trackInventory,depositPct}:Props) {
  const router=useRouter();const lines=useCart();const active=useMemo(()=>variants.filter(v=>v.active),[variants]);const first=active.find(v=>v.stock>0)??active[0]
  const [picked,setPicked]=useState<string[]>(first?.option_values??[]);const [qty,setQty]=useState(1);const [added,setAdded]=useState(false);const [intent,setIntent]=useState<'add'|'buy'|null>(null);const [pending,start]=useTransition();const timer=useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>|null>(null)
  useEffect(()=>()=>{if(timer.current)clearTimeout(timer.current)},[])
  const variant=useMemo(()=>!options.length?active[0]:active.find(v=>options.every((_,j)=>v.option_values[j]===picked[j])),[active,options,picked])
  const price=variant?.price??product.price;const pre=product.allow_preorder;const stock=variant?.stock??0
  const max=pre?Math.min(product.purchase_limit??5,product.preorder_slots??Infinity):isUnique?1:!trackInventory?(product.purchase_limit??99):Math.min(stock,product.purchase_limit??99)
  const safeQty=Math.max(1,Math.min(qty,max));const canBuy=!!variant&&max>0&&(pre||!trackInventory||stock>0)
  function apply(goCheckout:boolean) {
    if(!variant||!canBuy)return
    cart.add({variantId:variant.id,productId:product.id,slug:product.slug,name:product.name,variantTitle:options.length?variant.title:'',price,image:variant.image_url??product.thumbnail,max:Math.max(max,1),isPreorder:pre},safeQty)
    setIntent(null)
    if(goCheckout)start(()=>router.push('/gio-hang'))
    else {setAdded(true);if(timer.current)clearTimeout(timer.current);timer.current=setTimeout(()=>setAdded(false),2400)}
  }
  function request(goCheckout:boolean) {if(!canBuy)return;if(lines.some(l=>l.isPreorder!==pre)){setIntent(goCheckout?'buy':'add');return}apply(goCheckout)}
  return <div className="shop-buybox"><div className="shop-buy-price"><span className="pd-price-label">{pre?'Giá đặt trước':'Giá bán'}</span><strong>{formatVND(price)}</strong>{product.compare_at_price&&product.compare_at_price>price?<><del>{formatVND(product.compare_at_price)}</del><span className="pd-save">-{Math.round((1-price/product.compare_at_price)*100)}% · Tiết kiệm {formatVND(product.compare_at_price-price)}</span></>:null}</div>
    {options.map((o,i)=><fieldset key={o.id}><legend className="label mb-3">{o.name}<span className="ml-2 font-normal text-muted">{picked[i]}</span></legend><div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">{o.values.map(val=>{const exists=active.some(v=>v.option_values[i]===val&&(pre||!trackInventory||v.stock>0));return <button key={val} type="button" className="chip" disabled={!exists} aria-pressed={picked[i]===val} onClick={()=>{setPicked(s=>{const n=[...s];n[i]=val;return n});setAdded(false)}}>{val}</button>})}</div></fieldset>)}
    <p className="text-xs leading-relaxed" aria-live="polite">{!variant?<span className="pill pill-neu">Lựa chọn này chưa có hàng</span>:!canBuy?<span className="pill pill-neu">{pre?'Hết suất đặt trước':'Sản phẩm tạm hết hàng'}</span>:pre?<span className="pill pill-brand">Đặt trước{depositPct?` · Cọc ${depositPct}%`:''}</span>:trackInventory?<span className="pill pill-ok">{isUnique?'Còn 1 món duy nhất':`Còn ${stock} sản phẩm`}</span>:<span className="pill pill-ok">Có thể đặt hàng</span>}</p>
    {max>1?<div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3"><span className="label">Số lượng</span><div className="shop-quantity" role="group" aria-label="Số lượng sản phẩm"><button type="button" className="btn btn-ghost btn-icon" disabled={safeQty<=1} aria-label="Giảm số lượng" onClick={()=>setQty(Math.max(1,safeQty-1))}><Minus size={17} aria-hidden="true"/></button><input inputMode="numeric" aria-label="Số lượng" value={safeQty} onChange={e=>setQty(Math.max(1,Math.min(max,Number(e.target.value.replace(/\D/g,''))||1)))}/><button type="button" className="btn btn-ghost btn-icon" disabled={safeQty>=max} aria-label="Tăng số lượng" onClick={()=>setQty(Math.min(max,safeQty+1))}><Plus size={17} aria-hidden="true"/></button></div></div>:null}
    <div className="shop-buy-actions"><button type="button" className="btn btn-secondary btn-lg" disabled={!canBuy||pending} onClick={()=>request(false)}>{added?<Check size={17} aria-hidden="true"/>:<ShoppingBag size={17} aria-hidden="true"/>}{added?'Đã thêm vào giỏ':'Thêm vào giỏ'}</button><button type="button" className="btn btn-primary btn-lg" disabled={!canBuy||pending} onClick={()=>request(true)}>{pending?<Loader2 size={17} className="animate-spin" aria-hidden="true"/>:null}{pre?'Đặt trước ngay':'Mua ngay'}<ArrowRight size={16} aria-hidden="true"/></button></div>
    <div role="status" aria-live="polite">{added?<p className="shop-buy-feedback">Đã thêm {safeQty} sản phẩm. <Link href="/gio-hang" className="font-semibold underline underline-offset-4">Xem giỏ hàng</Link></p>:null}</div>
    {pre?<p className="text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-muted">Hàng đặt trước được tạo đơn riêng. Số tiền cọc chính xác hiển thị sau khi tạo đơn.</p>:null}
    <div className="shop-buy-mobile"><span><small>{pre?'Giá sản phẩm đặt trước':'Giá sản phẩm'}</small><strong>{formatVND(price)}</strong></span><button type="button" className="btn btn-secondary btn-icon" disabled={!canBuy||pending} aria-label="Thêm sản phẩm vào giỏ" onClick={()=>request(false)}>{added?<Check size={19} aria-hidden="true"/>:<ShoppingBag size={19} aria-hidden="true"/>}</button><button type="button" className="btn btn-primary" disabled={!canBuy||pending} onClick={()=>request(true)}>{pending?'Đang mở…':pre?'Đặt trước':'Mua ngay'}</button></div>
    <ShopDialog open={intent!==null} onClose={()=>setIntent(null)} title="Tạo giỏ hàng riêng?" description="Hàng có sẵn và hàng đặt trước cần tạo đơn riêng. Nếu tiếp tục, những món trong giỏ hiện tại sẽ được thay thế." actions={<><button type="button" className="btn btn-secondary" onClick={()=>setIntent(null)}>Giữ giỏ hiện tại</button><button type="button" className="btn btn-primary" onClick={()=>apply(intent==='buy')}>Thay giỏ hàng</button></>}><p className="text-sm text-muted">Bạn có thể hoàn tất giỏ hiện tại trước rồi quay lại đặt sản phẩm này.</p></ShopDialog>
  </div>
}

'use client'

import { useEffect, useRef, type ReactNode } from 'react'

export function AnimeClientShell({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const root = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  useEffect(() => {
    const element = root.current
    if (!element) return
    let disposed = false
    let cleanup: (() => void) | undefined
    void import('@/features/home/animation/smooth-scroll').then(({ mountHomeSmoothScroll }) => {
      if (!disposed) cleanup = mountHomeSmoothScroll(element, true)
    }).catch(() => {
      if (!disposed) element.dataset.homeScroll = 'native'
    })
    return () => { disposed = true; cleanup?.() }
  }, [])
  return <div ref={root} className="shop-ui shop-v13">{children}</div>
}

'use client'
import Image from 'next/image'
import Link from 'next/link'
import { useState } from 'react'
export function ShopBrand() {
  const [fallback,setFallback]=useState(false)
  return <Link href="/" className="shop-brand" aria-label="Dark Poke, về trang chủ">{fallback?<><span className="shop-brand-mark" aria-hidden="true"/>Dark Poke.</>:<Image src="/logo.png" alt="Dark Poke" width={433} height={112} priority onError={()=>setFallback(true)}/>}</Link>
}

'use client'
import Link from 'next/link'
import { ArrowLeft,ArrowRight,Minus,Plus,ShieldCheck,ShoppingBag,Trash2 } from 'lucide-react'
import { ProductImage } from '@/components/shop/product-image'
import { cart,cartCount,cartSubtotal,useCart } from '@/lib/cart'
import { formatVND } from '@/lib/utils'
export function CartView() {
  const lines=useCart();const subtotal=cartSubtotal(lines);const pre=lines.some(l=>l.isPreorder)
  if(!lines.length)return <div className="shop-empty"><span className="shop-empty-icon"><ShoppingBag size={29} strokeWidth={1.5} aria-hidden="true"/></span><h2>Chưa có mảnh ghép nào trong giỏ</h2><p>Khám phá sản phẩm mới và chọn những món dành riêng cho bộ sưu tập của bạn.</p><Link href="/san-pham" className="btn btn-primary mt-2">Bắt đầu khám phá<ArrowRight size={16} aria-hidden="true"/></Link></div>
  return <div className="shop-cart-layout"><div><div className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs text-muted"><span>{cartCount(lines)} sản phẩm trong giỏ</span>{pre?<span className="pill pill-brand">Giỏ hàng đặt trước</span>:<span>Hàng có sẵn</span>}</div><ul className="shop-cart-list">{lines.map(l=><li key={l.variantId} className="shop-cart-item"><Link href={`/san-pham/${l.slug}`} className="shop-cart-image"><ProductImage src={l.image} alt={l.name} sizes="86px"/></Link><div className="shop-cart-item-main"><Link href={`/san-pham/${l.slug}`}>{l.name}</Link>{l.variantTitle?<span className="text-[11px] text-muted">{l.variantTitle}</span>:null}<span className="text-[11px] text-muted">{formatVND(l.price)} / sản phẩm</span><div className="shop-cart-item-bottom">{l.max>1?<div className="shop-quantity" role="group" aria-label={`Số lượng ${l.name}`}><button type="button" className="btn btn-ghost btn-icon" aria-label={`Giảm số lượng ${l.name}`} disabled={l.qty<=1} onClick={()=>cart.setQty(l.variantId,l.qty-1)}><Minus size={15} aria-hidden="true"/></button><input inputMode="numeric" aria-label={`Số lượng ${l.name}`} value={l.qty} onChange={e=>cart.setQty(l.variantId,Number(e.target.value.replace(/\D/g,''))||1)}/><button type="button" className="btn btn-ghost btn-icon" aria-label={`Tăng số lượng ${l.name}`} disabled={l.qty>=l.max} onClick={()=>cart.setQty(l.variantId,l.qty+1)}><Plus size={15} aria-hidden="true"/></button></div>:<span className="text-xs text-muted">Số lượng: {l.qty}</span>}<strong className="text-base font-semibold tabular-nums">{formatVND(l.price*l.qty)}</strong></div></div><button type="button" className="btn btn-ghost btn-icon text-muted" aria-label={`Xóa ${l.name} khỏi giỏ`} onClick={()=>cart.remove(l.variantId)}><Trash2 size={17} aria-hidden="true"/></button></li>)}</ul><Link href="/san-pham" className="shop-section-link mt-5"><ArrowLeft size={15} aria-hidden="true"/>Tiếp tục khám phá sản phẩm</Link></div><aside className="shop-summary"><h2>Tóm tắt giỏ hàng</h2><dl className="flex flex-col gap-4"><div className="shop-summary-row"><dt>Tiền hàng</dt><dd>{formatVND(subtotal)}</dd></div><div className="shop-summary-row"><dt>Vận chuyển</dt><dd className="!text-xs !font-normal text-muted">Tính ở bước tiếp theo</dd></div><div className="shop-summary-row shop-summary-total"><dt>Tạm tính</dt><dd>{formatVND(subtotal)}</dd></div></dl>{pre?<p className="rounded-xl bg-brand-subtle p-3 text-xs leading-relaxed text-brand-ink">Đơn đặt trước chỉ cần chuyển tiền cọc. Số tiền cụ thể hiển thị sau khi bạn tạo đơn.</p>:null}<Link href="/thanh-toan" className="btn btn-primary btn-lg w-full">Tiếp tục đặt hàng<ArrowRight size={17} aria-hidden="true"/></Link><p className="flex items-start gap-2 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-muted"><ShieldCheck size={15} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" aria-hidden="true"/>Chưa thu tiền ở bước này. Bạn sẽ nhận mã VietQR sau khi xác nhận đơn.</p></aside></div>
}

import type { ReactNode } from 'react'
import Link from 'next/link'
import { Filters } from '@/components/shop/filters'
import { ProductGrid } from '@/components/shop/product-grid'
import { getCatalogMeta, getSettings, listProducts, type ProductQuery } from '@/lib/catalog'
import { queryString } from '@/lib/query'
import '@/components/shop/catalog-v14.css'

interface Props { basePath: string; query: ProductQuery; title: string; subtitle?: string; showTypes?: boolean; autoFocus?: boolean; crumbs?: ReactNode }

/** V14.21 catalog page (Tất cả sản phẩm, danh mục, pre-order), design option A: compact light header, one toolbar, underlined tabs. */
export async function CatalogView({ basePath, query, title, subtitle, showTypes, autoFocus, crumbs }: Props) {
  const [meta, settings, first] = await Promise.all([getCatalogMeta(), getSettings(), listProducts({ ...query, limit: 12 })])
  const names = Object.fromEntries(meta.types.map((t) => [t.id, t.name]))
  const qs = queryString(query)
  const count = first.nextCursor ? `${first.items.length}+` : String(first.items.length)

  return <div className="shop-container ct">
    <div className="ct-crumbs">{crumbs ?? <nav className="shop-breadcrumb" aria-label="Đường dẫn"><Link href="/">Trang chủ</Link><span aria-hidden="true">/</span><span aria-current="page">{title}</span></nav>}</div>
    <header className="ct-head">
      <div className="ct-copy">
        <h1 className="ct-title">{title}</h1>
        <p className="ct-sub">{subtitle ?? 'Sealed, thẻ lẻ, thẻ grading và phụ kiện cho bộ sưu tập của bạn.'}</p>
      </div>
      <p className="ct-count"><b>{count}</b> sản phẩm</p>
    </header>
    <Filters key={`filters:${qs}`} basePath={basePath} query={query} types={meta.types} attributes={meta.attributes} showTypes={showTypes} autoFocus={autoFocus} preorderLink={settings.modules.preorder && !query.preorder} />
    <ProductGrid key={`products:${qs}`} query={qs} initial={first} typeNames={names} />
  </div>
}

import { ArrowRight, Landmark, Loader2, ShieldCheck, ShoppingBag } from 'lucide-react'
import { ProductImage } from '@/components/shop/product-image'
import { placeOrder } from '@/lib/actions/checkout'
import { cart, cartSubtotal, useCart } from '@/lib/cart'
import { PROVINCES } from '@/lib/labels'
import { formatVND, unaccent } from '@/lib/utils'
import type { ShopSettings } from '@/lib/types'

interface Props {
  settings: Pick<ShopSettings, 'shipping' | 'rules'>
  defaults: { name: string; email: string }
}

export function CheckoutForm({ settings, defaults }: Props) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const lines = useCart()
  const [pending, start] = useTransition()
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [f, setF] = useState({ name: defaults.name, phone: '', email: defaults.email, province: 'TP. Hồ Chí Minh', address: '', note: '' })
  const [fulfillment, setFulfillment] = useState<'delivery' | 'pickup'>('delivery')
  const [touched, setTouched] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({})

  const subtotal = cartSubtotal(lines)
  const pre = lines.some((l) => l.isPreorder)
  const isHcm = unaccent(f.province.toLowerCase()).includes('ho chi minh')
  let ship = fulfillment === 'pickup' ? settings.shipping.pickup : isHcm ? settings.shipping.hcm : settings.shipping.other
  if (settings.shipping.free_over && subtotal >= settings.shipping.free_over) ship = 0
  const total = subtotal + ship

  const errors = {
    name: f.name.trim().length < 2 ? 'Vui lòng nhập họ tên' : '',
    phone: /^(0|\+84)[0-9]{9,10}$/.test(f.phone.replace(/[\s.]/g, '')) ? '' : 'Số điện thoại chưa đúng, ví dụ 0901234567',
    email: f.email && !/^\S+@\S+\.\S+$/.test(f.email) ? 'Email chưa đúng' : '',
    address: fulfillment === 'delivery' && f.address.trim().length < 5 ? 'Vui lòng nhập số nhà, đường, phường' : ''
  }
  const show = (k: keyof typeof errors) => (touched[k] ? errors[k] : '')
  const set = (k: keyof typeof f) => (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement | HTMLSelectElement | HTMLTextAreaElement>) => setF((s) => ({ ...s, [k]: e.target.value }))

  if (!lines.length) {
    return (
      <div className="shop-empty">
        <span className="shop-empty-icon"><ShoppingBag size={28} aria-hidden="true" /></span><h2>Giỏ hàng đang trống</h2><p>Thêm một vài sản phẩm trước khi bắt đầu đặt hàng.</p>
        <Link href="/san-pham" className="btn btn-primary">Xem sản phẩm</Link>
      </div>
    )
  }

  function submit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault()
    setTouched({ name: true, phone: true, email: true, address: true })
    if (Object.values(errors).some(Boolean)) { const first=Object.keys(errors).find(k=>errors[k as keyof typeof errors]); document.getElementById(`checkout-${first}`)?.focus(); return }
    setError(null)
    start(async () => {
      try {
      const res = await placeOrder({
        items: lines.map((l) => ({ variant_id: l.variantId, qty: l.qty })),
        customer: { name: f.name.trim(), phone: f.phone.replace(/[\s.]/g, ''), email: f.email.trim(), province: fulfillment === 'delivery' ? f.province : '', address: fulfillment === 'delivery' ? f.address.trim() : '' },
        fulfillment,
        note: f.note
      })
      if (!res.ok) {
        setError(res.error)
        return
      }
      cart.clear()
      router.replace(res.data?.url ?? '/tai-khoan')
      } catch {setError('Chưa nhận được xác nhận. Giữ nguyên giỏ hàng, kiểm tra Đơn hàng của tôi trước khi thử lại để tránh tạo trùng đơn.')}
    })
  }

  return (
    <form onSubmit={submit} noValidate className="shop-checkout-layout">
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
        <section className="shop-surface-card">
          <div className="shop-form-title"><span>1</span><h2>Thông tin liên hệ</h2></div>
          <div className="grid gap-5 sm:grid-cols-2">
            <Field label="Họ và tên" error={show('name')}>
              <input id="checkout-name" className="input" autoComplete="name" value={f.name} onChange={set('name')} onBlur={() => setTouched((t) => ({ ...t, name: true }))} aria-invalid={!!show('name')} />
            </Field>
            <Field label="Số điện thoại" hint="Shop gọi xác nhận đơn qua số này." error={show('phone')}>
              <input id="checkout-phone" className="input" type="tel" inputMode="tel" autoComplete="tel" placeholder="0901 234 567" value={f.phone} onChange={set('phone')} onBlur={() => setTouched((t) => ({ ...t, phone: true }))} aria-invalid={!!show('phone')} />
            </Field>
            <Field label="Email (không bắt buộc)" error={show('email')} className="sm:col-span-2">
              <input id="checkout-email" className="input" type="email" autoComplete="email" placeholder="ten@email.com" value={f.email} onChange={set('email')} onBlur={() => setTouched((t) => ({ ...t, email: true }))} />
            </Field>
          </div>
        </section>

        <section className="shop-surface-card">
          <div className="shop-form-title"><span>2</span><h2>Bạn muốn nhận hàng thế nào?</h2></div>
          <div className="mb-5 grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
            {([['delivery', 'Giao tận nơi', 'Nhận hàng tại địa chỉ bạn cung cấp'], ['pickup', 'Nhận tại cửa hàng', `${settings.shipping.pickup ? formatVND(settings.shipping.pickup) : 'Miễn phí'}, giữ hàng ${settings.shipping.pickup_hold_days} ngày`]] as const).map(([v, t, d]) => (
              <label key={v} className="shop-choice">
                <input type="radio" name="fulfillment" className="mt-1 size-5 accent-[var(--color-brand)]" checked={fulfillment === v} onChange={() => setFulfillment(v)} />
                <span><b>{t}</b><small>{d}</small></span>
              </label>
            ))}
          </div>
          {fulfillment === 'delivery' ? (
            <div className="grid gap-5 sm:grid-cols-2">
              <Field label="Tỉnh, thành phố">
                <select className="input" value={f.province} onChange={set('province')} autoComplete="address-level1">
                  {PROVINCES.map((p) => <option key={p}>{p}</option>)}
                </select>
              </Field>
              <Field label="Địa chỉ" error={show('address')}>
                <input id="checkout-address" className="input" autoComplete="street-address" placeholder="Số nhà, đường, phường" value={f.address} onChange={set('address')} onBlur={() => setTouched((t) => ({ ...t, address: true }))} aria-invalid={!!show('address')} />
              </Field>
            </div>
          ) : null}
          <Field label="Ghi chú (không bắt buộc)">
            <textarea className="input" rows={2} value={f.note} onChange={set('note')} placeholder="Ví dụ: giao giờ hành chính" />
          </Field>
        </section>

        <section className="shop-surface-card">
          <div className="shop-form-title"><span>3</span><h2>Phương thức thanh toán</h2></div>
          <div className="flex gap-3 rounded-xl border border-[#b9cbfc] bg-[#f5f8ff] p-4">
            <Landmark size={22} className="mt-0.5 flex-none text-brand" aria-hidden="true" />
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
              <span className="font-semibold">Chuyển khoản ngân hàng (VietQR)</span>
              <span className="text-sm text-muted">Sau khi đặt, bạn sẽ thấy mã QR và nội dung chuyển khoản. Đơn tự hủy nếu chưa chuyển sau {settings.rules.unpaid_cancel_hours} giờ.</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>
      </div>

      <aside className="shop-summary">
        <h2 className="h-card">Đơn hàng của bạn</h2>
        <ul className="flex flex-col gap-3">
          {lines.map((l) => (
            <li key={l.variantId} className="shop-summary-item">
              <span className="w-11 overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-line"><ProductImage src={l.image} alt={l.name} sizes="56px" /></span>

                <span className="line-clamp-2 text-xs font-semibold">{l.name}</span>

function Field({ label, hint, error, children, className }: { label: string; hint?: string; error?: string; children: React.ReactNode; className?: string }) {

  )
}

'use client'
import { useState } from 'react'
import { Check, Copy } from 'lucide-react'

export function CopyButton({ value, label }: { value: string; label: string }) {
  const [done, setDone] = useState(false)
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      className="btn btn-ghost btn-icon flex-none text-brand"
      aria-label={done ? `Đã sao chép ${label}` : `Sao chép ${label}`}
      title={done ? 'Đã sao chép' : 'Sao chép'}
      onClick={async () => {
        try {
          await navigator.clipboard.writeText(value)
        } catch {
          const t = document.createElement('textarea')
          t.value = value
          document.body.appendChild(t)
          t.select()
          document.execCommand('copy')
          t.remove()
        }
        setDone(true)
        setTimeout(() => setDone(false), 1500)
      }}
    >
      {done ? <Check size={18} aria-hidden="true" /> : <Copy size={18} aria-hidden="true" />}
    </button>
  )
}

'use client'
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'

function fmt(ms: number) {
  const s = Math.max(0, Math.floor(ms / 1000))
  const h = Math.floor(s / 3600)
  const m = Math.floor((s % 3600) / 60)
  const ss = s % 60
  return [h, m, ss].map((n) => String(n).padStart(2, '0')).join(':')
}

/** Đồng hồ giữ đơn. Render rỗng ở server để không lệch giờ khi hydrate. */
export function Countdown({ until }: { until: string }) {
  const [now, setNow] = useState<number | null>(null)
  useEffect(() => {
    const tick = () => setNow(Date.now())
    const first = setTimeout(tick, 0)
    const t = setInterval(tick, 1000)
    return () => {
      clearTimeout(first)
      clearInterval(t)
    }
  }, [])
  const left = now === null ? null : new Date(until).getTime() - now
  return (
    <span className="price tabular-nums" role="timer" aria-live="off">
      {left === null ? '--:--:--' : left <= 0 ? 'Hết hạn' : fmt(left)}
    </span>
  )
}

'use client'
import { useEffect, useId, useRef } from 'react'
import { X } from 'lucide-react'
export function ShopDialog({open,onClose,title,description,children,actions,drawer=false,wide=false}:{open:boolean;onClose:()=>void;title:string;description?:string;children:React.ReactNode;actions?:React.ReactNode;drawer?:boolean;wide?:boolean}) {
  const ref=useRef<HTMLDialogElement>(null);const id=useId()
  useEffect(()=>{
    const d=ref.current;if(!d)return
    if(open && !d.open)d.showModal()
    if(!open && d.open)d.close()
    if(!open)return
    const previous=document.documentElement.style.overflow;document.documentElement.style.overflow='hidden'
    return()=>{document.documentElement.style.overflow=previous}
  },[open])
  return <dialog ref={ref} className={`shop-dialog ${drawer?'shop-drawer':''} ${wide?'shop-dialog-wide':''}`} aria-labelledby={`${id}-title`} aria-describedby={description?`${id}-description`:undefined} onCancel={(e)=>{e.preventDefault();onClose()}} onClose={onClose} onClick={(e)=>{if(e.target!==e.currentTarget)return;const r=e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();if(e.clientX<r.left||e.clientX>r.right||e.clientY<r.top||e.clientY>r.bottom)onClose()}}><div className="shop-dialog-head"><h2 id={`${id}-title`}>{title}</h2><button type="button" className="btn btn-ghost btn-icon" aria-label="Đóng" onClick={onClose}><X size={21} aria-hidden="true"/></button></div><div className="shop-dialog-body">{description?<p id={`${id}-description`} className="shop-dialog-description">{description}</p>:null}{children}</div>{actions?<div className="shop-dialog-actions">{actions}</div>:null}</dialog>
}

'use client'
import Link from 'next/link'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { useEffect, useRef, useState, useTransition } from 'react'
import { ChevronDown, Loader2, Search, SlidersHorizontal, X } from 'lucide-react'
import { ShopDialog } from '@/components/shop/dialog'
import { queryString } from '@/lib/query'
import type { AttributeDef, ProductType } from '@/lib/types'
import type { ProductQuery } from '@/lib/catalog'

interface Props { basePath: string; query: ProductQuery; types: ProductType[]; attributes: AttributeDef[]; showTypes?: boolean; autoFocus?: boolean; preorderLink?: boolean }

/** V14.21 catalog filters (design option A): one toolbar (search, filters, sort), underlined type tabs, then the active filters. */
export function Filters({ basePath, query, types, attributes, showTypes = true, autoFocus, preorderLink }: Props) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const [pending, start] = useTransition()
  const [q, setQ] = useState(query.q ?? '')
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<ProductQuery>(query)
  const input = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null)
  useEffect(() => { if (autoFocus) input.current?.focus() }, [autoFocus])

  function go(next: Partial<ProductQuery>) {
    const merged = { ...query, ...next }
    if (Object.hasOwn(next, 'type') && next.type !== query.type && !Object.hasOwn(next, 'attrs')) merged.attrs = {}
    merged.attrs = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(merged.attrs ?? {}).filter(([, v]) => !!v))
    const qs = queryString(merged)
    start(() => router.push(qs ? `${basePath}?${qs}` : basePath, { scroll: false }))
  }

  const selectedType = types.find((t) => t.code === draft.type)
  const defs = selectedType ? attributes.filter((a) => a.type_id === selectedType.id && a.filterable && a.options.length) : []
  const attrs = Object.entries(query.attrs ?? {}).filter(([, v]) => !!v)
  const n = attrs.length + (query.inStock ? 1 : 0) + (query.type ? 1 : 0)
  const clear = () => { setQ(''); go({ q: undefined, type: undefined, brand: undefined, collection: undefined, attrs: {}, inStock: false }) }
  const activeType = types.find((t) => t.code === query.type)

  return <div className="shop-filters ctf" aria-busy={pending}>
    <div className="ctf-bar">
      <form role="search" className="ctf-search" onSubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); go({ q: q.trim() || undefined }) }}>
        <Search size={20} aria-hidden="true" />
        <input ref={input} value={q} onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)} type="search" placeholder="Tìm tên thẻ, bộ thẻ, SKU…" aria-label="Tìm trong danh sách sản phẩm" enterKeyHint="search" />
        {q ? <button type="button" className="ctf-clear" aria-label="Xóa từ khóa" onClick={() => { setQ(''); go({ q: undefined }) }}><X size={17} aria-hidden="true" /></button> : null}
        <button type="submit" className="ctf-submit" disabled={pending}>{pending ? <Loader2 size={16} className="animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" /> : 'Tìm'}</button>
      </form>
      <button type="button" className="ctf-btn" disabled={pending} onClick={() => { setDraft(query); setOpen(true) }}>
        <SlidersHorizontal size={18} aria-hidden="true" />Bộ lọc{n ? <span className="ctf-badge">{n}</span> : null}
      </button>
      <label className="ctf-sort">
        <span>Sắp xếp:</span>
        <select value={query.sort ?? 'new'} disabled={pending} onChange={(e) => go({ sort: e.target.value as ProductQuery['sort'] })} aria-label="Sắp xếp sản phẩm">
          <option value="new">Mới nhất</option><option value="price_asc">Giá thấp đến cao</option><option value="price_desc">Giá cao đến thấp</option>
        </select>
        <ChevronDown size={18} aria-hidden="true" />
      </label>
    </div>

    {showTypes ? <div className="ctf-tabs" role="group" aria-label="Loại sản phẩm">
      <button type="button" aria-pressed={!query.type} disabled={pending} onClick={() => go({ type: undefined })}>Tất cả</button>
      {types.map((t) => <button key={t.id} type="button" aria-pressed={query.type === t.code} disabled={pending} onClick={() => go({ type: t.code })}>{t.name}</button>)}
      {preorderLink ? <Link prefetch={false} href="/pre-order" className="ctf-tab-link">Pre-order<span>Mới</span></Link> : null}
    </div> : null}

    {n || query.q ? <div className="ctf-active" aria-label="Bộ lọc đang dùng">
      <span className="ctf-active-label">Đang lọc:</span>
      {query.q ? <button type="button" onClick={() => { setQ(''); go({ q: undefined }) }}>“{query.q}”<X size={14} aria-hidden="true" /><span className="sr-only">Xóa từ khóa</span></button> : null}
      {activeType ? <button type="button" onClick={() => go({ type: undefined })}>{activeType.name}<X size={14} aria-hidden="true" /><span className="sr-only">Bỏ loại sản phẩm</span></button> : null}
      {query.inStock ? <button type="button" onClick={() => go({ inStock: false })}>Còn hàng<X size={14} aria-hidden="true" /><span className="sr-only">Bỏ lọc còn hàng</span></button> : null}
      {attrs.map(([key, value]) => <button key={key} type="button" onClick={() => go({ attrs: { ...query.attrs, [key]: '' } })}>{attributes.find((a) => a.code === key)?.name ?? key}: {value}<X size={14} aria-hidden="true" /></button>)}
      <button type="button" className="ctf-reset" onClick={clear}>Xóa tất cả</button>
    </div> : null}

    <ShopDialog open={open} onClose={() => setOpen(false)} title="Tìm đúng món bạn cần" description="Chọn bộ lọc rồi áp dụng để xem những sản phẩm phù hợp." drawer
      actions={<><button type="button" className="btn btn-secondary" onClick={() => setDraft({ ...draft, type: undefined, attrs: {}, inStock: false })}>Đặt lại</button><button type="button" className="btn btn-primary" onClick={() => { go(draft); setOpen(false) }}>Áp dụng bộ lọc</button></>}>
      <div className="shop-filter-fields">
        {showTypes ? <label><span>Loại sản phẩm</span><select className="input" value={draft.type ?? ''} onChange={(e) => setDraft((s) => ({ ...s, type: e.target.value || undefined, attrs: {} }))}><option value="">Tất cả sản phẩm</option>{types.map((t) => <option key={t.id} value={t.code}>{t.name}</option>)}</select></label> : null}
        <label className="shop-choice !flex-row !items-center"><input type="checkbox" checked={!!draft.inStock} onChange={(e) => setDraft((s) => ({ ...s, inStock: e.target.checked }))} /><span>Chỉ hiện sản phẩm còn hàng</span></label>
        {defs.map((a) => <label key={a.id}><span>{a.name}</span><select className="input" value={draft.attrs?.[a.code] ?? ''} onChange={(e) => setDraft((s) => ({ ...s, attrs: { ...s.attrs, [a.code]: e.target.value } }))}><option value="">Tất cả</option>{a.options.map((o) => <option key={o} value={o}>{o}</option>)}</select></label>)}
        {!defs.length ? <p className="text-xs leading-relaxed text-muted">{draft.type ? 'Loại sản phẩm này chưa có thuộc tính cần lọc thêm.' : 'Chọn loại sản phẩm để xem các bộ lọc như bộ thẻ, tình trạng hoặc độ hiếm.'}</p> : null}
      </div>
    </ShopDialog>
  </div>
}

function contacts(shop: ShopSettings['shop']): Contact[] {
  const valid = (value: string) => !!value && !isPlaceholder(value)
  const list: Contact[] = []
  if (valid(shop.hotline)) list.push({ key: 'hotline', icon: Phone, label: 'Hotline', value: shop.hotline, href: `tel:${shop.hotline.replace(/[^+0-9]/g, '')}` })
  if (valid(shop.zalo)) {
    const digits = shop.zalo.replace(/\D/g, '')
    list.push({ key: 'zalo', icon: MessageCircle, label: 'Zalo', value: shop.zalo, href: digits.length >= 9 ? `https://zalo.me/${digits}` : undefined, external: true })
  }
  if (valid(shop.email)) list.push({ key: 'email', icon: Mail, label: 'Email', value: shop.email, href: `mailto:${shop.email}` })
  if (valid(shop.address)) list.push({ key: 'address', icon: MapPin, label: 'Cửa hàng', value: shop.address, href: `https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=${encodeURIComponent(shop.address)}`, external: true })
  return list
}

function ContactRow({ item }: { item: Contact }) {
  const body = <>
    <span className="dpf-contact-icon" aria-hidden="true"><item.icon size={17} strokeWidth={1.7} /></span>
    <span className="dpf-contact-text"><small>{item.label}</small><span>{item.value}</span></span>
  </>
  if (!item.href) return <li><div className="dpf-contact">{body}</div></li>
  return <li><a className="dpf-contact" href={item.href} {...(item.external ? { target: '_blank', rel: 'noopener noreferrer' } : {})}>{body}</a></li>
}

'use client'
import { useRef, useState, type KeyboardEvent, type PointerEvent } from 'react'
import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, Maximize2 } from 'lucide-react'
import { ProductImage } from '@/components/shop/product-image'
import { ShopDialog } from '@/components/shop/dialog'
import type { ProductImage as Img } from '@/lib/types'

const SWIPE_PX = 40

/** V14.13 product gallery: large stage, side thumbnails on desktop, arrows, keyboard and swipe, zoom dialog. */
export function Gallery({ images, name }: { images: Img[]; name: string }) {
  const [index, setIndex] = useState(0)
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
  const start = useRef<number | null>(null)
  const swiped = useRef(false)
  const list = images.length ? images : [{ id: 'placeholder', url: '', alt: name, product_id: '', sort: 0 }]
  const count = list.length
  const current = list[Math.min(index, count - 1)]
  const go = (delta: number) => setIndex((value) => (value + delta + count) % count)

  const onKey = (event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (count < 2) return
    if (event.key === 'ArrowRight') { event.preventDefault(); go(1) }
    if (event.key === 'ArrowLeft') { event.preventDefault(); go(-1) }
  }
  const onDown = (event: PointerEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => { swiped.current = false; start.current = event.pointerType === 'touch' ? event.clientX : null }
  const onUp = (event: PointerEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
    if (start.current === null || count < 2) return
    const dx = event.clientX - start.current
    start.current = null
    if (Math.abs(dx) > SWIPE_PX) { swiped.current = true; go(dx < 0 ? 1 : -1) }
  }

  const thumbs = count > 1 ? <div className="pd-thumbs" role="group" aria-label="Chọn ảnh sản phẩm">
    {list.map((image, k) => <button key={image.id} type="button" onClick={() => setIndex(k)} aria-label={`Xem ảnh ${k + 1} của ${name}`} aria-pressed={k === index}>
      <ProductImage src={image.url} alt="" sizes="80px" />
    </button>)}
  </div> : null

  return <div className="shop-gallery pd-gallery" data-count={count} onKeyDown={onKey}>
    {thumbs}
    <div className="pd-stage">
      <button type="button" className="pd-stage-main" aria-label={`Mở ảnh lớn của ${name}`} onPointerDown={onDown} onPointerUp={onUp}
        onClick={() => { if (!swiped.current) setOpen(true) }}>
        <ProductImage key={current?.id} src={current?.url || null} alt={current?.alt || name} priority sizes="(max-width:767px) 92vw,(max-width:1199px) 50vw,620px" />
      </button>
      <span className="pd-zoom" aria-hidden="true"><Maximize2 size={16} /></span>
      {count > 1 ? <>
        <button type="button" className="pd-nav pd-nav-prev" aria-label="Ảnh trước" onClick={() => go(-1)}><ChevronLeft size={20} aria-hidden="true" /></button>
        <button type="button" className="pd-nav pd-nav-next" aria-label="Ảnh tiếp theo" onClick={() => go(1)}><ChevronRight size={20} aria-hidden="true" /></button>
        <span className="pd-counter" aria-live="polite">{index + 1} / {count}</span>
      </> : null}
    </div>
    <ShopDialog open={open} onClose={() => setOpen(false)} title="Xem ảnh sản phẩm" description={name} wide>
      <div className="pd-zoom-stage"><ProductImage src={current?.url || null} alt={current?.alt || name} sizes="(max-width:767px) 92vw,760px" className="rounded-xl" /></div>
      {thumbs}
    </ShopDialog>
  </div>
}

'use client'

import dynamic from 'next/dynamic'
import Link from 'next/link'
import { usePathname } from 'next/navigation'
import { Suspense, useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { Search, ShoppingBag, User } from 'lucide-react'
import { ShopBrand } from '@/components/shop/brand'
import { ShopMenu } from '@/components/shop/menu'
import { cartCount, useCart } from '@/lib/cart'
import { HeaderLinks, HeaderLinksFallback } from './header-links'
import type { HeaderLink } from './header-navigation'

/** Routes whose first section is a full-bleed hero drawn beneath the bar. */
const OVERLAY_ROUTES = new Set(['/'])
const SOLID_AFTER_PX = 8

// The palette ships in its own chunk; it is fetched on hover/focus of the search button or on first open.
const loadPalette = () => import('./search-palette')
const SearchPalette = dynamic(() => loadPalette().then((module) => module.SearchPalette), { ssr: false })

const isEditable = (target: EventTarget | null) => target instanceof HTMLElement
  && (target.isContentEditable || /^(INPUT|TEXTAREA|SELECT)$/.test(target.tagName))

interface Props { links: HeaderLink[]; categories: { id: string; name: string; slug: string }[]; demo: boolean }

function useScrolledPast(enabled: boolean) {
  const [scrolled, setScrolled] = useState(false)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!enabled) return
    let frame = 0
    const update = () => { frame = 0; setScrolled(window.scrollY > SOLID_AFTER_PX) }
    const onScroll = () => { if (!frame) frame = requestAnimationFrame(update) }
    frame = requestAnimationFrame(update)
    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true })
    return () => { window.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll); cancelAnimationFrame(frame) }
  }, [enabled])
  return scrolled
}

function CartLink() {
  const count = cartCount(useCart())
  return <Link href="/gio-hang" className="dph-icon dph-cart" aria-label={count ? `Giỏ hàng, ${count} sản phẩm` : 'Giỏ hàng'}>
    <ShoppingBag size={20} strokeWidth={1.7} aria-hidden="true" />
    {count ? <span className="dph-badge" aria-hidden="true">{count > 99 ? '99+' : count}</span> : null}
  </Link>
}

export function HeaderBar({ links, categories, demo }: Props) {
  const pathname = usePathname()
  const overlayRoute = OVERLAY_ROUTES.has(pathname)
  const scrolled = useScrolledPast(overlayRoute)
  const [searchOpen, setSearchOpen] = useState(false)
  const toggle = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null)
  const tone = overlayRoute && !scrolled ? 'overlay' : 'solid'

  const closeSearch = useCallback((restoreFocus: boolean) => {
    setSearchOpen(false)
    if (restoreFocus) requestAnimationFrame(() => toggle.current?.focus())
  }, [])

  // Ctrl/⌘ + K anywhere, or "/" outside a text field, opens the palette.
  useEffect(() => {
    const onKey = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      const combo = (event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey) && event.key.toLowerCase() === 'k'
      const slash = event.key === '/' && !event.metaKey && !event.ctrlKey && !event.altKey && !isEditable(event.target)
      if (!combo && !slash) return
      event.preventDefault()
      setSearchOpen(true)
    }
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey)
    return () => document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey)
  }, [])

  return <header className="shop-header dph-header" data-tone={tone}>
    <div className="dph-inner">
      <div className="dph-menu"><ShopMenu links={links} categories={categories} /></div>
      <div className="dph-brand"><ShopBrand />{demo ? <span className="dph-demo" title="Đang hiển thị dữ liệu mẫu">Demo</span> : null}</div>
      <Suspense fallback={<HeaderLinksFallback links={links} />}><HeaderLinks links={links} /></Suspense>
      <div className="dph-actions">
        <button ref={toggle} type="button" className="dph-icon" aria-label="Tìm kiếm sản phẩm" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-expanded={searchOpen} aria-keyshortcuts="Control+K Meta+K /"
          onPointerEnter={() => void loadPalette()} onFocus={() => void loadPalette()} onClick={() => setSearchOpen(true)}>
          <Search size={20} strokeWidth={1.7} aria-hidden="true" />
        </button>
        <Link href="/tai-khoan" className="dph-icon dph-account" aria-label="Tài khoản và đơn hàng"><User size={20} strokeWidth={1.7} aria-hidden="true" /></Link>
        <CartLink />
      </div>
    </div>

    {searchOpen ? <SearchPalette links={links} onClose={closeSearch} /> : null}
  </header>
}

================
File: src/components/shop/header-navigation.ts

export interface HeaderLink { href: string; label: string }

export function currentHeaderHref(pathname: string, params: Pick<URLSearchParams, 'get'>, links: HeaderLink[]) {
  if (pathname === '/san-pham') {
    const type = params.get('type')
    const href = type ? `/san-pham?type=${encodeURIComponent(type)}` : '/san-pham'
    return links.some(link => link.href === href) ? href : null
  }
  if (pathname.startsWith('/san-pham/') || pathname.startsWith('/danh-muc/')) return '/san-pham'
  if (pathname === '/thu-vien-the' || pathname.startsWith('/thu-vien-the/')) return '/thu-vien-the'
  return links.find(link => link.href === pathname)?.href ?? null
}

import { HeaderBar } from '@/components/shop/header-bar'
import type { HeaderLink } from '@/components/shop/header-navigation'
import { isDemo } from '@/lib/env'
import type { Category, ShopSettings } from '@/lib/types'
import './header-v14.css'

/** Server entry: builds links from settings, the compact bar is a small client island. */
export function SiteHeader({ categories, modules }: { categories: Category[]; modules: ShopSettings['modules'] }) {
  const shopLinks: HeaderLink[] = [
    { href: '/san-pham', label: 'Sản phẩm' },
    { href: '/san-pham?type=sealed', label: 'Sealed' },
    { href: '/san-pham?type=the-le', label: 'Thẻ lẻ' },
    { href: '/san-pham?type=the-grading', label: 'Grading' },
    { href: '/san-pham?type=phu-kien', label: 'Phụ kiện' },
    ...(modules.preorder ? [{ href: '/pre-order', label: 'Pre-order' }] : []),
    ...(modules.tradein ? [{ href: '/thu-mua', label: 'Thu mua' }] : [])
  ]
  const navLinks = [...shopLinks, { href: '/thu-vien-the', label: 'Thư viện thẻ' }]
  const roots = categories.filter((c) => !c.parent_id && c.visible).map((c) => ({ id: c.id, name: c.name, slug: c.slug }))
  return <HeaderBar links={navLinks} categories={roots} demo={isDemo} />
}

'use client'
import { useRef, useState, useTransition } from 'react'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { Loader2, Upload } from 'lucide-react'
import { confirmTransfer, uploadProof } from '@/lib/actions/checkout'

export function ConfirmTransferButton({ code, token, confirmed }: { code: string; token: string; confirmed: boolean }) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const [pending, start] = useTransition()
  const [msg, setMsg] = useState<{ ok: boolean; text: string } | null>(null)
  if (confirmed) {
    return <p className="rounded-lg bg-brand-subtle p-3 text-center text-sm font-semibold text-brand-ink">Bạn đã báo chuyển khoản. Shop đang đối soát.</p>
  }
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
      <button
        type="button"
        className="btn btn-primary btn-lg w-full"
        disabled={pending}
        onClick={() =>
          start(async () => {
            const r = await confirmTransfer(code, token)
            setMsg(r.ok ? { ok: true, text: r.message ?? 'Đã ghi nhận' } : { ok: false, text: r.error })
            if (r.ok) router.refresh()
          })
        }
      >
        {pending ? <Loader2 size={18} className="animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" /> : null}
        Tôi đã chuyển khoản
      </button>
      {msg ? <p role="status" className={`text-sm ${msg.ok ? 'text-ok' : 'text-bad'}`}>{msg.text}</p> : null}
    </div>
  )
}

export function ProofUpload({ code, token, hasProof }: { code: string; token: string; hasProof: boolean }) {
  const input = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null)
  const [pending, start] = useTransition()
  const [msg, setMsg] = useState<{ ok: boolean; text: string } | null>(hasProof ? { ok: true, text: 'Shop đã nhận ảnh chuyển khoản của bạn.' } : null)
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4">
      <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-[1_1_260px] flex-col">
        <span className="font-semibold">Ảnh chuyển khoản</span>
        <span className="text-sm text-muted">Tải lên ảnh chụp màn hình để shop xác minh nhanh hơn. Không bắt buộc.</span>
        {msg ? <span role="status" className={`mt-1 text-sm ${msg.ok ? 'text-ok' : 'text-bad'}`}>{msg.text}</span> : null}
      </div>
      <input
        ref={input}
        type="file"
        accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp,image/heic"
        className="sr-only"
        aria-label="Chọn ảnh chuyển khoản"
        onChange={(e) => {
          const file = e.target.files?.[0]
          if (!file) return
          const fd = new FormData()
          fd.set('code', code)
          fd.set('token', token)
          fd.set('file', file)
          start(async () => {
            const r = await uploadProof(fd)
            setMsg(r.ok ? { ok: true, text: r.message ?? 'Đã tải lên' } : { ok: false, text: r.error })
          })
        }}
      />
      <button type="button" className="btn btn-secondary" disabled={pending} onClick={() => input.current?.click()}>
        {pending ? <Loader2 size={18} className="animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" /> : <Upload size={18} aria-hidden="true" />}
        Tải ảnh lên
      </button>
    </div>
  )
}

import Link from 'next/link'
import { ArrowUpRight } from 'lucide-react'
import { ProductImage } from '@/components/shop/product-image'
import { formatDate,priceRange,formatVND } from '@/lib/utils'
import type { ProductCard as Card } from '@/lib/types'
import './product-card-v14.css'

type Tone = 'ok' | 'warn' | 'neu' | 'brand'
const LOW_STOCK = 3

/** Status line under the price: what a shopper most needs to know before opening the product. */
function status(p: Card, soldOut: boolean): { text: string; tone: Tone } {
  if (p.allow_preorder) return { text: p.preorder_release_date ? `Dự kiến ${formatDate(p.preorder_release_date)}` : 'Nhận đặt trước', tone: 'brand' }
  if (soldOut) return { text: 'Hết hàng', tone: 'neu' }
  if (p.variant_count > 1) return { text: `${p.variant_count} lựa chọn`, tone: 'ok' }
  if (p.stock_total <= LOW_STOCK) return { text: `Chỉ còn ${p.stock_total}`, tone: 'warn' }
  return { text: 'Còn hàng', tone: 'ok' }
}

/** V14.11 product card: larger image, readable name and price, honest stock line. */
export function ProductCard({p,typeName,priority,className}:{p:Card;typeName?:string;priority?:boolean;className?:string}) {
  const soldOut=p.stock_total<=0&&!p.allow_preorder
  const sale=p.variant_count<=1&&!!p.compare_at_price&&p.compare_at_price>p.price
  const off=sale&&p.compare_at_price?Math.round((1-p.price/p.compare_at_price)*100):0
  const line=status(p,soldOut)
  return <Link href={`/san-pham/${p.slug}`} className={`shop-product-card pc ${className??''}`} data-soldout={soldOut||undefined}>
    <span className="pc-media">
      <ProductImage src={p.thumbnail} alt={p.name} priority={priority} className="product-image" sizes="(max-width:639px) 60vw,(max-width:1099px) 34vw,300px"/>

    </span>
    <span className="pc-body">
      {typeName?<span className="pc-type">{typeName}</span>:null}
      <span className="pc-name">{p.name}</span>
      <span className="pc-price"><strong>{priceRange(p)}</strong>{sale?<><del>{formatVND(p.compare_at_price)}</del>{off>0?<span className="pc-off">-{off}%</span>:null}</>:null}</span>
      <span className="pc-foot"><span className="pc-status" data-tone={line.tone}>{line.text}</span><span className="pc-arrow" aria-hidden="true"><ArrowUpRight size={17}/></span></span>
    </span>
  </Link>
}

'use client'
import Link from 'next/link'
import { useEffect,useRef } from 'react'
import { useInfiniteQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { ArrowDown,Loader2,PackageSearch } from 'lucide-react'
import { ProductCard,ProductCardSkeleton,GRID } from '@/components/shop/product-card'
import type { ProductPage } from '@/lib/catalog'
interface Props {query:string;initial:ProductPage;typeNames:Record<string,string>;emptyText?:string}
export function ProductGrid({query,initial,typeNames,emptyText='Thử đổi từ khóa hoặc bỏ bớt bộ lọc để khám phá thêm sản phẩm.'}:Props) {
  const sentinel=useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const {data,fetchNextPage,hasNextPage,isFetchingNextPage,isError,refetch}=useInfiniteQuery({queryKey:['products',query],queryFn:async({pageParam})=>{const qs=new URLSearchParams(query);if(pageParam)qs.set('cursor',pageParam);const res=await fetch(`/api/products?${qs}`);if(!res.ok)throw new Error('load_failed');return await res.json() as ProductPage},initialPageParam:null as string|null,getNextPageParam:last=>last.nextCursor,initialData:{pages:[initial],pageParams:[null]},staleTime:60_000})
  useEffect(()=>{const el=sentinel.current;if(!el||!hasNextPage||isError||!('IntersectionObserver'in window))return;const io=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>{if(entries.some(e=>e.isIntersecting)&&!isFetchingNextPage)void fetchNextPage()},{rootMargin:'360px 0px'});io.observe(el);return()=>io.disconnect()},[hasNextPage,isFetchingNextPage,isError,fetchNextPage])
  const items=[...new Map(data.pages.flatMap(p=>p.items).map(p=>[p.id,p])).values()]
  if(!items.length)return <div className="shop-empty"><span className="shop-empty-icon"><PackageSearch size={30} strokeWidth={1.5} aria-hidden="true"/></span><h2>Chưa tìm thấy sản phẩm phù hợp</h2><p>{emptyText}</p><Link href="/san-pham" className="btn btn-primary mt-2">Khám phá tất cả sản phẩm</Link></div>
  return <div><div className={GRID}>{items.map((p,i)=><ProductCard key={p.id} p={p} typeName={typeNames[p.type_id]} priority={i<2} className={i>=initial.items.length?'card-in':undefined}/>)}{isFetchingNextPage?Array.from({length:4},(_,i)=><ProductCardSkeleton key={`s${i}`}/>):null}</div><div ref={sentinel} className="h-px" aria-hidden="true"/><div className="shop-grid-footer" aria-live="polite">{isError?<><p>Chưa tải được phần tiếp theo. Các sản phẩm đã xem vẫn được giữ.</p><button type="button" className="btn btn-secondary" onClick={()=>void(hasNextPage?fetchNextPage():refetch())}>Thử tải lại</button></>:hasNextPage?<button type="button" className="btn btn-secondary" disabled={isFetchingNextPage} onClick={()=>void fetchNextPage()}>{isFetchingNextPage?<Loader2 size={16} className="animate-spin" aria-hidden="true"/>:<ArrowDown size={16} aria-hidden="true"/>}{isFetchingNextPage?'Đang tải thêm…':'Xem thêm sản phẩm'}</button>:<p>Bạn đã xem tất cả {items.length} sản phẩm phù hợp.</p>}</div></div>
}

File: src/components/shop/product-image.tsx

import Image from 'next/image'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

interface Props {
  src: string | null | undefined
  alt: string
  sizes?: string
  priority?: boolean
  className?: string
}

const SUPABASE_HOST = (() => {
  try {
    return process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL ? new URL(process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL).hostname.toLowerCase() : ''
  } catch {
    return ''
  }
})()

/** Tên miền ảnh ngoài được tối ưu qua next/image, khai báo trong NEXT_PUBLIC_IMAGE_HOSTS (cách nhau bằng dấu phẩy). */
const EXTRA_HOSTS = (process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_IMAGE_HOSTS ?? '')
  .split(',')
  .map((h) => h.trim().toLowerCase())
  .filter(Boolean)

/** Chỉ ảnh trong public/, kho ảnh Supabase hoặc tên miền đã khai báo mới đi qua next/image. Ảnh từ nơi khác hiện bằng <img> thường để không lỗi. */
function canOptimize(src: string) {
  if (src.startsWith('/') && !src.startsWith('//')) return true
  try {
    const u = new URL(src)
    if (u.protocol !== 'https:') return false
    const host = u.hostname.toLowerCase()
    if (SUPABASE_HOST && host === SUPABASE_HOST) return u.pathname.startsWith('/storage/v1/object/public/')
    return EXTRA_HOSTS.includes(host)
  } catch {
    return false
  }
}

/** Ảnh sản phẩm khung vuông, tỷ lệ cố định để không nhảy bố cục. */
export function ProductImage({ src, alt, sizes = '(max-width: 640px) 50vw, (max-width: 1024px) 33vw, 260px', priority, className }: Props) {
  const box = cn('relative block aspect-square overflow-hidden bg-surface', className)
  if (!src) {
    return <span className={cn(box, 'flex items-center justify-center text-xs text-muted')}>Chưa có ảnh</span>
  }
  const isSvg = /\.svg(\?|$)/i.test(src) || src.startsWith('data:')
  if (isSvg || !canOptimize(src)) {
    return (
      <span className={box}>
        {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
        <img
          src={src}
          alt={alt}
          width={400}
          height={400}
          loading={priority ? 'eager' : 'lazy'}
          decoding="async"
          fetchPriority={priority ? 'high' : 'auto'}
          referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
          className="size-full object-cover"
        />
      </span>
    )
  }
  return (
    <span className={box}>
      <Image src={src} alt={alt} fill sizes={sizes} priority={priority} className="object-cover" />
    </span>
  )
}
