'use client'

import Link from 'next/link'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { useEffect, useId, useMemo, useRef, useState, type KeyboardEvent, type ReactNode } from 'react'
import {
  ArrowUpDown, BadgeCheck, BookOpen, CornerDownLeft, LayoutGrid, Loader2, Package, Repeat2, Search, Shield,
  ShoppingBag, Sparkles, Timer, User, WalletCards, X, type LucideIcon
} from 'lucide-react'
import { ProductImage } from '@/components/shop/product-image'
import { priceRange } from '@/lib/utils'
import type { HeaderLink } from './header-navigation'
import './search-palette.css'

const QUICK_SEARCHES = ['Pikachu', 'Charizard', 'Elite Trainer Box', 'Booster Box', 'PSA 10'] as const
const PRODUCT_LIMIT = 6
const DEBOUNCE_MS = 180

interface ProductHit { id: string; name: string; slug: string; price: number; min_price: number | null; max_price: number | null; thumbnail: string | null }
interface Item { id: string; group: string; label: string; href: string; icon?: LucideIcon; hint?: string; product?: ProductHit }
type Status = 'idle' | 'loading' | 'done' | 'error'

function iconFor(href: string): LucideIcon {
  if (href.includes('type=sealed')) return Package
  if (href.includes('type=the-le')) return WalletCards
  if (href.includes('type=the-grading')) return BadgeCheck
  if (href.includes('type=phu-kien')) return Shield
  if (href.startsWith('/pre-order')) return Timer
  if (href.startsWith('/thu-mua')) return Repeat2
  if (href.startsWith('/thu-vien-the')) return BookOpen
  if (href.startsWith('/gio-hang')) return ShoppingBag
  if (href.startsWith('/tai-khoan')) return User
  return LayoutGrid
}

const normalize = (value: string) => value.normalize('NFD').replace(/[̀-ͯ]/g, '').replace(/đ/g, 'd').replace(/Đ/g, 'D').toLowerCase().trim()

function isProductHit(value: unknown): value is ProductHit {
  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') return false
  const item = value as Record<string, unknown>
  return typeof item.id === 'string' && typeof item.name === 'string' && typeof item.slug === 'string' && typeof item.price === 'number'
}

/** Live product search against the existing /api/products endpoint (debounced, abortable). */
function useProductSearch(term: string) {
  const [state, setState] = useState<{ term: string; status: Status; items: ProductHit[] }>({ term: '', status: 'idle', items: [] })
  useEffect(() => {
    if (term.length < 2) return
    const controller = new AbortController()
    const timer = window.setTimeout(async () => {
      setState({ term, status: 'loading', items: [] })
      try {
        const response = await fetch(`/api/products?q=${encodeURIComponent(term)}`, { signal: controller.signal, headers: { Accept: 'application/json' } })
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error('search_failed')
        const body: unknown = await response.json()
        const rows = body && typeof body === 'object' && Array.isArray((body as { items?: unknown }).items) ? (body as { items: unknown[] }).items : []
        setState({ term, status: 'done', items: rows.filter(isProductHit).slice(0, PRODUCT_LIMIT) })
      } catch {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted) setState({ term, status: 'error', items: [] })
      }
    }, DEBOUNCE_MS)
    return () => { controller.abort(); window.clearTimeout(timer) }
  }, [term])
  if (term.length < 2) return { status: 'idle' as Status, items: [] as ProductHit[] }
  return state.term === term ? state : { status: 'loading' as Status, items: [] as ProductHit[] }
}

interface Props { links: HeaderLink[]; onClose: (restoreFocus: boolean) => void }

/** Command palette: navigation, live products and library search in one keyboard-first dialog. */
export function SearchPalette({ links, onClose }: Props) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const id = useId()
  const input = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null)
  const closeButton = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null)
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('')
  const [active, setActive] = useState(0)
  // Rendered only after the user opens it, so navigator is always available here.
  const [mac] = useState(() => typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && /Mac|iPhone|iPad/.test(navigator.platform || navigator.userAgent))

  const pageMode = query.startsWith('/')
  const term = (pageMode ? query.slice(1) : query).trim()
  const products = useProductSearch(pageMode ? '' : term)

  const pages = useMemo<Item[]>(() => [
    ...links,
    { href: '/gio-hang', label: 'Giỏ hàng' },
    { href: '/tai-khoan', label: 'Tài khoản & đơn hàng' }
  ].map((link) => ({ id: `page:${link.href}`, group: 'Điều hướng', label: `Đến ${link.label}`, href: link.href, icon: iconFor(link.href) })), [links])

  const items = useMemo<Item[]>(() => {
    const needle = normalize(term)
    const matchedPages = needle ? pages.filter((page) => normalize(page.label).includes(needle)) : pages
    if (pageMode) return matchedPages
    if (!term) return [
      ...pages,
      ...QUICK_SEARCHES.map((word) => ({ id: `quick:${word}`, group: 'Tìm nhanh', label: word, href: `/san-pham?q=${encodeURIComponent(word)}`, icon: Sparkles }))
    ]
    const encoded = encodeURIComponent(term)
    return [
      ...products.items.map((product) => ({ id: `product:${product.id}`, group: 'Sản phẩm', label: product.name, href: `/san-pham/${product.slug}`, product })),
      { id: 'action:products', group: 'Tìm kiếm', label: `Tìm “${term}” trong tất cả sản phẩm`, href: `/san-pham?q=${encoded}`, icon: Search },
      { id: 'action:library', group: 'Tìm kiếm', label: `Tra cứu “${term}” trong thư viện thẻ`, href: `/thu-vien-the?q=${encoded}`, icon: BookOpen, hint: 'Giá TCGplayer' },
      ...matchedPages
    ]
  }, [pages, pageMode, term, products.items])

  const groups = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, { item: Item; index: number }[]>()
    items.forEach((item, index) => { const rows = map.get(item.group) ?? []; rows.push({ item, index }); map.set(item.group, rows) })
    return [...map.entries()]
  }, [items])

  const current = Math.min(active, Math.max(items.length - 1, 0))
  const activeId = items[current] ? `${id}-opt-${current}` : undefined

  useEffect(() => {
    const frame = requestAnimationFrame(() => input.current?.focus())
    const root = document.documentElement
    const previous = root.style.overflow
    root.style.overflow = 'hidden'
    return () => { cancelAnimationFrame(frame); root.style.overflow = previous }
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!activeId) return
    document.getElementById(activeId)?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' })
  }, [activeId])

  const open = (item: Item | undefined, newTab: boolean) => {
    const href = item?.href ?? (term ? `/san-pham?q=${encodeURIComponent(term)}` : null)
    if (!href) return
    if (newTab) { window.open(href, '_blank', 'noopener'); return }
    onClose(false)
    router.push(href)
  }

  const onKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (event.key === 'Escape') { event.preventDefault(); onClose(true); return }
    if (event.key === 'Tab') {
      // Two stops only: the field and the close button. Results are reached with the arrow keys.
      event.preventDefault()
      ;(document.activeElement === input.current ? closeButton.current : input.current)?.focus()
      return
    }
    if (event.target !== input.current) return
    const count = items.length
    if (event.key === 'ArrowDown' && count) { event.preventDefault(); setActive((current + 1) % count) }
    else if (event.key === 'ArrowUp' && count) { event.preventDefault(); setActive((current - 1 + count) % count) }
    else if (event.key === 'Home' && event.ctrlKey && count) { event.preventDefault(); setActive(0) }
    else if (event.key === 'End' && event.ctrlKey && count) { event.preventDefault(); setActive(count - 1) }
    else if (event.key === 'Enter') { event.preventDefault(); open(items[current], event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey) }
  }

  const productStatus: ReactNode = !pageMode && term.length >= 2
    ? products.status === 'loading' ? <p className="dps-note" role="status"><Loader2 size={15} className="animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" />Đang tìm sản phẩm…</p>
      : products.status === 'error' ? <p className="dps-note" role="status">Chưa tải được gợi ý sản phẩm. Nhấn Enter để tìm trên trang sản phẩm.</p>
      : products.status === 'done' && !products.items.length ? <p className="dps-note" role="status">Không có sản phẩm khớp “{term}”. Thử tra cứu trong thư viện thẻ.</p>
      : null
    : null

  return <div className="dps-root" onKeyDown={onKeyDown}>
    <div className="dps-scrim" aria-hidden="true" onClick={() => onClose(false)} />
    <div className="dps" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Tìm kiếm tại Dark Poke">
      <div className="dps-field">
        <Search size={20} strokeWidth={1.7} aria-hidden="true" />
        <input ref={input} type="search" value={query} onChange={(event) => { setQuery(event.target.value); setActive(0) }}
          placeholder="Tìm sản phẩm sealed hoặc thẻ lẻ…" aria-label="Tìm kiếm"
          role="combobox" aria-expanded="true" aria-controls={`${id}-list`} aria-activedescendant={activeId} aria-autocomplete="list"
          autoComplete="off" spellCheck={false} enterKeyHint="search" maxLength={80} />
        <button ref={closeButton} type="button" className="dps-close" aria-label="Đóng tìm kiếm" onClick={() => onClose(true)}><X size={18} strokeWidth={1.8} aria-hidden="true" /></button>
      </div>

      <div className="dps-list" id={`${id}-list`} role="listbox" aria-label="Kết quả">
        {productStatus}
        {groups.map(([group, rows]) => <div key={group} role="group" aria-labelledby={`${id}-${group}`}>
          <p className="dps-group" id={`${id}-${group}`} role="presentation">{group}</p>
          {rows.map(({ item, index }) => <Link key={item.id} id={`${id}-opt-${index}`} href={item.href} prefetch={false} role="option" aria-selected={index === current} tabIndex={-1}
            className="dps-item" data-active={index === current || undefined}
            onPointerMove={() => { if (index !== current) setActive(index) }}
            onClick={(event) => { if (event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey || event.shiftKey || event.button !== 0) return; event.preventDefault(); open(item, false) }}>
            {item.product
              ? <span className="dps-thumb" aria-hidden="true"><ProductImage src={item.product.thumbnail} alt="" sizes="40px" /></span>
              : item.icon ? <item.icon className="dps-icon" size={18} strokeWidth={1.7} aria-hidden="true" /> : null}
            <span className="dps-label">{item.label}</span>
            {item.product ? <span className="dps-meta">{priceRange(item.product)}</span> : item.hint ? <span className="dps-meta">{item.hint}</span> : null}
          </Link>)}
        </div>)}
        {!items.length ? <p className="dps-note" role="status">Không có trang nào khớp “{term}”.</p> : null}
      </div>

      <div className="dps-hints" aria-hidden="true">
        <span><kbd><ArrowUpDown size={12} /></kbd>Di chuyển</span>
        <span><kbd><CornerDownLeft size={12} /></kbd>Mở</span>
        <span><kbd>{mac ? '⌘' : 'Ctrl'}</kbd><kbd><CornerDownLeft size={12} /></kbd>Mở tab mới</span>
        <span><kbd>/</kbd>Tìm trang</span>
        <span className="dps-hint-end"><kbd>Esc</kbd>Đóng</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
}

'use client'
import * as Primitive from '@radix-ui/react-checkbox'
import { Check, Minus } from 'lucide-react'
export function Checkbox(props: React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof Primitive.Root>) {
  return <Primitive.Root {...props} className="check-target"><span className="check-box"><Primitive.Indicator>{props.checked === 'indeterminate' ? <Minus size={13} aria-hidden="true" /> : <Check size={13} aria-hidden="true" />}</Primitive.Indicator></span></Primitive.Root>
}

import Link from 'next/link'
import { Suspense } from 'react'
import { ArrowLeft, ArrowUpRight, Info, Layers, Search } from 'lucide-react'
import { LANGUAGES, backHref, cardImageCandidates, categoryLabel, libraryHref, parseLibraryQuery, serieFromLogo, typeLabel, type CardLanguage, type LibraryDetail } from '../domain'
import { formatUpdated, variantLabel, type ExchangeRates } from '../pricing'
import { DetailArt } from './detail-art'
import { MarketPanel } from './price-panel'
import { CurrencyProvider } from './currency'
import { ScrydexSection, ScrydexSkeleton } from './scrydex-section'
import '../library.css'
import '../library-v14.css'

const ENERGY: Record<string, string> = { Fire: '#e4572e', Water: '#2f86de', Grass: '#3fa34d', Lightning: '#f2c12e', Electric: '#f2c12e', Psychic: '#9b59b6', Fighting: '#b8692f', Darkness: '#2f3c4f', Metal: '#8d99a6', Fairy: '#e48bb4', Dragon: '#b08a1e', Colorless: '#c9ced6' }

function Energy({ types }: { types: string[] }) {
  return <span className="dx-energy">{types.map((type, index) => <i key={`${type}:${index}`} style={{ background: ENERGY[type] ?? '#c9ced6' }} title={typeLabel(type)} />)}<span className="sr-only">{types.map(typeLabel).join(', ')}</span></span>
}

export function LibraryCardDetail({ card, lang, from, rates }: { card: LibraryDetail; lang: CardLanguage; from?: string; rates: ExchangeRates }) {
  const language = LANGUAGES.find((l) => l.code === lang)?.label
  const setHref = libraryHref({ ...parseLibraryQuery(new URLSearchParams()), lang, set: card.set.id })
  const number = `${card.localId}${card.set.cardCount?.official ? '/' + card.set.cardCount.official : ''}`
  const printed = Object.entries(card.variants ?? {}).filter(([, on]) => on).map(([key]) => variantLabel(key))
  const legal = card.legal ? [card.legal.standard ? 'Standard' : null, card.legal.expanded ? 'Expanded' : null].filter(Boolean).join(' · ') || 'Không hợp lệ ở Standard/Expanded' : null
  const facts: [string, string][] = [
    ['Mã thẻ', card.id], ['Bộ thẻ', card.set.name], ['Số thẻ', number], ['Ngôn ngữ', language ?? lang],
    ['Độ hiếm', card.rarity ?? 'Chưa cập nhật'], ['Họa sĩ', card.illustrator ?? 'Chưa cập nhật']
  ]
  if (card.hp != null) facts.push(['HP', String(card.hp)])
  if (card.stage) facts.push(['Giai đoạn', card.stage])
  if (card.evolveFrom) facts.push(['Tiến hóa từ', card.evolveFrom])
  if (card.trainerType) facts.push(['Loại Trainer', card.trainerType])
  if (card.energyType) facts.push(['Loại năng lượng', card.energyType])
  if (card.suffix) facts.push(['Hậu tố', card.suffix])
  if (card.regulationMark) facts.push(['Dấu điều chỉnh', card.regulationMark])
  if (legal) facts.push(['Thể thức hợp lệ', legal])
  if (card.dexId?.length) facts.push(['Số Pokédex', card.dexId.map((n) => `#${String(n).padStart(4, '0')}`).join(', ')])
  if (printed.length) facts.push(['Phiên bản in', printed.join(' · ')])
  const dataUpdated = formatUpdated(card.updated ?? null)
  const serie = serieFromLogo(card.set.logo, card.set.id)
  const images = (quality: 'low' | 'high') => cardImageCandidates({ primary: quality === 'high' ? card.imageHigh : card.imageLow, localId: card.localId, setId: card.set.id, lang, serie, quality })

  return <CurrencyProvider rates={rates}><div className="shop-container dex-page dx-page">
    <nav className="dex-breadcrumb" aria-label="Đường dẫn"><Link href={backHref(from, lang)}><ArrowLeft size={15} aria-hidden="true" />Thư viện thẻ</Link><span>/</span><Link prefetch={false} href={setHref}>{card.set.name}</Link><span>/</span><span>{card.name}</span></nav>

    <div className="dx-layout">
      <div className="dx-art"><DetailArt candidates={images('high')} zoomCandidates={images('high')} name={card.name} meta={`${card.set.name} · #${number}`} /></div>

      <div className="dx-main">
        <header className="dx-title">
          <span className="dx-eyebrow">Pokémon TCG · {card.category === 'Pokemon' ? 'Thẻ Pokémon' : categoryLabel(card.category)}</span>
          <h1>{card.name}</h1>
          <p>{card.set.name} · #{number}{card.rarity ? ` · ${card.rarity}` : ''}</p>
          <div className="dex-detail-tags">
            <span>{card.id}</span>
            {card.types?.map((type, i) => <span key={`${type}:${i}`} className="dx-type"><i style={{ background: ENERGY[type] ?? '#c9ced6' }} aria-hidden="true" />{typeLabel(type)}</span>)}
            {card.hp != null ? <span>HP {card.hp}</span> : null}
            {card.regulationMark ? <span>Dấu {card.regulationMark}</span> : null}
          </div>
        </header>

        <MarketPanel market={card.market} name={card.name} setName={card.set.name} />

        <div className="dx-actions">
          <Link prefetch={false} href={`/san-pham?q=${encodeURIComponent(card.name)}`} className="btn btn-primary btn-lg"><Search size={17} aria-hidden="true" />Tìm sản phẩm cùng tên tại shop</Link>
          <Link prefetch={false} href={setHref} className="btn btn-secondary btn-lg"><Layers size={17} aria-hidden="true" />Xem cả bộ {card.set.name}</Link>
        </div>
        <p className="dx-disclaimer"><Info size={15} aria-hidden="true" />Giá thị trường quốc tế (TCGplayer: Mỹ, Cardmarket: châu Âu) chỉ để tham khảo, không phải giá bán tại Dark Poke. Giá thực tế phụ thuộc tình trạng thẻ và phí vận chuyển.</p>
      </div>
    </div>

    <Suspense fallback={<ScrydexSkeleton />}>
      <ScrydexSection input={{ name: card.name, localId: card.localId, setName: card.set.name, official: card.set.cardCount?.official }} lang={lang} />
    </Suspense>

    <div className="dx-columns">
      <div className="dx-texts">
        {card.description || card.effect || card.item ? <section className="dx-section"><h2>Nội dung thẻ</h2>
          {card.item ? <p><b>{card.item.name}</b>{card.item.effect ? ` — ${card.item.effect}` : ''}</p> : null}
          {card.effect ? <p>{card.effect}</p> : null}{card.description ? <p className="dx-flavor">{card.description}</p> : null}</section> : null}
        {card.abilities?.length ? <section className="dx-section"><h2>Khả năng</h2><div className="dx-moves">{card.abilities.map((a, i) => <article key={`ability:${i}:${a.name}`}>
          <header>{a.type ? <small>{a.type}</small> : null}<h3>{a.name}</h3></header>{a.effect ? <p>{a.effect}</p> : null}</article>)}</div></section> : null}
        {card.attacks?.length ? <section className="dx-section"><h2>Chiêu thức</h2><div className="dx-moves">{card.attacks.map((a, i) => <article key={`attack:${i}:${a.name}`}>

'use client'
import Image from 'next/image'
import { useState } from 'react'
import type { ImageCandidate } from '../domain'
import '../card-image.css'

interface Props { candidates: ImageCandidate[]; name: string; meta?: string; large?: boolean; priority?: boolean }

/**
 * Tries each image source in turn (TCGdex → English print → Pokémon TCG API). When none loads, a card-shaped
 * placeholder with the name, set and number keeps the grid tidy instead of an empty "image missing" box.
 */
export function LibraryImage({ candidates, name, meta, large = false, priority = false }: Props) {
  const chain = candidates.map((candidate) => candidate.src).join('|')
  const [state, setState] = useState({ chain, index: 0 })
  const index = state.chain === chain ? state.index : 0
  const current = candidates[index]
  return <span className={`dex-image ${large ? 'dex-image-large' : ''}`}>
    {current
      ? <>
        <Image key={current.src} unoptimized src={current.src} alt={name} fill priority={priority && index === 0} className="object-contain"
          sizes={large ? '(max-width: 767px) 88vw, 430px' : '(max-width: 600px) 44vw, (max-width: 900px) 28vw, 220px'}
          onError={() => setState({ chain, index: index + 1 })} />
        {current.note ? <span className="dex-image-note">{current.note}</span> : null}
      </>
      : <span className="dex-ph" role="img" aria-label={`${name}: chưa có ảnh thẻ`}>
        <span className="dex-ph-name">{name}</span>
        <span className="dex-ph-ball" aria-hidden="true" />
        {meta ? <span className="dex-ph-meta">{meta}</span> : null}
        <span className="dex-ph-tag">Chưa có ảnh</span>
      </span>}
  </span>
}

File: src/features/card-library/components/currency.tsx

'use client'

import { createContext, useContext, useSyncExternalStore, type ReactNode } from 'react'
import { formatMoney, formatUpdated, formatVnd, rateFor, toVnd, type ExchangeRates } from '../pricing'

/** Display currency for market prices: the source currency (USD/EUR/JPY) or Vietnamese đồng. */
export type DisplayMode = 'original' | 'vnd'
const KEY = 'dp-card-price-currency'
const listeners = new Set<() => void>()
let memory: DisplayMode | null = null

// The choice is a per-viewer convenience: remembered in localStorage when available, in memory otherwise.
function read(): DisplayMode {
  if (memory) return memory
  try { return window.localStorage.getItem(KEY) === 'vnd' ? 'vnd' : 'original' } catch { return 'original' }
}
function write(mode: DisplayMode) {
  memory = mode
  try { window.localStorage.setItem(KEY, mode) } catch { /* storage blocked: keep the in-memory choice */ }
  listeners.forEach((listener) => listener())
}
function subscribe(listener: () => void) {
  listeners.add(listener)
  const onStorage = (event: StorageEvent) => { if (event.key === KEY) { memory = null; listener() } }
  window.addEventListener('storage', onStorage)
  return () => { listeners.delete(listener); window.removeEventListener('storage', onStorage) }
}

const RatesContext = createContext<ExchangeRates | null>(null)

export function CurrencyProvider({ rates, children }: { rates: ExchangeRates; children: ReactNode }) {
  return <RatesContext.Provider value={rates}>{children}</RatesContext.Provider>
}

export function useCurrency() {
  const rates = useContext(RatesContext)
  const stored = useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, read, () => 'original' as DisplayMode)
  const available = !!rates && (rates.USD != null || rates.EUR != null || rates.JPY != null)
  return { rates, available, mode: available ? stored : 'original' as DisplayMode, setMode: write }
}

/** Formats one price in the chosen display currency; falls back to the source currency when no rate exists. */
export function Money({ value, currency, className }: { value: number | null | undefined; currency: string; className?: string }) {
  const { rates, mode } = useCurrency()
  const converted = mode === 'vnd' && rates ? toVnd(value, currency, rates) : null
  const text = converted != null ? formatVnd(converted) : formatMoney(value, currency)
  return <span className={className} title={converted != null ? formatMoney(value, currency) : undefined}>{text}</span>
}

/** Secondary line under a headline price: the "other" currency, so both are always visible. */
export function MoneyCounterpart({ value, currency }: { value: number | null | undefined; currency: string }) {
  const { rates, mode, available } = useCurrency()
  if (!available || !rates || value == null) return null
  if (mode === 'vnd') return <span className="dx-price-vnd">= {formatMoney(value, currency)}</span>
  const converted = toVnd(value, currency, rates)
  return converted == null ? null : <span className="dx-price-vnd">≈ {formatVnd(converted)}</span>
}

export function CurrencyToggle({ currency }: { currency?: string }) {
  const { rates, available, mode, setMode } = useCurrency()
  if (!available || !rates) return null
  const label = currency && rateFor(currency, rates) ? currency.toUpperCase() : 'Gốc'
  return <div className="dx-currency" role="group" aria-label="Đơn vị tiền hiển thị">
    <button type="button" aria-pressed={mode === 'original'} onClick={() => setMode('original')}>{label}</button>
    <button type="button" aria-pressed={mode === 'vnd'} onClick={() => setMode('vnd')}>VND</button>
  </div>
}

/** One line describing the rate in use, with the attribution ExchangeRate-API requires. */
export function RateNote({ currency }: { currency: string }) {
  const { rates, available, mode } = useCurrency()
  if (!available || !rates) return null
  const rate = rateFor(currency, rates)
  const updated = formatUpdated(rates.updated)
  return <p className="dx-rate-note" data-active={mode === 'vnd' || undefined}>
    {rate ? <>1 {currency.toUpperCase()} ≈ {formatVnd(Math.round(rate))}</> : <>Chưa có tỷ giá {currency.toUpperCase()}</>}
    {rates.source !== 'env' ? <> · <a href="https://www.exchangerate-api.com" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Rates By Exchange Rate API</a>{updated ? `, ${updated}` : ''}</> : ' · tỷ giá do cửa hàng cài đặt'}
  </p>
}

const QUICK = ['Pikachu', 'Charizard', 'Eevee', 'Mewtwo', 'Umbreon', 'Gengar'] as const

interface Props { query: LibraryQuery; sets: LibrarySet[]; setsAvailable: boolean; intro: ReactNode; aside?: ReactNode }

/** Hero search (name or card code) with quick picks, then a compact toolbar for language, set and sort. */
export function LibraryFilters({ query, sets, setsAvailable, intro, aside }: Props) {

  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(false)
  const [pending, start] = useTransition()
  const go = (patch: Partial<LibraryQuery>) => start(() => router.push(libraryHref({ ...query, q: q.trim(), by, page: 1, ...patch }), { scroll: false }))
  const hasFilters = !!query.q || !!query.set || query.sort !== 'id_desc' || query.by !== 'name'
  const language = LANGUAGES.find((item) => item.code === query.lang)?.label
  const setName = query.set ? sets.find((set) => set.id === query.set)?.name ?? query.set : null
  const active = [language && query.lang !== 'en' ? language : null, setName].filter(Boolean)

  return <>
    <section className="dxl-hero" aria-labelledby="dxl-title" aria-busy={pending}>
      <div className="dxl-hero-glow" aria-hidden="true"><i /><i /><i /></div>
      <div className="dxl-fan" aria-hidden="true"><i><b /></i><i><b /></i><i><b /></i></div>

            <input id="dex-search" type="search" value={q} maxLength={80} onChange={(event) => setQ(event.target.value)} enterKeyHint="search" autoComplete="off"
              placeholder={by === 'id' ? 'Nhập mã đầy đủ, ví dụ swsh3-136' : 'Tìm Pikachu, Charizard…'} aria-describedby="dex-search-hint" disabled={pending} />

            <button type="submit" className="dxl-submit" disabled={pending}>{pending ? <Loader2 size={17} className="animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" /> : <Search size={17} aria-hidden="true" />}<span>Tra cứu</span></button>
          </div>

import Link from 'next/link'
import { ArrowUpRight, BadgeDollarSign, BookOpen, Layers, WifiOff } from 'lucide-react'
import { getLibraryPage, getLibrarySets } from '../server/data'
import { LANGUAGES, libraryParams, type LibraryQuery } from '../domain'
import { LibraryCardGrid } from './card-grid'
import { LibraryFilters } from './filters'
import { RefreshLibrary } from './refresh-button'
import '../library.css'

export async function LibraryList({ query }: { query: LibraryQuery }) {
  const [pageResult, setsResult] = await Promise.allSettled([getLibraryPage(query), getLibrarySets(query.lang)])
  const page = pageResult.status === 'fulfilled' ? pageResult.value : null
  const sets = setsResult.status === 'fulfilled' ? setsResult.value : []
  const names = Object.fromEntries(sets.map(set => [set.id, set.name]))
  const series = Object.fromEntries(sets.flatMap(set => set.serie ? [[set.id, set.serie]] : []))
  const queryKey = libraryParams(query).toString()

import { formatMoney, formatPercent, type PriceHistory } from '../pricing'
import { Money } from './currency'

const W = 640
const H = 180
const PAD = { top: 14, right: 12, bottom: 24, left: 12 }

const shortDate = (date: string) => { const [, month, day] = date.split('-'); return `${day}/${month}` }

/** Server-rendered area chart (no chart library); the data table below is the accessible version. */
export function PriceChart({ history }: { history: PriceHistory }) {
  const points = history.points
  const values = points.map((point) => point.market)
  const min = Math.min(...values); const max = Math.max(...values)
  const span = max - min || Math.max(max * 0.1, 0.01)
  const x = (index: number) => PAD.left + (index / Math.max(points.length - 1, 1)) * (W - PAD.left - PAD.right)
  const y = (value: number) => PAD.top + (1 - (value - min) / span) * (H - PAD.top - PAD.bottom)
  const line = points.map((point, index) => `${index ? 'L' : 'M'}${x(index).toFixed(1)},${y(point.market).toFixed(1)}`).join(' ')
  const area = `${line} L${x(points.length - 1).toFixed(1)},${H - PAD.bottom} L${x(0).toFixed(1)},${H - PAD.bottom} Z`
  const first = points[0]!; const last = points.at(-1)!
  const change = first.market ? ((last.market - first.market) / first.market) * 100 : 0
  const direction = change > 0.05 ? 'up' : change < -0.05 ? 'down' : 'flat'
  const weekly = points.filter((_, index) => index % 7 === 0 || index === points.length - 1)

  return <figure className="dx-chart" data-direction={direction}>
    <figcaption>
      <span>Lịch sử giá Near Mint · {points.length} ngày</span>
      <b><Money value={last.market} currency={history.currency} /><em>{formatPercent(change)}</em></b>
    </figcaption>
    <svg viewBox={`0 0 ${W} ${H}`} preserveAspectRatio="none" role="img"
      aria-label={`Giá market từ ${formatMoney(first.market, history.currency)} ngày ${shortDate(first.date)} đến ${formatMoney(last.market, history.currency)} ngày ${shortDate(last.date)}, thấp nhất ${formatMoney(min, history.currency)}, cao nhất ${formatMoney(max, history.currency)}.`}>
      <defs><linearGradient id="dx-chart-fill" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stopColor="currentColor" stopOpacity=".22" /><stop offset="1" stopColor="currentColor" stopOpacity="0" /></linearGradient></defs>
      {[0, 0.5, 1].map((ratio) => <line key={ratio} x1={PAD.left} x2={W - PAD.right} y1={PAD.top + ratio * (H - PAD.top - PAD.bottom)} y2={PAD.top + ratio * (H - PAD.top - PAD.bottom)} className="dx-chart-grid" />)}
      <path d={area} fill="url(#dx-chart-fill)" />
      <path d={line} className="dx-chart-line" vectorEffect="non-scaling-stroke" />
      <circle cx={x(points.length - 1)} cy={y(last.market)} r="3.5" className="dx-chart-dot" vectorEffect="non-scaling-stroke" />
    </svg>
    <div className="dx-chart-axis" aria-hidden="true"><span>{shortDate(first.date)}</span><span>Thấp <Money value={min} currency={history.currency} /> · Cao <Money value={max} currency={history.currency} /></span><span>{shortDate(last.date)}</span></div>
    <details className="dx-chart-table">
      <summary>Xem bảng số liệu theo tuần</summary>
      <table><thead><tr><th scope="col">Ngày</th><th scope="col">Market</th><th scope="col">Thấp</th></tr></thead>
        <tbody>{weekly.map((point) => <tr key={point.date}><td>{point.date.split('-').reverse().join('/')}</td><td><Money value={point.market} currency={history.currency} /></td><td><Money value={point.low} currency={history.currency} /></td></tr>)}</tbody></table>
    </details>
  </figure>
}

'use client'

import { useId, useState, type KeyboardEvent } from 'react'
import { ArrowUpRight, Info } from 'lucide-react'
import { cardmarketSearchUrl, formatUpdated, tcgplayerSearchUrl, type CardMarket } from '../pricing'
import { CurrencyToggle, Money, MoneyCounterpart, RateNote } from './currency'

type Source = 'tcgplayer' | 'cardmarket'
interface View { key: string; label: string; headline: number | null; headlineLabel: string; cells: [string, number | null][] }

/** Roving-tabindex keyboard support shared by the source and variant tab lists. */
function tabKeys(count: number, select: (index: number) => void, idFor: (index: number) => string) {
  return (event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLButtonElement>, index: number) => {
    const next = event.key === 'ArrowRight' ? (index + 1) % count : event.key === 'ArrowLeft' ? (index - 1 + count) % count
      : event.key === 'Home' ? 0 : event.key === 'End' ? count - 1 : -1
    if (next < 0) return
    event.preventDefault(); select(next)
    document.getElementById(idFor(next))?.focus()
  }
}

function views(market: CardMarket, source: Source): { currency: string; updated: string | null; items: View[] } | null {
  if (source === 'tcgplayer' && market.tcgplayer) return {
    currency: market.tcgplayer.currency, updated: market.tcgplayer.updated,
    items: market.tcgplayer.variants.map((v) => ({
      key: v.key, label: v.label, headline: v.market ?? v.mid ?? v.low, headlineLabel: v.market != null ? 'Market price' : 'Giá tham khảo',
      cells: [['Thấp nhất', v.low], ['Trung bình', v.mid], ['Cao nhất', v.high], ['Direct thấp nhất', v.directLow]]
    }))
  }
  if (source === 'cardmarket' && market.cardmarket) return {
    currency: market.cardmarket.currency, updated: market.cardmarket.updated,
    items: market.cardmarket.rows.map((row) => ({
      key: row.label, label: row.label, headline: row.trend ?? row.avg ?? row.avg30 ?? row.low, headlineLabel: row.trend != null ? 'Xu hướng giá' : 'Giá tham khảo',
      cells: [['Trung bình', row.avg], ['Thấp nhất', row.low], ['TB 1 ngày', row.avg1], ['TB 7 ngày', row.avg7], ['TB 30 ngày', row.avg30]]
    }))
  }
  return null
}

const SOURCE_LABEL: Record<Source, string> = { tcgplayer: 'TCGplayer', cardmarket: 'Cardmarket' }

/**
 * One price card at the top of the page. TCGplayer comes first; when TCGdex has no TCGplayer listing
 * (common for promos and Europe-only prints) the card opens on Cardmarket instead of reporting "no price".
 */
export function MarketPanel({ market, name, setName }: { market: CardMarket; name: string; setName: string }) {
  const id = useId()
  const sources = (['tcgplayer', 'cardmarket'] as Source[]).filter((source) => views(market, source)?.items.length)
  const [sourceIndex, setSourceIndex] = useState(0)
  const [variantIndex, setVariantIndex] = useState(0)
  const source = sources[sourceIndex] ?? sources[0]
  const data = source ? views(market, source) : null
  const view = data?.items[variantIndex] ?? data?.items[0]
  const sourceKeys = tabKeys(sources.length, (i) => { setSourceIndex(i); setVariantIndex(0) }, (i) => `${id}-src-${i}`)
  const variantKeys = tabKeys(data?.items.length ?? 0, setVariantIndex, (i) => `${id}-var-${i}`)

  if (!source || !data || !view) return <section className="dx-price dx-price-empty" aria-labelledby={`${id}-title`}>
    <h2 id={`${id}-title`}>Giá thị trường</h2>
    <p>TCGplayer và Cardmarket chưa có giá cho lá bài này. Bạn có thể xem tin đăng trực tiếp:</p>
    <div className="dx-price-links">
      <a className="dx-price-link" href={tcgplayerSearchUrl(name, setName)} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Tìm trên TCGplayer<ArrowUpRight size={14} aria-hidden="true" /></a>
      <a className="dx-price-link" href={cardmarketSearchUrl(name)} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Tìm trên Cardmarket<ArrowUpRight size={14} aria-hidden="true" /></a>
    </div>
  </section>

  const updated = formatUpdated(data.updated)
  const onlyCardmarket = !market.tcgplayer && source === 'cardmarket'

  return <section className="dx-price" aria-labelledby={`${id}-title`}>
    <header className="dx-price-head">
      <div><h2 id={`${id}-title`}>Giá thị trường</h2><p>{SOURCE_LABEL[source]} · {data.currency}{updated ? ` · cập nhật ${updated}` : ''}</p></div>
      <CurrencyToggle currency={data.currency} />
    </header>

    {sources.length > 1 ? <div className="dx-sources" role="tablist" aria-label="Nguồn giá">
      {sources.map((item, index) => {
        const first = views(market, item)!.items[0]!
        return <button key={item} id={`${id}-src-${index}`} type="button" role="tab" aria-selected={index === sourceIndex} tabIndex={index === sourceIndex ? 0 : -1}
          aria-controls={`${id}-panel`} onClick={() => { setSourceIndex(index); setVariantIndex(0) }} onKeyDown={(event) => sourceKeys(event, index)}>
          <span>{SOURCE_LABEL[item]}</span><b><Money value={first.headline} currency={views(market, item)!.currency} /></b>
        </button>
      })}
    </div> : null}

    {onlyCardmarket ? <p className="dx-price-note"><Info size={14} aria-hidden="true" />TCGplayer chưa niêm yết lá bài này (thường gặp với thẻ promo hoặc bản phát hành riêng). Đang hiển thị giá Cardmarket.</p> : null}

    {data.items.length > 1 ? <div className="dx-tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="Phiên bản in">
      {data.items.map((item, index) => <button key={item.key} id={`${id}-var-${index}`} type="button" role="tab" aria-selected={index === variantIndex} tabIndex={index === variantIndex ? 0 : -1}
        aria-controls={`${id}-panel`} onClick={() => setVariantIndex(index)} onKeyDown={(event) => variantKeys(event, index)}>{item.label}</button>)}
    </div> : null}

    <div id={`${id}-panel`} role={sources.length > 1 || data.items.length > 1 ? 'tabpanel' : undefined}>
      <div className="dx-price-main">
        <span className="dx-price-label">{view.headlineLabel}{data.items.length === 1 ? ` · ${view.label}` : ''}</span>
        <strong className="dx-price-value"><Money value={view.headline} currency={data.currency} /></strong>
        <MoneyCounterpart value={view.headline} currency={data.currency} />
      </div>
      <dl className={`dx-price-grid ${view.cells.length === 5 ? 'dx-price-grid-5' : ''}`}>
        {view.cells.map(([label, value]) => <div key={label}><dt>{label}</dt><dd><Money value={value} currency={data.currency} /></dd></div>)}
      </dl>
      <RateNote currency={data.currency} />
    </div>

    <div className="dx-price-links">
      {market.tcgplayer || source === 'tcgplayer' ? <a className="dx-price-link" href={tcgplayerSearchUrl(name, setName)} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Xem niêm yết trên TCGplayer<ArrowUpRight size={14} aria-hidden="true" /></a> : null}
      {market.cardmarket ? <a className="dx-price-link" href={cardmarketSearchUrl(name)} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Xem trên Cardmarket<ArrowUpRight size={14} aria-hidden="true" /></a> : null}
    </div>
  </section>
}

import { ArrowUpRight, Award, ChartColumn, Layers } from 'lucide-react'
import { getScrydexMarket, type MatchInput } from '../server/scrydex'
import { CONDITION_LABELS, formatPercent, type GradedPrice, type PopReport, type ScrydexVariant, type TrendKey, type Trends } from '../pricing'
import { PriceChart } from './price-chart'
import { CurrencyToggle, Money } from './currency'

const GRADED_VISIBLE = 14

function Trend({ trends, period, optional }: { trends: Trends; period: TrendKey; optional?: boolean }) {
  const value = trends[period]
  const className = optional ? 'dx-trend dx-opt' : 'dx-trend'
  if (!value) return <td className={className}>—</td>
  const tone = value.percent > 0.05 ? 'up' : value.percent < -0.05 ? 'down' : 'flat'
  return <td className={className} data-tone={tone}>{formatPercent(value.percent)}</td>
}

function GradedRows({ rows }: { rows: GradedPrice[] }) {
  return <>{rows.map((row, index) => <tr key={`${row.company}:${row.grade}:${row.flags.join()}:${index}`}>
    <th scope="row">{row.company} {row.grade}{row.flags.length ? <small>{row.flags.join(' · ')}</small> : null}</th>
    <td><Money value={row.low} currency={row.currency} /></td><td className="dx-opt"><Money value={row.mid} currency={row.currency} /></td><td className="dx-opt"><Money value={row.high} currency={row.currency} /></td>
    <td className="dx-strong"><Money value={row.market} currency={row.currency} /></td><Trend trends={row.trends} period="days_30" />
  </tr>)}</>
}

function Pop({ reports }: { reports: PopReport[] }) {
  return <div className="dx-pop">
    {reports.map((report) => {
      const top = report.grades.slice(0, 6); const peak = Math.max(...top.map((g) => g.count), 1)
      return <article key={report.company}>
        <header><b>{report.company}</b><span>{report.total.toLocaleString('vi-VN')} thẻ đã chấm</span></header>
        <ul>{top.map((g) => <li key={g.grade}><span>{report.company} {g.grade}</span><span className="dx-pop-bar" aria-hidden="true"><i style={{ width: `${Math.max((g.count / peak) * 100, 2)}%` }} /></span><b>{g.count.toLocaleString('vi-VN')}</b></li>)}</ul>
      </article>
    })}
  </div>
}

function Variant({ variant, open }: { variant: ScrydexVariant; open: boolean }) {
  const nm = variant.raw.find((row) => row.condition === 'NM' && !row.flags.length) ?? variant.raw[0]
  const psa10 = variant.graded.find((row) => row.company === 'PSA' && row.grade === '10' && !row.flags.length)
  return <details className="dx-variant" open={open}>
    <summary>
      <span className="dx-variant-name"><Layers size={16} aria-hidden="true" />{variant.label}</span>
      <span className="dx-variant-summary">
        {nm?.market != null ? <span>NM <b><Money value={nm.market} currency={nm.currency} /></b></span> : null}
        {psa10?.market != null ? <span>PSA 10 <b><Money value={psa10.market} currency={psa10.currency} /></b></span> : null}
      </span>
    </summary>

    {variant.raw.length ? <div className="dx-table-wrap"><table className="dx-table">
      <caption>Thẻ raw theo tình trạng</caption>
      <thead><tr><th scope="col">Tình trạng</th><th scope="col">Thấp nhất</th><th scope="col">Market</th><th scope="col" className="dx-opt">1 ngày</th><th scope="col" className="dx-opt">7 ngày</th><th scope="col">30 ngày</th><th scope="col" className="dx-opt">90 ngày</th></tr></thead>
      <tbody>{variant.raw.map((row, index) => <tr key={`${row.condition}:${row.flags.join()}:${index}`}>
        <th scope="row"><abbr title={CONDITION_LABELS[row.condition] ?? row.condition}>{row.condition}</abbr>{row.flags.length ? <small>{row.flags.join(' · ')}</small> : null}</th>
        <td><Money value={row.low} currency={row.currency} /></td><td className="dx-strong"><Money value={row.market} currency={row.currency} /></td>
        <Trend trends={row.trends} period="days_1" optional /><Trend trends={row.trends} period="days_7" optional /><Trend trends={row.trends} period="days_30" /><Trend trends={row.trends} period="days_90" optional />
      </tr>)}</tbody>
    </table></div> : null}

    {variant.graded.length ? <div className="dx-table-wrap"><table className="dx-table">
      <caption><Award size={15} aria-hidden="true" />Thẻ đã grading</caption>
      <thead><tr><th scope="col">Hãng · điểm</th><th scope="col">Thấp nhất</th><th scope="col" className="dx-opt">Trung vị</th><th scope="col" className="dx-opt">Cao nhất</th><th scope="col">Market</th><th scope="col">30 ngày</th></tr></thead>
      <tbody><GradedRows rows={variant.graded.slice(0, GRADED_VISIBLE)} /></tbody>
    </table>
    {variant.graded.length > GRADED_VISIBLE ? <details className="dx-more"><summary>Xem thêm {variant.graded.length - GRADED_VISIBLE} mức điểm</summary>
      <table className="dx-table"><tbody><GradedRows rows={variant.graded.slice(GRADED_VISIBLE)} /></tbody></table></details> : null}
    </div> : null}

    {variant.pop.length ? <section className="dx-pop-wrap" aria-label={`Pop report ${variant.label}`}><h4><ChartColumn size={15} aria-hidden="true" />Pop report (số lượng thẻ đã chấm)</h4><Pop reports={variant.pop} /></section> : null}
  </details>
}

/** Streams in after the main card facts; renders nothing when Scrydex is not configured or has no match. */
export async function ScrydexSection({ input, lang }: { input: MatchInput; lang: string }) {
  const result = await getScrydexMarket(input, lang)
  if (result.status === 'disabled') return null
  if (result.status !== 'ok') return <section className="dx-section dx-scrydex-empty" aria-label="Giá chi tiết">
    <p>{result.status === 'unmatched' ? 'Chưa có dữ liệu giá theo tình trạng và grading cho lá bài này.' : 'Chưa tải được giá chi tiết theo tình trạng và grading. Giá TCGplayer phía trên vẫn dùng được.'}</p>
  </section>

  const { card, history } = result
  const primary = history ? card.variants.findIndex((v) => v.name === history.variant) : 0
  return <section className="dx-section dx-scrydex" aria-labelledby="dx-scrydex-title">
    <header className="dx-section-head">
      <div><span className="dx-eyebrow">Phân tích giá · Scrydex</span><h2 id="dx-scrydex-title">Giá theo tình trạng & grading</h2>
        <p>{card.expansionName ? `${card.expansionName} · ` : ''}Giá raw theo NM/LP/MP/HP/DM, giá PSA, CGC, BGS… kèm biến động 1–90 ngày.</p></div>
      <div className="dx-section-tools"><CurrencyToggle currency="USD" /><a href="https://scrydex.com" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="dx-source-badge">Scrydex<ArrowUpRight size={12} aria-hidden="true" /></a></div>
    </header>
    {history ? <PriceChart history={history} /> : null}
    <div className="dx-variants">{card.variants.map((variant, index) => <Variant key={variant.name} variant={variant} open={index === Math.max(primary, 0)} />)}</div>
  </section>
}

    <span className="skeleton mt-6 block h-40 w-full" /><span className="skeleton mt-4 block h-14 w-full" />

import type { z } from 'zod'
import type { detailSchema } from './server/schema'
import type { CardMarket } from './pricing'

export const PAGE_SIZE = 24
export const CARD_ID = /^[a-zA-Z0-9](?:[a-zA-Z0-9._!?-]|%3[fF]){0,79}$/
export const SET_ID = /^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9._-]{0,49}$/
export const LANGUAGES = [
  {code:'en',label:'Tiếng Anh'}, {code:'ja',label:'Tiếng Nhật'},
  {code:'fr',label:'Tiếng Pháp'}, {code:'de',label:'Tiếng Đức'},
  {code:'es',label:'Tiếng Tây Ban Nha'}, {code:'it',label:'Tiếng Ý'},
  {code:'pt-br',label:'Tiếng Bồ Đào Nha (Brazil)'}, {code:'ko',label:'Tiếng Hàn'},
  {code:'zh-tw',label:'Tiếng Trung phồn thể'}, {code:'zh-cn',label:'Tiếng Trung giản thể'},
  {code:'id',label:'Tiếng Indonesia'}, {code:'th',label:'Tiếng Thái'}
] as const
export type CardLanguage = typeof LANGUAGES[number]['code']
export type LibraryQuery = {q:string;by:'name'|'id';lang:CardLanguage;set:string;sort:'id_desc'|'name_asc'|'number_asc';page:number}
type SP = Record<string,string|string[]|undefined>
export function parseLibraryQuery(input:SP|URLSearchParams):LibraryQuery {
  const get=(key:string)=>{const v=input instanceof URLSearchParams?input.get(key):input[key];return(Array.isArray(v)?v[0]:v)??''}
  const lang=get('lang');const sort=get('sort');const set=get('set');const page=Number(get('page'))
  const by=get('by')==='id'?'id':'name';const q=get('q').trim().slice(0,80)
  return {q,by,lang:LANGUAGES.some(l=>l.code===lang)?lang as CardLanguage:'en',set:SET_ID.test(set)?set:'',sort:sort==='name_asc'||sort==='number_asc'?sort:'id_desc',page:by==='id'&&q?1:Number.isSafeInteger(page)&&page>0&&page<=5000?page:1}
}
export function libraryParams(query:LibraryQuery) {
  const p=new URLSearchParams()
  if(query.q)p.set('q',query.q)
  if(query.by==='id')p.set('by','id')
  if(query.lang!=='en')p.set('lang',query.lang)
  if(query.set)p.set('set',query.set)
  if(query.sort!=='id_desc')p.set('sort',query.sort)
  if(query.page>1)p.set('page',String(query.page))
  return p
}
export function libraryHref(query:LibraryQuery) {const params=libraryParams(query).toString();return `/thu-vien-the${params?'?'+params:''}`}
export function cardHref(id:string,query:LibraryQuery) {
  const params=new URLSearchParams({lang:query.lang,from:libraryParams(query).toString()})
  return `/thu-vien-the/${encodeURIComponent(id)}?${params}`
}
export function backHref(from:string|undefined,lang:CardLanguage) {return libraryHref({...parseLibraryQuery(new URLSearchParams((from??'').slice(0,600))),lang})}
export function cardImageUrl(base:unknown,quality:'low'|'high') {
  if(typeof base!=='string')return null
  try{const url=new URL(base);if(url.protocol!=='https:'||url.hostname!=='assets.tcgdex.net'||url.port||url.search||url.hash||url.username||url.password)return null;return `${url.origin}${url.pathname.replace(/\/$/,'')}/${quality}.webp`}catch{return null}
}

/** TCGdex logo URLs embed the serie: https://assets.tcgdex.net/en/<serie>/<set>/logo. */
export function serieFromLogo(logo:unknown,setId:string) {
  if(typeof logo!=='string')return null
  const match=/^https:\/\/assets\.tcgdex\.net\/[a-z-]+\/([a-z0-9.-]{1,30})\/([^/]{1,50})\/logo$/i.exec(logo)
  return match&&match[2]===setId?match[1]!:null
}

export interface ImageCandidate {src:string;note:string|null}
const LATIN_PRINTS=new Set<CardLanguage>(['en','fr','de','es','it','pt-br'])
/** Pokémon TCG API set ids differ from TCGdex for decimal sets: sv03.5 → sv3pt5, swsh4.5 → swsh45, sm11.5 → sm115. */
function ptcgSetId(setId:string) {
  const id=setId.toLowerCase()
  if(id==='swsh4.5')return 'swsh45'
  let m=/^(sv|swsh)0?(\d+)\.5$/.exec(id);if(m)return `${m[1]}${m[2]}pt5`
  m=/^sm(\d+)\.5$/.exec(id);if(m)return `sm${m[1]}5`
  m=/^sv0(\d)$/.exec(id);if(m)return `sv${m[1]}`
  return /^[a-z0-9]{2,12}$/.test(id)?id:null
}
/**
 * Image chain for one card: TCGdex in the chosen language, then the English print on TCGdex (same numbering
 * for Latin-alphabet languages), then the Pokémon TCG API scan. Each step is tried only if the previous fails.
 */
export function cardImageCandidates(input:{primary:string|null;localId:string;setId:string;lang:CardLanguage;serie?:string|null;quality:'low'|'high'}):ImageCandidate[] {
  const list:ImageCandidate[]=[]
  if(input.primary)list.push({src:input.primary,note:null})
  const latin=LATIN_PRINTS.has(input.lang)
  const local=encodeURIComponent(input.localId)
  if(latin&&input.lang!=='en'&&input.serie&&SET_ID.test(input.setId))
    list.push({src:`https://assets.tcgdex.net/en/${encodeURIComponent(input.serie)}/${encodeURIComponent(input.setId)}/${local}/${input.quality}.webp`,note:'Ảnh bản tiếng Anh'})
  const ptcgSet=latin?ptcgSetId(input.setId):null
  const number=/^\d+$/.test(input.localId)?String(Number(input.localId)):input.localId
  if(ptcgSet&&/^[a-zA-Z0-9-]{1,20}$/.test(number))
    list.push({src:`https://images.pokemontcg.io/${ptcgSet}/${encodeURIComponent(number)}${input.quality==='high'?'_hires':''}.png`,note:input.lang==='en'?'Ảnh tham khảo · Pokémon TCG API':'Ảnh bản tiếng Anh · Pokémon TCG API'})
  return [...new Map(list.map(c=>[c.src,c])).values()]
}

'use client'

import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { useInfiniteQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { libraryParams, type LibraryPage, type LibraryQuery } from '../domain'
import { fetchLibraryBatch, mergeLibraryCards, nextLibraryBatch } from '../infinite'

export function useInfiniteLibrary(query: LibraryQuery, initial: LibraryPage) {
  const sentinel = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const [automatic, setAutomatic] = useState(true)
  const [observerSupported, setObserverSupported] = useState(true)
  const filterKey = libraryParams({ ...query, page: 1 }).toString()
  const result = useInfiniteQuery({
    queryKey: ['tcgdex-library-v5', filterKey],
    queryFn: ({ pageParam, signal }) => fetchLibraryBatch(query, pageParam, signal),
    initialPageParam: 1,
    initialData: { pages: [initial], pageParams: [1] },
    getNextPageParam: nextLibraryBatch,
    staleTime: 10 * 60_000,
    // SSR owns a short-lived QueryClient; avoid retaining it with a browser GC timer.
    gcTime: typeof window === 'undefined' ? Infinity : 15 * 60_000,
    refetchOnMount: false,
    refetchOnWindowFocus: false,
    refetchOnReconnect: false,
    retry: 1
  })
  const { hasNextPage, isFetching, isError, isPaused, fetchNextPage } = result

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!('IntersectionObserver' in window)) { setObserverSupported(false); return }
    const element = sentinel.current
    if (!element || !automatic || !hasNextPage || isFetching || isError || isPaused) return
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
      if (entries.some(entry => entry.isIntersecting)) void fetchNextPage({ cancelRefetch: false })
    }, { rootMargin: '600px 0px', threshold: 0 })
    observer.observe(element)
    return () => observer.disconnect()
  }, [automatic, hasNextPage, isFetching, isError, isPaused, fetchNextPage])

  const cards = useMemo(() => mergeLibraryCards(result.data.pages), [result.data.pages])
  const loadMore = () => { if (hasNextPage && !isFetching) void fetchNextPage({ cancelRefetch: false }) }
  return { ...result, cards, sentinel, automatic, setAutomatic, observerSupported, loadMore }
}

================
File: src/features/card-library/infinite.ts

import { CARD_ID, PAGE_SIZE, SET_ID, libraryParams, type LibraryCard, type LibraryPage, type LibraryQuery } from './domain'

/** Page numbers are an internal API cursor; they never become pagination controls. */
export function nextLibraryBatch(last: LibraryPage): number | undefined {
  return last.hasNext && last.items.length > 0 && last.page < 5000 ? last.page + 1 : undefined
}

export function mergeLibraryCards(pages: LibraryPage[]): LibraryCard[] {
  return [...new Map(pages.flatMap(page => page.items).map(card => [card.id, card])).values()]
}

function isCard(value: unknown): value is LibraryCard {
  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') return false
  const card = value as Partial<LibraryCard>
  return typeof card.id === 'string' && CARD_ID.test(card.id)
    && typeof card.name === 'string' && !!card.name
    && typeof card.localId === 'string'
    && typeof card.setId === 'string' && (!card.setId || SET_ID.test(card.setId))
    && (card.image === null || typeof card.image === 'string')
}

export async function fetchLibraryBatch(query: LibraryQuery, page: number, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<LibraryPage> {
  const params = libraryParams({ ...query, page })
  const response = await fetch(`/api/card-library?${params}`, { signal, headers: { Accept: 'application/json' } })
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error('TCGDEX_BATCH_UNAVAILABLE')
  const value: unknown = await response.json()
  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') throw new Error('TCGDEX_BATCH_INVALID')
  const batch = value as Partial<LibraryPage>
  if (batch.page !== page || typeof batch.hasNext !== 'boolean' || !Array.isArray(batch.items)
    || batch.items.length > PAGE_SIZE || !batch.items.every(isCard)) throw new Error('TCGDEX_BATCH_INVALID')
  return { items: batch.items, page, hasNext: batch.hasNext }
}

/** Market-price shapes shared by server loaders and UI. All prices are reference values, never shop prices. */

export interface TcgplayerVariant { key: string; label: string; low: number | null; mid: number | null; high: number | null; market: number | null; directLow: number | null }
export interface TcgplayerPricing { updated: string | null; currency: string; variants: TcgplayerVariant[] }
export interface CardmarketRow { label: string; avg: number | null; low: number | null; trend: number | null; avg1: number | null; avg7: number | null; avg30: number | null }
export interface CardmarketPricing { updated: string | null; currency: string; rows: CardmarketRow[] }
export interface CardMarket { tcgplayer: TcgplayerPricing | null; cardmarket: CardmarketPricing | null }

export type TrendKey = 'days_1' | 'days_7' | 'days_14' | 'days_30' | 'days_90' | 'days_180'
export type Trends = Partial<Record<TrendKey, { change: number; percent: number }>>
export interface RawPrice { condition: string; low: number | null; market: number | null; currency: string; trends: Trends; flags: string[] }
export interface GradedPrice { company: string; grade: string; low: number | null; mid: number | null; high: number | null; market: number | null; currency: string; trends: Trends; flags: string[] }
export interface PopReport { company: string; total: number; grades: { grade: string; count: number }[] }
export interface ScrydexVariant { name: string; label: string; raw: RawPrice[]; graded: GradedPrice[]; pop: PopReport[] }
export interface ScrydexCard { id: string; expansionId: string; expansionName: string; variants: ScrydexVariant[] }
export interface HistoryPoint { date: string; market: number; low: number | null }
export interface PriceHistory { variant: string; condition: string; currency: string; points: HistoryPoint[] }

/** VND per unit of each currency. Reference rates only: a live daily feed, or overrides from server env. */
export interface ExchangeRates { USD: number | null; EUR: number | null; JPY: number | null; source: 'env' | 'exchangerate-api' | 'mixed' | null; updated: string | null }
export const NO_RATES: ExchangeRates = { USD: null, EUR: null, JPY: null, source: null, updated: null }

const VARIANT_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  normal: 'Thường', holo: 'Holo', holofoil: 'Holo', reverse: 'Reverse Holo', 'reverse-holofoil': 'Reverse Holo', reverseholofoil: 'Reverse Holo',
  '1st-edition': '1st Edition', '1steditionnormal': '1st Edition', '1st-edition-holofoil': '1st Edition Holo', '1steditionholofoil': '1st Edition Holo',
  unlimited: 'Unlimited', unlimitedholofoil: 'Unlimited Holo', firstedition: '1st Edition', wpromo: 'W Promo',
  pokeball: 'Poké Ball', masterball: 'Master Ball', pokeballreverseholofoil: 'Poké Ball Reverse', masterballreverseholofoil: 'Master Ball Reverse'
}

/** "reverseHolofoil", "reverse-holofoil" and "reverse" all read as "Reverse Holo". */
export function variantLabel(key: string) {
  const compact = key.replace(/[\s_]/g, '').toLowerCase()
  const known = VARIANT_LABELS[key.toLowerCase()] ?? VARIANT_LABELS[compact] ?? VARIANT_LABELS[compact.replace(/-/g, '')]
  if (known) return known
  return key.replace(/([a-z])([A-Z])/g, '$1 $2').replace(/[-_]+/g, ' ').replace(/\b\w/g, (letter) => letter.toUpperCase())
}

export const CONDITION_LABELS: Record<string, string> = { NM: 'Near Mint', LP: 'Lightly Played', MP: 'Moderately Played', HP: 'Heavily Played', DM: 'Damaged' }
const CONDITION_ORDER = ['NM', 'LP', 'MP', 'HP', 'DM']
export const conditionRank = (condition: string) => { const index = CONDITION_ORDER.indexOf(condition); return index < 0 ? 99 : index }

const money = new Map<string, Intl.NumberFormat>()
export function formatMoney(value: number | null | undefined, currency: string) {
  if (value == null || !Number.isFinite(value)) return '—'
  const key = currency.toUpperCase()
  let format = money.get(key)
  if (!format) {
    try { format = new Intl.NumberFormat(key === 'EUR' ? 'de-DE' : key === 'JPY' ? 'ja-JP' : 'en-US', { style: 'currency', currency: key, maximumFractionDigits: key === 'JPY' ? 0 : 2 }) }
    catch { format = new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { maximumFractionDigits: 2 }) }
    money.set(key, format)
  }
  return format.format(value)
}

const vnd = new Intl.NumberFormat('vi-VN', { style: 'currency', currency: 'VND', maximumFractionDigits: 0 })
export function rateFor(currency: string, rates: ExchangeRates) {
  const key = currency.toUpperCase()
  const rate = key === 'USD' ? rates.USD : key === 'EUR' ? rates.EUR : key === 'JPY' ? rates.JPY : null
  return rate && Number.isFinite(rate) && rate > 0 ? rate : null
}
/** Converted amount in VND, rounded to the nearest 1,000 ₫ (100 ₫ under 10,000 ₫): the rate is only a reference. */
export function toVnd(value: number | null | undefined, currency: string, rates: ExchangeRates) {
  const rate = rateFor(currency, rates)
  if (value == null || !rate || !Number.isFinite(value)) return null
  const amount = value * rate
  const step = amount < 10_000 ? 100 : 1000
  return Math.round(amount / step) * step
}
export function formatVnd(value: number | null | undefined) {
  return value == null || !Number.isFinite(value) ? '—' : vnd.format(value)
}
export function approxVnd(value: number | null | undefined, currency: string, rates: ExchangeRates) {
  const converted = toVnd(value, currency, rates)
  return converted == null ? null : `≈ ${vnd.format(converted)}`
}

export function formatPercent(value: number | null | undefined) {
  if (value == null || !Number.isFinite(value)) return '—'
  const rounded = Math.round(value * 10) / 10
  return `${rounded > 0 ? '+' : ''}${rounded.toLocaleString('vi-VN', { maximumFractionDigits: 1 })}%`
}

export function formatUpdated(value: string | null) {
  if (!value) return null
  const date = new Date(value.replace(/\//g, '-'))
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return null
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('vi-VN', { day: '2-digit', month: '2-digit', year: 'numeric', timeZone: 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh' }).format(date)
}

/** TCGplayer search link: TCGdex does not expose product ids, so we never fabricate a product URL. */
export function tcgplayerSearchUrl(name: string, setName?: string) {
  const q = [name, setName].filter(Boolean).join(' ')
  return `https://www.tcgplayer.com/search/pokemon/product?productLineName=pokemon&q=${encodeURIComponent(q)}`
}
export function cardmarketSearchUrl(name: string) {
  return `https://www.cardmarket.com/en/Pokemon/Products/Search?searchString=${encodeURIComponent(name)}`
}

import 'server-only'
import { cache } from 'react'
import { unstable_cache } from 'next/cache'
import { Query } from '@tcgdex/sdk'
import { z } from 'zod'
import { CARD_ID, PAGE_SIZE, cardImageUrl, serieFromLogo, type CardLanguage, type LibraryCard, type LibraryDetail, type LibraryPage, type LibraryQuery, type LibrarySet } from '../domain'
import { createCardSdk } from './sdk'
import { briefSchema, detailSchema, setSchema } from './schema'
import { parseTcgdexPricing } from './tcgdex-pricing'

export function buildCardQuery(query:LibraryQuery,page=query.page,size=PAGE_SIZE) {
  const filter=Query.create().paginate(page,size)
  if(query.q)filter.contains('name',`like:${query.q}`)
  if(query.set)filter.equal('set.id',query.set)
  const field=query.sort==='name_asc'?'name':query.sort==='number_asc'?'localId':'id'
  return filter.sort(field,query.sort==='id_desc'?'DESC':'ASC')
}
function toBrief(input:z.infer<typeof briefSchema>):LibraryCard {
  const separator=input.id.lastIndexOf('-')
  return {id:input.id,name:input.name,localId:input.localId,image:cardImageUrl(input.image,'low'),setId:separator>0?input.id.slice(0,separator):''}
}
class MissingCard extends Error {}
const cardCached=unstable_cache(async(lang:CardLanguage,id:string):Promise<LibraryDetail>=>{
  const card=await createCardSdk(lang).card.get(id)
  if(!card)throw new MissingCard('TCGDEX_CARD_NOT_FOUND')
  const {pricing,...parsed}=detailSchema.parse(card)
  return {...parsed,imageLow:cardImageUrl(parsed.image,'low'),imageHigh:cardImageUrl(parsed.image,'high'),market:parseTcgdexPricing(pricing)}
},['tcgdex-v6-card'],{revalidate:3600,tags:['tcgdex-cards','tcgdex-prices']})
export const getLibraryCard=cache(async(lang:CardLanguage,id:string):Promise<LibraryDetail|null>=>{
  if(!CARD_ID.test(id))return null
  try{return await cardCached(lang,id)}catch(error){if(error instanceof MissingCard)return null;throw error}
})
export const getLibrarySets=unstable_cache(async(lang:CardLanguage):Promise<LibrarySet[]>=>{
  const sdk=createCardSdk(lang)
  const data=await sdk.set.list(Query.create().sort('releaseDate','DESC').paginate(1,500))
  return z.array(setSchema).max(500).parse(data).map(s=>({id:s.id,name:s.name,serie:serieFromLogo(s.logo,s.id)}))
},['tcgdex-v5-sets'],{revalidate:86400,tags:['tcgdex-sets']})
export const getLibraryPage=unstable_cache(async(query:LibraryQuery):Promise<LibraryPage>=>{
  if(query.by==='id'&&query.q){
    const card=await getLibraryCard(query.lang,query.q)
    const items=card&&(!query.set||card.set.id===query.set)?[toBrief(card)]:[]
    return {items,page:1,hasNext:false}
  }
  const sdk=createCardSdk(query.lang)
  // One bounded page + one lookahead record; never fetch the full card database.
  const [data,next]=await Promise.all([
    sdk.card.list(buildCardQuery(query)),
    sdk.card.list(buildCardQuery(query,query.page*PAGE_SIZE+1,1))
  ])
  const rows=z.array(briefSchema).max(PAGE_SIZE).parse(data)
  const sentinel=z.array(briefSchema).max(1).parse(next)
  const items=[...new Map(rows.map(c=>[c.id,toBrief(c)])).values()]
  return {items,page:query.page,hasNext:sentinel.length>0&&query.page<5000}
},['tcgdex-v4-page'],{revalidate:600,tags:['tcgdex-cards']})

import 'server-only'
import { unstable_cache } from 'next/cache'
import { NO_RATES, type ExchangeRates } from '../pricing'

/**
 * VND reference rates for card prices.
 * 1. CARD_PRICE_USD_VND / CARD_PRICE_EUR_VND / CARD_PRICE_JPY_VND in env win (the shop's own rate, e.g. 26300).
 * 2. Otherwise the free ExchangeRate-API open endpoint (updates once a day, no key; attribution shown on the page).
 * The feed is cached for 12 hours, well inside its "at most once per hour" guidance.
 */
const FEED = 'https://open.er-api.com/v6/latest/USD'

function envRate(name: string) {
  const value = Number(process.env[name]?.replace(/[_\s.,]/g, ''))
  return Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0 && value < 1_000_000 ? value : null
}

interface Feed { USD: number; EUR: number | null; JPY: number | null; updated: string | null }

const loadFeed = unstable_cache(async (): Promise<Feed | null> => {
  const response = await fetch(FEED, { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(6000), cache: 'no-store', headers: { Accept: 'application/json' } })
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`FX_HTTP_${response.status}`)
  const body = await response.json() as { result?: unknown; rates?: Record<string, unknown>; time_last_update_unix?: unknown }
  const rates = body.rates ?? {}
  const vnd = Number(rates.VND); const eur = Number(rates.EUR); const jpy = Number(rates.JPY)
  // Sanity bounds keep a malformed feed from showing absurd prices.
  if (body.result !== 'success' || !(vnd > 1000 && vnd < 1_000_000)) return null
  const updated = typeof body.time_last_update_unix === 'number' ? new Date(body.time_last_update_unix * 1000).toISOString() : null
  return { USD: vnd, EUR: eur > 0 ? vnd / eur : null, JPY: jpy > 0 ? vnd / jpy : null, updated }
}, ['fx-usd-vnd-v1'], { revalidate: 12 * 3600, tags: ['fx-rates'] })

export async function getExchangeRates(): Promise<ExchangeRates> {
  const env = { USD: envRate('CARD_PRICE_USD_VND'), EUR: envRate('CARD_PRICE_EUR_VND'), JPY: envRate('CARD_PRICE_JPY_VND') }
  const needFeed = env.USD == null || env.EUR == null || env.JPY == null
  const feed = needFeed ? await loadFeed().catch(() => null) : null
  const result = { USD: env.USD ?? feed?.USD ?? null, EUR: env.EUR ?? feed?.EUR ?? null, JPY: env.JPY ?? feed?.JPY ?? null }
  if (result.USD == null && result.EUR == null && result.JPY == null) return NO_RATES
  const usedEnv = env.USD != null || env.EUR != null || env.JPY != null
  const usedFeed = !!feed && ((env.USD == null && feed.USD != null) || (env.EUR == null && feed.EUR != null) || (env.JPY == null && feed.JPY != null))
  return { ...result, source: usedEnv && usedFeed ? 'mixed' : usedFeed ? 'exchangerate-api' : 'env', updated: usedFeed ? feed!.updated : null }
}

================
File: src/features/card-library/server/scrydex-signature.ts

import 'server-only'
import { createHmac, timingSafeEqual } from 'node:crypto'

/** Scrydex signs "<t>.<raw body>" with HMAC-SHA256; deliveries older than five minutes are rejected. */
const TOLERANCE_SECONDS = 300

function parseSignature(header: string | null) {
  if (!header || header.length > 600) return null
  let t = ''; const v1: string[] = []
  for (const part of header.split(',')) {
    const [key, value] = part.trim().split('=', 2)
    if (key === 't' && value) t = value
    if (key === 'v1' && value && /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/i.test(value)) v1.push(value.toLowerCase())
  }
  return /^\d{9,13}$/.test(t) && v1.length ? { t, v1 } : null
}

export function verifyScrydexSignature(rawBody: string, header: string | null, secret: string, nowSeconds = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000)) {
  const signature = parseSignature(header)
  if (!signature) return false
  // Scrydex documents seconds; a millisecond timestamp is tolerated for the age check only.
  const issued = signature.t.length >= 13 ? Math.floor(Number(signature.t) / 1000) : Number(signature.t)
  if (Math.abs(nowSeconds - issued) > TOLERANCE_SECONDS) return false
  const expected = createHmac('sha256', secret).update(`${signature.t}.${rawBody}`, 'utf8').digest()
  return signature.v1.some((candidate) => {
    const given = Buffer.from(candidate, 'hex')
    return given.length === expected.length && timingSafeEqual(given, expected)
  })
}

================
File: src/features/card-library/server/scrydex.ts
================
import 'server-only'
import { unstable_cache } from 'next/cache'
import { conditionRank, variantLabel, type GradedPrice, type HistoryPoint, type PopReport, type PriceHistory, type RawPrice, type ScrydexCard, type ScrydexVariant, type TrendKey, type Trends } from '../pricing'

/**
 * Optional Scrydex integration (https://scrydex.com/docs): condition and graded prices, trends,
 * price history and pop reports. Enabled only when SCRYDEX_API_KEY and SCRYDEX_TEAM_ID are set.
 * Every request costs API credits, so responses are cached and refreshed by the Scrydex webhook.
 */
const API = 'https://api.scrydex.com/pokemon/v1'
const TIMEOUT_MS = 8000
export const SCRYDEX_TAG = 'scrydex'
export const scrydexExpansionTag = (expansionId: string) => `scrydex-exp-${expansionId.toLowerCase()}`
export const EXPANSION_ID = /^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9._-]{0,49}$/
const CARD_ID = /^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9._-]{0,79}$/

export function scrydexEnabled() {
  return !!process.env.SCRYDEX_API_KEY?.trim() && !!process.env.SCRYDEX_TEAM_ID?.trim()
}

class ScrydexHttpError extends Error { constructor(readonly status: number) { super(`SCRYDEX_HTTP_${status}`) } }

async function request(path: string, params: Record<string, string>): Promise<unknown> {
  const url = new URL(`${API}${path}`)
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(params)) url.searchParams.set(key, value)
  const response = await fetch(url, {
    headers: { 'X-Api-Key': process.env.SCRYDEX_API_KEY!.trim(), 'X-Team-ID': process.env.SCRYDEX_TEAM_ID!.trim(), Accept: 'application/json' },
    signal: AbortSignal.timeout(TIMEOUT_MS), cache: 'no-store'
  })
  if (response.status === 404) return null
  if (!response.ok) throw new ScrydexHttpError(response.status)
  return response.json()
}

// --- defensive readers ------------------------------------------------------
type Obj = Record<string, unknown>
const obj = (value: unknown): Obj | null => (value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value) ? value as Obj : null)
const arr = (value: unknown): unknown[] => (Array.isArray(value) ? value : [])
const num = (value: unknown) => { const n = typeof value === 'string' ? Number(value) : value; return typeof n === 'number' && Number.isFinite(n) ? n : null }
const text = (value: unknown, max = 80) => (typeof value === 'string' && value.length <= max ? value : typeof value === 'number' ? String(value) : '')
const TREND_KEYS: TrendKey[] = ['days_1', 'days_7', 'days_14', 'days_30', 'days_90', 'days_180']

function trends(value: unknown): Trends {
  const source = obj(value); const result: Trends = {}
  if (!source) return result
  for (const key of TREND_KEYS) {
    const row = obj(source[key]); const change = num(row?.price_change); const percent = num(row?.percent_change)
    if (change != null && percent != null) result[key] = { change, percent }
  }
  return result
}
const flags = (row: Obj) => [row.is_perfect === true && 'Perfect', row.is_signed === true && 'Có chữ ký', row.is_error === true && 'Lỗi in'].filter((flag): flag is string => !!flag)
const gradeValue = (grade: string) => { const n = Number(grade); return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : -1 }

function variant(input: unknown): ScrydexVariant | null {
  const row = obj(input); const name = text(row?.name, 60)
  if (!row || !name) return null
  const raw: RawPrice[] = []; const graded: GradedPrice[] = []
  for (const item of arr(row.prices).slice(0, 200)) {
    const price = obj(item); if (!price) continue
    const currency = text(price.currency, 4) || 'USD'
    if (price.type === 'graded') {
      const company = text(price.company, 20); const grade = text(price.grade, 10)
      if (company && grade) graded.push({ company, grade, low: num(price.low), mid: num(price.mid), high: num(price.high), market: num(price.market), currency, trends: trends(price.trends), flags: flags(price) })
    } else {
      const condition = text(price.condition, 4) || 'NM'
      raw.push({ condition, low: num(price.low), market: num(price.market), currency, trends: trends(price.trends), flags: flags(price) })
    }
  }
  const pop: PopReport[] = arr(row.pop_reports).slice(0, 10).flatMap((item) => {
    const report = obj(item); const company = text(report?.company, 20)
    if (!report || !company) return []
    const grades = arr(report.grades).flatMap((g) => { const gr = obj(g); const count = num(gr?.count); const grade = text(gr?.grade, 10); return gr && grade && count != null ? [{ grade, count }] : [] })
    return [{ company, total: num(report.total) ?? grades.reduce((sum, g) => sum + g.count, 0), grades: grades.sort((a, b) => gradeValue(b.grade) - gradeValue(a.grade)) }]
  })
  raw.sort((a, b) => conditionRank(a.condition) - conditionRank(b.condition) || a.flags.length - b.flags.length)
  graded.sort((a, b) => a.company.localeCompare(b.company) || gradeValue(b.grade) - gradeValue(a.grade) || a.flags.length - b.flags.length)
  if (!raw.length && !graded.length && !pop.length) return null
  return { name, label: variantLabel(name), raw, graded, pop }
}

// --- matching a TCGdex card to a Scrydex card --------------------------------
export interface MatchInput { name: string; localId: string; setName: string; official?: number }
const normalize = (value: string) => value.normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, ' ').trim()
const quote = (value: string) => `"${value.replace(/["\\]/g, ' ').trim()}"`

async function findMatch(input: MatchInput): Promise<{ id: string; expansionId: string } | null> {
  const number = input.localId.replace(/^0+(?=\d)/, '')
  const body = obj(await request('/cards', { q: `name:${quote(input.name)} number:${quote(number)}`, page_size: '25', select: 'id,name,number,language_code,expansion' }))
  const candidates = arr(body?.data).flatMap((item) => {
    const card = obj(item); const expansion = obj(card?.expansion)
    const id = text(card?.id); const expansionId = text(expansion?.id, 50)
    if (!card || !CARD_ID.test(id) || !EXPANSION_ID.test(expansionId)) return []
    if (text(card.language_code, 4) && text(card.language_code, 4).toUpperCase() !== 'EN') return []
    return [{ id, expansionId, expansionName: normalize(text(expansion?.name, 120)), printedTotal: num(expansion?.printed_total) }]
  })
  const setName = normalize(input.setName)
  const best = candidates.find((c) => c.expansionName === setName)
    ?? candidates.find((c) => !!setName && (c.expansionName.includes(setName) || setName.includes(c.expansionName)) && (!input.official || c.printedTotal === input.official))
    ?? (input.official ? candidates.filter((c) => c.printedTotal === input.official) : []).at(0)
    ?? (candidates.length === 1 ? candidates[0] : undefined)
  return best ? { id: best.id, expansionId: best.expansionId } : null
}

const matchCached = unstable_cache(findMatch, ['scrydex-match-v1'], { revalidate: 7 * 86400, tags: [SCRYDEX_TAG, 'scrydex-match'] })

async function fetchCard(id: string): Promise<ScrydexCard | null> {
  let body: Obj | null
  try { body = obj(await request(`/cards/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, { include: 'prices,pop_reports' })) }
  catch (error) {
    // Fall back to prices only if the combined include is rejected.
    if (!(error instanceof ScrydexHttpError) || error.status !== 400) throw error
    body = obj(await request(`/cards/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, { include: 'prices' }))
  }
  const card = obj(body?.data) ?? body
  if (!card) return null
  const expansion = obj(card.expansion)
  return {
    id, expansionId: text(expansion?.id, 50), expansionName: text(expansion?.name, 120),
    variants: arr(card.variants).slice(0, 12).map(variant).filter((v): v is ScrydexVariant => !!v)
  }
}

async function fetchHistory(id: string, variantName: string): Promise<PriceHistory | null> {
  const body = obj(await request(`/cards/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/price_history`, { days: '90', variant: variantName, condition: 'NM', page_size: '100' }))
  let currency = 'USD'
  const points: HistoryPoint[] = arr(body?.data).flatMap((day) => {
    const row = obj(day); const date = text(row?.date, 10)
    if (!row || !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(date)) return []
    const price = arr(row.prices).map(obj).find((p) => p && (p.type ?? 'raw') === 'raw' && (p.condition ?? 'NM') === 'NM' && (!p.variant || p.variant === variantName) && p.is_perfect !== true && p.is_signed !== true && p.is_error !== true)
    const market = num(price?.market)
    if (!price || market == null) return []
    currency = text(price.currency, 4) || currency
    return [{ date, market, low: num(price.low) }]
  }).sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date))
  return points.length >= 2 ? { variant: variantName, condition: 'NM', currency, points } : null
}

export type ScrydexResult =
  | { status: 'disabled' }
  | { status: 'unmatched' }
  | { status: 'error' }
  | { status: 'ok'; card: ScrydexCard; history: PriceHistory | null }

/** Scrydex covers English prints here; TCGdex names in other languages cannot be matched reliably. */
export async function getScrydexMarket(input: MatchInput, lang: string): Promise<ScrydexResult> {
  if (!scrydexEnabled() || lang !== 'en') return { status: 'disabled' }
  try {
    const match = await matchCached(input)
    if (!match) return { status: 'unmatched' }
    // Per-expansion tags let the webhook refresh exactly the expansions whose prices changed.
    const tags = [SCRYDEX_TAG, 'scrydex-prices', scrydexExpansionTag(match.expansionId)]
    const card = await unstable_cache(fetchCard, ['scrydex-card-v1'], { revalidate: 12 * 3600, tags })(match.id)
    if (!card || !card.variants.length) return { status: 'unmatched' }
    const primary = card.variants.find((v) => v.raw.some((p) => p.condition === 'NM' && p.market != null)) ?? card.variants[0]!
    const history = await unstable_cache(fetchHistory, ['scrydex-history-v1'], { revalidate: 12 * 3600, tags })(match.id, primary.name).catch(() => null)
    return { status: 'ok', card, history }
  } catch {
    return { status: 'error' }
  }
}

import 'server-only'
import TCGdex from '@tcgdex/sdk'
import type { CardLanguage } from '../domain'

/** The SDK's documented fetch hook is confined to TCGdex; global fetch is unchanged. */
TCGdex.fetch=async(input,init)=>{
  const url=new URL(input instanceof Request?input.url:String(input))
  if(url.protocol!=='https:'||url.hostname!=='api.tcgdex.net'||!url.pathname.startsWith('/v2/'))throw new Error('TCGDEX_ENDPOINT')
  const response=await fetch(input,{...init,signal:AbortSignal.timeout(8000),cache:'no-store'})
  if(response.status!==200&&response.status!==404)throw new Error(`TCGDEX_HTTP_${response.status}`)
  return response
}

File: src/features/card-library/server/tcgdex-pricing.ts
