import 'server-only'
import { variantLabel, type CardMarket, type CardmarketRow, type TcgplayerVariant } from '../pricing'

/**
 * TCGdex embeds marketplace data in each card under `pricing` (TCGplayer in USD, Cardmarket in EUR).
 * The shape is parsed defensively: unknown keys are ignored and a malformed block simply hides that panel.
 */
const num = (value: unknown) => (typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value) && value >= 0 ? value : null)
const str = (value: unknown) => (typeof value === 'string' && value.length <= 40 ? value : null)
const record = (value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> | null => (value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value) ? value as Record<string, unknown> : null)

const TCGPLAYER_ORDER = ['normal', 'holofoil', 'holo', 'reverse-holofoil', 'reverseHolofoil', 'reverse', '1st-edition', '1stEditionNormal', '1st-edition-holofoil', '1stEditionHolofoil', 'unlimited', 'unlimitedHolofoil']

function tcgplayer(input: unknown): CardMarket['tcgplayer'] {
  const block = record(input)
  if (!block) return null
  const variants: TcgplayerVariant[] = []
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(block)) {
    const row = record(value)
    if (!row || variants.length >= 12 || !/^[a-zA-Z0-9-]{1,40}$/.test(key)) continue
    const variant = { key, label: variantLabel(key), low: num(row.lowPrice), mid: num(row.midPrice), high: num(row.highPrice), market: num(row.marketPrice), directLow: num(row.directLowPrice) }
    if ([variant.low, variant.mid, variant.high, variant.market, variant.directLow].some((price) => price != null)) variants.push(variant)
  }
  if (!variants.length) return null
  const rank = (key: string) => { const index = TCGPLAYER_ORDER.indexOf(key); return index < 0 ? 99 : index }
  variants.sort((a, b) => rank(a.key) - rank(b.key))
  return { updated: str(block.updated), currency: str(block.unit) ?? 'USD', variants }
}

function cardmarket(input: unknown): CardMarket['cardmarket'] {
  const block = record(input)
  if (!block) return null
  const pick = (suffix: string, label: string): CardmarketRow => ({
    label, avg: num(block[`avg${suffix}`]), low: num(block[`low${suffix}`]), trend: num(block[`trend${suffix}`]),
    avg1: num(block[`avg1${suffix}`]), avg7: num(block[`avg7${suffix}`]), avg30: num(block[`avg30${suffix}`])
  })
  const filled = (row: CardmarketRow) => [row.avg, row.low, row.trend, row.avg1, row.avg7, row.avg30].some((value) => value != null)
  const rows = [pick('', 'Thường'), pick('-holo', 'Holo / Reverse')].filter(filled)
  if (!rows.length) return null
  return { updated: str(block.updated), currency: str(block.unit) ?? 'EUR', rows }
}

export function parseTcgdexPricing(input: unknown): CardMarket {
  const block = record(input)
  return { tcgplayer: tcgplayer(block?.tcgplayer), cardmarket: cardmarket(block?.cardmarket) }
}

import { gsap } from 'gsap'
import { ScrollTrigger } from 'gsap/ScrollTrigger'
import { mountLibraryPortalMotion } from './library-portal'
import { mountPreorderDropMotion } from './preorder-drop'
import { subscribeHomeScroll } from './scroll-events'

export function mountHomeMotion(root: HTMLElement) {
  gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger)
  let disposed = false
  let unmountLibraryPortal: (() => void) | undefined
  let unmountPreorderDrop: (() => void) | undefined
  const unsubscribeScroll = subscribeHomeScroll(() => ScrollTrigger.update())
  const context = gsap.context(() => {}, root)
  const destroy = () => {
    if (disposed) return
    disposed = true
    unsubscribeScroll()
    unmountPreorderDrop?.()
    unmountLibraryPortal?.()
    context.revert()
    delete root.dataset.homeMotion
  }
  try {
    context.add(() => {
      root.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[data-home-reveal]').forEach(element => {
        if (element.getBoundingClientRect().top < window.innerHeight * .9) return
        gsap.fromTo(element, { y: 26, opacity: .15 }, {
          y: 0, opacity: 1, duration: .75, ease: 'power2.out', clearProps: 'transform,opacity',
          scrollTrigger: { trigger: element, start: 'top 92%', once: true }
        })
      })
      const desktop = window.matchMedia('(min-width: 900px) and (pointer: fine)').matches
      if (desktop) {
        root.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[data-home-parallax]').forEach(element => {
          gsap.fromTo(element, { yPercent: -3 }, {
            yPercent: 3, ease: 'none',
            scrollTrigger: { trigger: element.parentElement, start: 'top bottom', end: 'bottom top', scrub: .7 }
          })
        })
      }
      const stamp = root.querySelector('[data-home-stamp]')
      const hero = root.querySelector('[data-home-hero]')
      if (stamp && hero) gsap.to(stamp, { rotation: 32, ease: 'none', scrollTrigger: { trigger: hero, start: 'top top', end: 'bottom top', scrub: .8 } })

      unmountLibraryPortal = mountLibraryPortalMotion(root)
      unmountPreorderDrop = mountPreorderDropMotion(root)
    })
    const refresh = () => { if (!disposed) ScrollTrigger.refresh() }
    void document.fonts?.ready.then(refresh)
    refresh()
    root.dataset.homeMotion = 'ready'
    return destroy
  } catch (error) {
    destroy()
    throw error
  }
}

import { gsap } from 'gsap'
import { DrawSVGPlugin } from 'gsap/DrawSVGPlugin'
import { MotionPathPlugin } from 'gsap/MotionPathPlugin'

/** The server component stays visible without JS; this module only owns its motion. */
export function mountLibraryPortalMotion(root: HTMLElement) {
  const portal = root.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[data-library-portal]')
  if (!portal) return () => {}
  gsap.registerPlugin(DrawSVGPlugin, MotionPathPlugin)
  const media = gsap.matchMedia()
  try {
    media.add('(min-width: 900px) and (pointer: fine) and (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)', () => {
      const art = portal.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[data-library-art]')
      const orbit = portal.querySelector<SVGSVGElement>('[data-library-orbit]')
      const path = portal.querySelector<SVGPathElement>('[data-library-path]')
      const marker = portal.querySelector<SVGCircleElement>('[data-library-marker]')
      if (art) gsap.fromTo(art, { rotation: -1.8, scale: .97 }, {
        rotation: 0, scale: 1, ease: 'none',
        scrollTrigger: { trigger: art, start: 'top 92%', end: 'center 50%', scrub: .7 }
      })
      if (orbit && path && marker) {
        const timeline = gsap.timeline({ scrollTrigger: { trigger: art ?? portal, start: 'top 92%', end: 'bottom 45%', scrub: .7 } })
        timeline.fromTo(path, { drawSVG: '0%' }, { drawSVG: '100%', duration: 1, ease: 'none' }, 0)
        timeline.to(marker, { motionPath: { path, align: path, alignOrigin: [.5, .5] }, duration: 1, ease: 'none' }, 0)
        timeline.fromTo(orbit, { rotation: -8 }, { rotation: 16, duration: 1, ease: 'none' }, 0)
      }
    }, portal)
    return () => media.revert()
  } catch (error) {
    media.revert()
    throw error
  }
}

/** Lazy motion can finish loading after a route change; only the current mount owns it. */
export function createMotionLifecycle(load: () => Promise<() => (() => void)>, onError?: (error: unknown) => void) {
  let generation = 0
  let disposed = false
  let cleanup: (() => void) | undefined
  return {
    async configure(enabled: boolean) {
      const current = ++generation
      cleanup?.(); cleanup = undefined
      if (!enabled || disposed) return
      try {
        const mount = await load()
        if (!disposed && current === generation) cleanup = mount()
      } catch (error) {
        if (!disposed && current === generation) onError?.(error)
        // All content and native scrolling work when animation cannot load.
        if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development') console.warn('Homepage motion could not start:', error)
      }
    },
    destroy() {
      disposed = true; generation++
      cleanup?.(); cleanup = undefined
    }
  }
}

import { gsap } from 'gsap'

export function mountPreorderDropMotion(root: HTMLElement) {
  const section = root.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[data-preorder-drop]')
  if (!section) return () => {}
  const media = gsap.matchMedia()
  try {
    media.add('(min-width: 900px) and (pointer: fine) and (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)', () => {
      const stage = section.querySelector('[data-preorder-stage]')
      const art = section.querySelector('[data-preorder-art]')
      const cards = section.querySelectorAll('[data-preorder-card]')
      if (art) gsap.fromTo(art, { rotation: -5, y: 20 }, { rotation: -1, y: -12, ease: 'none', scrollTrigger: { trigger: stage ?? section, start: 'top 92%', end: 'bottom 38%', scrub: .8 } })
      if (cards.length) gsap.fromTo(cards, { y: 28 }, { y: 0, duration: .7, stagger: .1, ease: 'power2.out', clearProps: 'transform', scrollTrigger: { trigger: stage ?? section, start: 'top 87%', once: true } })
    }, section)
    return () => media.revert()
  } catch (error) { media.revert(); throw error }
}

const listeners = new Set<() => void>()
export function subscribeHomeScroll(listener: () => void) {
  listeners.add(listener)
  return () => { listeners.delete(listener) }
}
export function publishHomeScroll() {
  for (const listener of listeners) {
    try { listener() } catch (error) { if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development') console.warn('Scroll effect could not update:', error) }
  }
}

File: src/features/home/animation/smooth-scroll.ts
================
import Lenis from 'lenis'
import { gsap } from 'gsap'
import { publishHomeScroll } from './scroll-events'
import 'lenis/dist/lenis.css'

/**
 * Wheel smoothing for the shop (V14.8).
 * - Keeps the 1.1 s ease-out curve: measured against lerp 0.06–0.12 and other curves, none was steadier,
 *   and lerp 0.12 pulsed more between wheel notches.
 * - `force` (used by the shop shell) keeps smoothing on even when the OS asks for reduced motion: many Windows
 *   machines report that setting by default, which silently turned Lenis off in V14.8.
 * - While the page moves, html[data-scrolling] switches off hover hit-testing, so image zooms and card lifts
 *   do not start under the cursor mid-scroll. Those repaints were the occasional hitches.
 */
const SETTLE_MS = 140

export function mountHomeSmoothScroll(root: HTMLElement, force = false) {
  const headerHeight = document.querySelector('.shop-header')?.getBoundingClientRect().height ?? 64
  const lenis = new Lenis({
    smoothWheel: true, syncTouch: false, autoRaf: false,
    lerp: 0, duration: 1.1, easing: value => 1 - Math.pow(1 - value, 3), wheelMultiplier: 1, touchMultiplier: 1,
    respectReducedMotion: !force, stopInertiaOnNavigate: true,
    anchors: { offset: -headerHeight - 16 },
    virtualScroll: ({ event }) => !event.shiftKey && !event.ctrlKey,
    prevent: node => !!node.closest('[role="dialog"],dialog,input,textarea,select,[contenteditable],[data-lenis-prevent]')
  })
  const html = document.documentElement
  const hoverDevice = window.matchMedia('(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)').matches
  let disposed = false
  let observer: MutationObserver | undefined
  let settle = 0
  const tick = () => lenis.raf(performance.now())
  const lock = () => {
    if (html.style.overflow === 'hidden' || document.body.style.overflow === 'hidden') lenis.stop()
    else lenis.start()
  }
  const onScroll = () => {
    if (!hoverDevice) return
    if (!html.hasAttribute('data-scrolling')) html.setAttribute('data-scrolling', '')
    window.clearTimeout(settle)
    settle = window.setTimeout(() => html.removeAttribute('data-scrolling'), SETTLE_MS)
  }
  const destroy = () => {
    if (disposed) return
    disposed = true
    observer?.disconnect()
    window.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll)
    window.clearTimeout(settle)
    html.removeAttribute('data-scrolling')
    gsap.ticker.remove(tick)
    lenis.off('scroll', publishHomeScroll)
    lenis.destroy()
    delete root.dataset.homeScroll
  }
  try {
    observer = new MutationObserver(lock)
    observer.observe(html, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['style'] })
    observer.observe(document.body, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['style'] })
    lock()
    lenis.on('scroll', publishHomeScroll)
    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true })
    gsap.ticker.add(tick)
    root.dataset.homeScroll = 'ready'
    return destroy
  } catch (error) { destroy(); throw error }
}

File: src/features/home/carousel/model.ts

export interface CarouselState {
  count: number
  index: number
  previous: number | null
  pending: number | null
  ready: number[]
  failed: number[]
  attempts: number[]
}
export type CarouselAction = { type: 'request' | 'ready' | 'failed'; index: number } | { type: 'step'; delta: number }

export function initialCarousel(count: number): CarouselState {
  return { count, index: 0, previous: null, pending: null, ready: [], failed: [], attempts: Array(count).fill(0) as number[] }
}
export function wrapSlide(index: number, count: number) {
  return count > 0 && Number.isSafeInteger(index) ? ((index % count) + count) % count : 0
}
function commit(state: CarouselState, index: number): CarouselState {
  return { ...state, index, previous: index === state.index ? state.previous : state.index, pending: null }
}
function request(state: CarouselState, index: number): CarouselState {
  index = wrapSlide(index, state.count)
  if (state.ready.includes(index)) return commit(state, index)
  const retry = state.failed.includes(index)
  return { ...state, pending: index, failed: state.failed.filter(value => value !== index), attempts: state.attempts.map((value, i) => i === index && retry ? value + 1 : value) }
}
export function carouselReducer(state: CarouselState, action: CarouselAction): CarouselState {
  if (action.type === 'step') return request(state, (state.pending ?? state.index) + action.delta)
  if (action.type === 'request') return request(state, action.index)
  if (action.index < 0 || action.index >= state.count) return state
  if (action.type === 'ready') {
    const next = { ...state, ready: [...new Set([...state.ready, action.index])], failed: state.failed.filter(index => index !== action.index) }
    return state.pending === action.index || (state.pending === null && state.failed.includes(state.index)) ? commit(next, action.index) : next
  }
  return { ...state, ready: state.ready.filter(index => index !== action.index), failed: [...new Set([...state.failed, action.index])], pending: state.pending === action.index ? null : state.pending }
}
export function nextCandidate(state: CarouselState): number | null {
  for (let offset = 1; offset < state.count; offset++) {
    const index = wrapSlide(state.index + offset, state.count)
    if (!state.failed.includes(index)) return index
  }
  return null
}
export function mountedSlides(state: CarouselState, preload: boolean): number[] {
  // Retain decoded slides after their first visit; looping never reveals an unmounted image.
  return [...new Set([state.index, ...state.ready, state.previous, state.pending, preload ? nextCandidate(state) : null].filter((index): index is number => index !== null))]
}
export function canAutoRotate(state: CarouselState, enabled: boolean) {
  const next = nextCandidate(state)
  return enabled && state.pending === null && next !== null && state.ready.includes(state.index) && state.ready.includes(next)
}

export function swipeDirection(dx: number, dy: number): -1 | 0 | 1 {
  return Math.abs(dx) >= 50 && Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy) * 1.3 ? dx < 0 ? 1 : -1 : 0
}

File: src/features/home/carousel/use-hero-carousel.ts

'use client'

import { useCallback, useEffect, useReducer, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { canAutoRotate, carouselReducer, initialCarousel, mountedSlides, nextCandidate } from './model'
import { HERO_INTERVAL, HERO_SLIDES } from './slides'

export function useHeroCarousel() {
  const [state, dispatch] = useReducer(carouselReducer, HERO_SLIDES.length, initialCarousel)
  const stage = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const [wanted, setWanted] = useState(true)
  const [focusStopped, setFocusStopped] = useState(false)
  const [pageVisible, setPageVisible] = useState(true)
  const [inView, setInView] = useState(true)

  useEffect(() => {
    const visibility = () => setPageVisible(document.visibilityState === 'visible')
    visibility()
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', visibility)
    const element = stage.current
    const observer = element && 'IntersectionObserver' in window ? new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
      setInView(entries.some(entry => entry.isIntersecting))
    }, { threshold: 0 }) : null
    if (element) observer?.observe(element)
    return () => { document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', visibility); observer?.disconnect() }
  }, [])

  // Reduced motion is handled by CSS: keep the requested rotation, without a fade.
  const rotationEnabled = wanted && !focusStopped
  const running = canAutoRotate(state, rotationEnabled && pageVisible && inView)
  const next = nextCandidate(state)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!running || next === null) return
    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => dispatch({ type: 'request', index: next }), HERO_INTERVAL)
    return () => window.clearTimeout(timer)
  }, [running, next, state.index])

  const step = useCallback((delta: number) => dispatch({ type: 'step', delta }), [])
  const ready = useCallback((index: number) => dispatch({ type: 'ready', index }), [])
  const fail = useCallback((index: number) => dispatch({ type: 'failed', index }), [])
  const toggle = () => {
    if (rotationEnabled) setWanted(false)
    else { setWanted(true); setFocusStopped(false) }
  }
  const preload = state.ready.includes(state.index) || state.failed.includes(state.index)
  return { state, stage, rotationEnabled, running, ready, fail, step, toggle,
    mounted: mountedSlides(state, preload), stopForFocus: () => setFocusStopped(true) }
}

'use client'

import { getImageProps } from 'next/image'
import Link from 'next/link'
import { useCallback, useRef, type CSSProperties, type PointerEvent } from 'react'
import { ImageOff, Pause, Play } from 'lucide-react'
import { HERO_INTERVAL, HERO_SLIDES, type HeroSlide } from '../carousel/slides'
import { swipeDirection } from '../carousel/model'
import { useHeroCarousel } from '../carousel/use-hero-carousel'
import '../hero-carousel.css'

interface ArtProps { slide: HeroSlide; index: number; first: boolean; urgent: boolean; ready: (index: number) => void; fail: (index: number) => void }

/** Art direction: wide banner on tablet/desktop, portrait banner on phones. */
function HeroArt({ slide, index, first, urgent, ready, fail }: ArtProps) {
  const shared = { alt: slide.alt, sizes: '100vw' }
  const { props: { srcSet: wide } } = getImageProps({ ...shared, src: slide.src, width: 1920, height: 784 })
  const { props: { srcSet: narrow, ...img } } = getImageProps({
    ...shared, src: slide.mobile.src, width: slide.mobile.width, height: slide.mobile.height,
    loading: 'eager', fetchPriority: first || urgent ? 'high' : 'low'
  })
  // A cached image can finish before hydration attaches onLoad.
  const markIfComplete = useCallback((element: HTMLImageElement | null) => {
    if (element?.complete && element.naturalWidth > 0) ready(index)
  }, [ready, index])
  return <picture>
    <source media="(min-width: 768px)" srcSet={wide} sizes="100vw" />
    <source srcSet={narrow} sizes="100vw" />
    {/* eslint-disable-next-line jsx-a11y/alt-text -- alt comes from getImageProps */}
    <img {...img} ref={markIfComplete} className="hp-hero-img" onLoad={() => ready(index)} onError={() => fail(index)} />
  </picture>
}

export function HomeHeroCarousel() {
  // Destructured: the hook also returns a ref, which must not be read during render.
  const { state, stage, rotationEnabled, running, mounted, ready, fail, step, toggle, stopForFocus } = useHeroCarousel()
  const gesture = useRef<{ x: number; y: number } | null>(null)
  const suppressClick = useRef(false)
  const current = HERO_SLIDES[state.index] ?? HERO_SLIDES[0]!
  const target = state.pending ?? state.index

  const finishSwipe = (event: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    const start = gesture.current; gesture.current = null
    if (!start) return
    const direction = swipeDirection(event.clientX - start.x, event.clientY - start.y)
    if (direction) { suppressClick.current = true; step(direction) }
  }

  return <section className="hp-hero" data-home-hero aria-roledescription="trình chiếu" aria-label="Sản phẩm nổi bật tại Dark Poke"
    onFocusCapture={(event) => { if (event.target.matches(':focus-visible') && !event.target.closest('.hp-hero-bar')) stopForFocus() }}>
    <div ref={stage} className="hp-hero-stage" aria-busy={state.pending !== null}
      onKeyDown={(event) => { if (event.key === 'ArrowLeft' || event.key === 'ArrowRight') { event.preventDefault(); step(event.key === 'ArrowRight' ? 1 : -1) } }}
      onPointerDown={(event) => { suppressClick.current = false; gesture.current = event.pointerType === 'touch' && event.isPrimary ? { x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY } : null }}
      onPointerUp={finishSwipe} onPointerCancel={() => { gesture.current = null }}
      onClickCapture={(event) => { if (suppressClick.current) { event.preventDefault(); event.stopPropagation(); suppressClick.current = false } }}>
      <div className="hp-hero-frame" aria-hidden="true" />
      {mounted.map((index) => {
        const slide = HERO_SLIDES[index]
        if (!slide) return null
        const active = index === state.index
        return <div key={slide.id} className={`hp-hero-slide ${active ? 'is-active' : ''}`} role="group" aria-roledescription="ảnh" aria-label={`${index + 1} trên ${HERO_SLIDES.length}: ${slide.name}`} aria-hidden={!active} inert={!active}>
          <div className="hp-hero-backdrop" style={{ '--hp-bd': `url("${slide.backdrop}")`, '--hp-bd-m': `url("${slide.mobile.backdrop}")` } as CSSProperties} />
          <Link prefetch={false} href={slide.href} className="hp-hero-link" tabIndex={active ? 0 : -1} aria-label={slide.action}>
            {state.failed.includes(index)
              ? <span className="hp-hero-fallback"><ImageOff size={26} aria-hidden="true" />Ảnh tạm chưa tải được · Khám phá {slide.name}</span>
              : <HeroArt key={`${slide.id}:${state.attempts[index]}`} slide={slide} index={index} first={index === 0 && state.previous === null} urgent={state.pending === index} ready={ready} fail={fail} />}
          </Link>
        </div>
      })}
      <div className="hp-hero-scrim" aria-hidden="true" />

      <div className="hp-hero-bar" data-running={running}>
        <p className="hp-hero-caption" aria-hidden="true"><span>{String(state.index + 1).padStart(2, '0')}</span>{current.name}</p>
        <div className="hp-hero-dots" role="group" aria-label="Chọn ảnh">
          {HERO_SLIDES.map((slide, index) => <button key={slide.id} type="button" className="hp-hero-dot" aria-label={`Ảnh ${index + 1}: ${slide.name}`} aria-current={index === target ? 'true' : undefined}
            onClick={() => { if (index !== target) step(index - target) }}>
            <span className="hp-hero-track"><span key={`${state.index}:${running}`} className="hp-hero-fill" style={{ '--hp-duration': `${HERO_INTERVAL}ms` } as CSSProperties} /></span>
          </button>)}
        </div>
        <button type="button" className="hp-hero-toggle" onClick={toggle} aria-label={rotationEnabled ? 'Tạm dừng tự chuyển ảnh' : 'Bật tự chuyển ảnh'}>
          {rotationEnabled ? <Pause size={14} aria-hidden="true" fill="currentColor" /> : <Play size={14} aria-hidden="true" fill="currentColor" />}
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <p className="sr-only" aria-live={running ? 'off' : 'polite'} aria-atomic="true">Ảnh {state.index + 1} trên {HERO_SLIDES.length}: {current.name}</p>
  </section>
}

File: src/features/home/components/motion-shell.tsx

'use client'

import { useEffect, useRef, type ReactNode } from 'react'
import { createMotionLifecycle } from '../animation/lifecycle'

export function HomeMotionShell({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const root = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  useEffect(() => {
    const element = root.current
    if (!element) return
    const preference = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)')
    const lifecycle = createMotionLifecycle(async () => {
      const { mountHomeMotion } = await import('../animation/controller')
      return () => mountHomeMotion(element)
    }, () => { element.dataset.homeMotion = 'error' })
    const configure = () => { void lifecycle.configure(!preference.matches) }
    preference.addEventListener('change', configure)
    configure()
    return () => { preference.removeEventListener('change', configure); lifecycle.destroy() }
  }, [])
  return <div ref={root} className="dp-home">{children}</div>
}

================
File: src/features/home/components/rail-controls.tsx
================
'use client'

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight } from 'lucide-react'

const DRAG_THRESHOLD = 6
const FLING_MS = 260

/**
 * Click-and-drag with the mouse (V14.12). Touch, pen and trackpads keep native scrolling.
 * Snap is paused while dragging, then the list glides to the nearest card and snap resumes.
 * A drag never opens the card under the cursor; a plain click still does.
 */
function enableMouseDrag(list: HTMLElement) {
  let drag: { id: number; x: number; left: number; moved: boolean; lastX: number; lastT: number; v: number } | null = null
  let suppressClick = false
  let resume = 0
  const reduce = () => window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches
  const step = () => {
    const first = list.firstElementChild as HTMLElement | null
    const gap = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(list).columnGap) || 0
    return first ? first.getBoundingClientRect().width + gap : list.clientWidth
  }
  const settle = (velocity: number) => {
    const size = step()
    const max = list.scrollWidth - list.clientWidth
    const projected = list.scrollLeft - (reduce() ? 0 : velocity * FLING_MS)
    const target = Math.max(0, Math.min(max, Math.round(projected / size) * size))
    list.scrollTo({ left: target, behavior: reduce() ? 'auto' : 'smooth' })
    window.clearTimeout(resume)
    resume = window.setTimeout(() => { delete list.dataset.dragging }, reduce() ? 0 : 520)
  }
  const down = (event: PointerEvent) => {
    if (event.pointerType !== 'mouse' || event.button !== 0) return
    window.clearTimeout(resume)
    drag = { id: event.pointerId, x: event.clientX, left: list.scrollLeft, moved: false, lastX: event.clientX, lastT: event.timeStamp, v: 0 }
  }
  const move = (event: PointerEvent) => {
    if (!drag || event.pointerId !== drag.id) return
    const dx = event.clientX - drag.x
    if (!drag.moved) {
      if (Math.abs(dx) < DRAG_THRESHOLD) return
      drag.moved = true
      list.dataset.dragging = 'true'
      list.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId)
    }
    event.preventDefault()
    list.scrollLeft = drag.left - dx
    const dt = event.timeStamp - drag.lastT
    if (dt > 0) drag.v = drag.v * 0.4 + ((event.clientX - drag.lastX) / dt) * 0.6
    drag.lastX = event.clientX; drag.lastT = event.timeStamp
  }
  const up = (event: PointerEvent) => {
    if (!drag || event.pointerId !== drag.id) return
    const { moved, v, lastT } = drag
    drag = null
    if (!moved) return
    if (list.hasPointerCapture(event.pointerId)) list.releasePointerCapture(event.pointerId)
    suppressClick = true
    window.setTimeout(() => { suppressClick = false }, 0)
    // A pause before release means the user stopped: no fling.
    settle(event.timeStamp - lastT > 80 ? 0 : v)
  }
  const click = (event: MouseEvent) => { if (suppressClick) { event.preventDefault(); event.stopPropagation(); suppressClick = false } }
  const dragStart = (event: DragEvent) => event.preventDefault()
  list.addEventListener('pointerdown', down)
  list.addEventListener('pointermove', move)
  list.addEventListener('pointerup', up)
  list.addEventListener('pointercancel', up)
  list.addEventListener('click', click, true)
  list.addEventListener('dragstart', dragStart)
  return () => {
    window.clearTimeout(resume)
    delete list.dataset.dragging
    list.removeEventListener('pointerdown', down)
    list.removeEventListener('pointermove', move)
    list.removeEventListener('pointerup', up)
    list.removeEventListener('pointercancel', up)
    list.removeEventListener('click', click, true)
    list.removeEventListener('dragstart', dragStart)
  }
}

/** Previous/next for a horizontal scroll-snap list, plus mouse drag; touch and trackpad keep native scrolling. */
export function RailControls({ target, label }: { target: string; label: string }) {
  const [edges, setEdges] = useState({ start: true, end: false })
  useEffect(() => {
    const list = document.getElementById(target)
    if (!list) return
    let frame = 0
    const measure = () => {
      frame = 0
      const max = list.scrollWidth - list.clientWidth - 2
      setEdges({ start: list.scrollLeft <= 2, end: list.scrollLeft >= max })
    }
    const schedule = () => { if (!frame) frame = requestAnimationFrame(measure) }
    schedule()
    list.addEventListener('scroll', schedule, { passive: true })
    const observer = new ResizeObserver(schedule)
    observer.observe(list)
    const stopDrag = enableMouseDrag(list)
    return () => { cancelAnimationFrame(frame); list.removeEventListener('scroll', schedule); observer.disconnect(); stopDrag() }
  }, [target])

  const move = (direction: -1 | 1) => {
    const list = document.getElementById(target)
    if (!list) return
    const reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches
    list.scrollBy({ left: direction * list.clientWidth * 0.9, behavior: reduce ? 'auto' : 'smooth' })
  }

  if (edges.start && edges.end) return null
  return <div className="hp-rail-controls" role="group" aria-label={`Cuộn ${label}`}>
    <button type="button" aria-controls={target} aria-label="Xem các sản phẩm trước" disabled={edges.start} onClick={() => move(-1)}><ChevronLeft size={18} aria-hidden="true" /></button>
    <button type="button" aria-controls={target} aria-label="Xem thêm sản phẩm" disabled={edges.end} onClick={() => move(1)}><ChevronRight size={18} aria-hidden="true" /></button>
  </div>
}

        <div className="hx-sky" aria-hidden="true"><i /><i /><i /></div>
        <div className="shop-container hx-stage-inner">
          <header className="hx-head" data-home-reveal>
            <span className="hx-eyebrow">Khám phá · {pad(tiles.length)} lối vào</span>
            <h2 id="hp-stories-title">Mọi thứ cho hành trình sưu tầm</h2>
            <p>Từ tra cứu một lá bài tới giữ suất bộ thẻ sắp phát hành. Chọn lối vào phù hợp với bạn.</p>
          </header>
          <Link prefetch={false} href={lead.href} className="hx-lead" aria-label={`${lead.title}: ${lead.action}`}>
            <span className="hx-lead-tag"><b>01</b>{lead.eyebrow}</span>
            <span className="hx-lead-title">{lead.title}</span>
            <span className="hx-lead-text">{lead.text}</span>
            <span className="hx-lead-cta">{lead.action}<ArrowUpRight size={16} aria-hidden="true" /></span>
          </Link>
        </div>
      </div>
      {deck.length ? <div className="hx-deck-wrap">
        <ul className="hx-deck" data-count={deck.length} aria-label="Các lối vào khác">
          {deck.map((story, index) => {
            const offset = index - (deck.length - 1) / 2
            return <li key={story.key} style={{ '--o': offset, '--oa': Math.abs(offset) } as CSSProperties}>
              <Link prefetch={false} href={story.href} className="hx-card">
                <span className="hx-card-bar"><span>{story.eyebrow}</span><b>{pad(index + 2)}/{pad(tiles.length)}</b></span>
                <span className="hx-card-art">
                  <Image src={story.image} alt={story.alt} fill sizes="(max-width: 1099px) 62vw, 250px" className="hx-card-img" style={story.position ? { objectPosition: story.position } : undefined} />
                </span>
                <span className="hx-card-title">{story.title}</span>
                <span className="hx-card-text">{story.text}</span>
                <span className="hx-card-foot"><span>{story.action}</span><span className="hx-card-arrow" aria-hidden="true"><ArrowUpRight size={16} strokeWidth={2} /></span></span>
              </Link>
            </li>
          })}
        </ul>
      </div> : null}
    </section> : null}

    {settings.modules.preorder ? <ProductRail id="hp-preorder" eyebrow="Sắp phát hành" title="Đặt trước bộ thẻ mới" href="/pre-order" action="Xem tất cả pre-order" items={preorders} typeNames={typeNames} variant="feature" /> : null}

    <ProductRail id="hp-latest" eyebrow="Mới về kho" title="Vừa có mặt tại Dark Poke" href="/san-pham?sort=new" action="Xem sản phẩm mới" items={latest} typeNames={typeNames} tone={settings.modules.preorder && preorders.length ? 'tint' : 'plain'} />

    <RecentlyViewed />
  </HomeMotionShell>
}

'use client'

import { useSyncExternalStore } from 'react'

export interface RecentProduct { id: string; slug: string; name: string; thumbnail: string | null; price: number; min_price: number | null; max_price: number | null }

const KEY = 'dp-recent-v1'
const LIMIT = 10
const EMPTY: RecentProduct[] = []
let items: RecentProduct[] = EMPTY
let loaded = false
const listeners = new Set<() => void>()

function isRecent(value: unknown): value is RecentProduct {
  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') return false
  const item = value as Partial<RecentProduct>
  return typeof item.id === 'string' && typeof item.slug === 'string' && /^[a-z0-9-]{2,120}$/.test(item.slug)
    && typeof item.name === 'string' && typeof item.price === 'number'
}

function load() {
  if (loaded || typeof window === 'undefined') return
  loaded = true
  try {
    const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(window.localStorage.getItem(KEY) ?? '[]')
    items = Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed.filter(isRecent).slice(0, LIMIT) : EMPTY
  } catch { items = EMPTY }
}

function subscribe(listener: () => void) {
  load()
  listeners.add(listener)
  const onStorage = (event: StorageEvent) => { if (event.key === KEY) { loaded = false; load(); listener() } }
  window.addEventListener('storage', onStorage)
  return () => { listeners.delete(listener); window.removeEventListener('storage', onStorage) }
}

/** Device-only history; nothing is sent to the server. */
export function rememberProduct(product: RecentProduct) {
  load()
  items = [product, ...items.filter((item) => item.id !== product.id)].slice(0, LIMIT)
  try { window.localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(items)) } catch { /* Private mode: keep the in-memory list. */ }
  listeners.forEach((listener) => listener())
}

export function clearRecentProducts() {
  items = EMPTY
  try { window.localStorage.removeItem(KEY) } catch { /* ignore */ }
  listeners.forEach((listener) => listener())
}

export function useRecentProducts() {
  return useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, () => { load(); return items }, () => EMPTY)
}

import 'server-only'
import { getCatalogMeta, getSettings, listProducts } from '@/lib/catalog'
import type { ProductCard } from '@/lib/types'

function unique(items: ProductCard[]) {
  return [...new Map(items.map(product => [product.id, product])).values()]
}

/** Bounded, cached reads only: three short lists, never the full catalogue. */
export async function getHomeData() {
  const [meta, settings] = await Promise.all([getCatalogMeta(), getSettings()])
  const [featured, recent, preorders] = await Promise.all([
    listProducts({ featured: true, limit: 12 }),
    listProducts({ limit: 24 }),
    settings.modules.preorder ? listProducts({ preorder: true, limit: 10 }) : Promise.resolve({ items: [] })
  ])
  const products = unique(featured.items.length ? featured.items : recent.items).slice(0, 12)
  const ids = new Set(products.map(product => product.id))
  const types = [...new Map(meta.types.filter(type => type.code !== 'hang-thuong').map(type => [type.id, type])).values()].slice(0, 4)
  return {
    settings, types, products,
    typeNames: Object.fromEntries(meta.types.map(type => [type.id, type.name])),
    preorders: unique(preorders.items).slice(0, 10),
    latest: unique(recent.items).filter(product => !ids.has(product.id)).slice(0, 12),
    accessoriesHref: meta.types.some(type => type.code === 'phu-kien') ? '/san-pham?type=phu-kien' : '/san-pham'
  }
}

export type HomeData = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof getHomeData>>

import { gsap } from 'gsap'
import { ScrollTrigger } from 'gsap/ScrollTrigger'
import Lenis from 'lenis'

export function mountTradeinMotion(root:HTMLElement) {
  gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger)
  const media=gsap.matchMedia()
  media.add('(prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)',()=>{
    const stages=root.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[data-tradein-step]')
    gsap.from(stages,{opacity:0,y:14,duration:.5,stagger:.09,ease:'power2.out'})
    const cards=root.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[data-tradein-section]')
    cards.forEach(card=>gsap.from(card,{y:18,opacity:.25,duration:.5,ease:'power2.out',scrollTrigger:{trigger:card,start:'top 93%',once:true}}))
    const line=root.querySelector('[data-tradein-line]')
    if(line)gsap.fromTo(line,{scaleX:0},{scaleX:1,transformOrigin:'left center',ease:'none',scrollTrigger:{trigger:root,start:'top top',end:'bottom bottom',scrub:.3}})
  },root)
  let lenis:Lenis|undefined;let frame=0;let refreshFrame=0
  // Keep native touch scrolling, form focus, pinch zoom and dialog scrolling.
  const desktop=window.matchMedia('(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) and (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)')
  function stop(){cancelAnimationFrame(frame);lenis?.destroy();lenis=undefined}
  function configure(){stop();if(!desktop.matches)return;lenis=new Lenis({smoothWheel:true,syncTouch:false,lerp:.12,autoRaf:false,prevent:node=>!!node.closest('dialog,textarea,select,[contenteditable],[data-lenis-prevent]')});lenis.on('scroll',ScrollTrigger.update)
    const tick=(time:number)=>{lenis?.raf(time);frame=requestAnimationFrame(tick)};frame=requestAnimationFrame(tick)
  }
  configure();desktop.addEventListener('change',configure)
  const observer=new ResizeObserver(()=>{cancelAnimationFrame(refreshFrame);refreshFrame=requestAnimationFrame(()=>{lenis?.resize();ScrollTrigger.refresh()})})
  observer.observe(root)
  return()=>{stop();cancelAnimationFrame(refreshFrame);observer.disconnect();desktop.removeEventListener('change',configure);media.revert()}
}

'use client'
import { useEffect, type RefObject } from 'react'
/** No animation library enters the initial render or form state module. */
export function useTradeinMotion(ref:RefObject<HTMLElement|null>) {
  useEffect(()=>{let active=true;let destroy:(()=>void)|undefined
    if(!ref.current||window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches)return
    void import('./controller').then(({mountTradeinMotion})=>{if(active&&ref.current)destroy=mountTradeinMotion(ref.current)}).catch(()=>{/* Native scrolling and the complete form remain available. */})
    return()=>{active=false;destroy?.()}
  },[ref])
}

import type { PhotoDescriptor, UploadTicket } from './domain'
import type { LocalPhoto } from './hooks/use-tradein-photos'
export async function photoDescriptors(photos:LocalPhoto[]):Promise<PhotoDescriptor[]> {
  const result:PhotoDescriptor[]=[]
  for(const p of photos){const digest=await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256',await p.file.arrayBuffer());result.push({item_id:p.itemId,name:p.file.name.slice(0,180),size:p.file.size,mime:p.file.type as PhotoDescriptor['mime'],sha256:Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest),n=>n.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('')})}
  return result
}
export async function uploadPhotos(ticket:UploadTicket,photos:LocalPhoto[],uploaded:Set<number>,onProgress:(count:number)=>void) {
  let cursor=0;const errors:Error[]=[]
  async function worker(){for(;;){const slot=cursor++;if(slot>=photos.length||errors.length)return;if(uploaded.has(slot))continue;const photo=photos[slot];if(!photo)return
    const controller=new AbortController();const timer=setTimeout(()=>controller.abort(),30000)
    try {
      const body=new FormData();body.set('file',photo.file)
      const response=await fetch('/api/tradein/photos',{method:'POST',headers:{'x-tradein-id':ticket.id,'x-tradein-token':ticket.token,'x-tradein-slot':String(slot)},body,signal:controller.signal})
      const result=await response.json().catch(()=>({error:response.status===413?'Ảnh vượt 2 MB.':'Chưa tải được ảnh. Vui lòng thử lại.'}))
      if(!response.ok){const e=new Error(result.error??'Chưa tải được ảnh.');if(response.status===410)e.name='UploadExpired';throw e}
      uploaded.add(slot);onProgress(uploaded.size)
    }catch(error){errors.push(error instanceof Error?error:new Error('Mất kết nối khi tải ảnh.'))}finally{clearTimeout(timer)}
  }}
  await Promise.all([worker(),worker()])
  if(errors.length)throw errors[0]
}

import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server'
import { PHOTO_BUCKET, parsePhotos } from '../domain'
import { AdminPhotoGallery } from './admin-photo-gallery'
export async function TradeinAttachments({photos}:{photos:unknown}) {
  const files=parsePhotos(photos)
  if(!files.length)return null
  // Session client + Storage RLS: only authorized staff can sign these paths.
  const sb=await createClient()
  const {data,error}=await sb.storage.from(PHOTO_BUCKET).createSignedUrls(files.map(p=>p.path),600)
  if(error)return <p className="text-sm text-bad">Chưa mở được ảnh khách gửi. Tải lại trang để thử lại.</p>
  const signed=files.map((p,i)=>({name:p.name,url:data?.[i]?.signedUrl??''})).filter(p=>p.url)
  return <AdminPhotoGallery photos={signed} total={files.length}/>
}

'use client'
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, Images, RotateCw, X } from 'lucide-react'
import '../tradein-admin.css'
export function AdminPhotoGallery({photos,total}:{photos:{name:string;url:string}[];total:number}) {
  const [expanded,setExpanded]=useState(false);const [selected,setSelected]=useState<number|null>(null);const [failed,setFailed]=useState(false)
  const dialog=useRef<HTMLDialogElement>(null);const router=useRouter()
  useEffect(()=>{const d=dialog.current;if(!d)return;if(selected!==null&&!d.open)d.showModal();if(selected===null&&d.open)d.close();if(selected===null)return
    const previous=document.documentElement.style.overflow;document.documentElement.style.overflow='hidden';return()=>{document.documentElement.style.overflow=previous}
  },[selected])
  const change=(offset:number)=>{setSelected(n=>((n??0)+offset+photos.length)%photos.length);setFailed(false)}
  return <div className="t3-admin-photos"><div><button type="button" className="btn btn-secondary" aria-expanded={expanded} onClick={()=>setExpanded(v=>!v)}><Images size={17} aria-hidden="true"/>{expanded?'Ẩn ảnh':`Xem ${total} ảnh khách gửi`}</button>{expanded?<button type="button" className="btn btn-ghost" onClick={()=>{setFailed(false);router.refresh()}}><RotateCw size={16} aria-hidden="true"/>Làm mới ảnh</button>:null}</div>
    {expanded?<><p>Ảnh riêng tư · Bấm vào ảnh để xem lớn. Liên kết xem ảnh có hiệu lực 10 phút.</p><div className="t3-admin-photo-grid">{photos.map((p,i)=><button key={p.url} type="button" onClick={()=>{setSelected(i);setFailed(false)}} aria-label={`Xem ảnh ${i+1}: ${p.name}`}><img src={p.url} alt={p.name} width={180} height={180} loading="lazy" decoding="async" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"/><span>Ảnh {i+1}</span></button>)}</div>{photos.length<total?<p role="status">Một số ảnh chưa mở được. Bấm làm mới ảnh để thử lại.</p>:null}</>:null}
    <dialog ref={dialog} className="t3-admin-dialog" aria-label="Ảnh thực tế khách gửi" onCancel={e=>{e.preventDefault();setSelected(null)}} onClose={()=>setSelected(null)} onKeyDown={e=>{if(e.key==='ArrowRight'){e.preventDefault();change(1)}if(e.key==='ArrowLeft'){e.preventDefault();change(-1)}}}>
      <header><b>Ảnh {selected===null?0:selected+1}/{photos.length}</b><button type="button" className="btn btn-ghost btn-icon" aria-label="Đóng ảnh" onClick={()=>setSelected(null)}><X size={21}/></button></header>
      {selected!==null?<div className="t3-admin-large">{failed?<p role="alert">Ảnh chưa tải được hoặc liên kết đã hết hạn. Đóng ảnh và bấm “Làm mới ảnh”.</p>:<img src={photos[selected]?.url} alt={photos[selected]?.name} width={1000} height={1000} referrerPolicy="no-referrer" onError={()=>setFailed(true)}/>}</div>:null}
      <footer><button type="button" className="btn btn-secondary" onClick={()=>change(-1)} disabled={photos.length<2}><ChevronLeft size={17}/>Ảnh trước</button><button type="button" className="btn btn-secondary" onClick={()=>change(1)} disabled={photos.length<2}>Ảnh sau<ChevronRight size={17}/></button></footer>
    </dialog>
  </div>
}

'use client'
import { useId, useRef, type ChangeEvent } from 'react'
import { useController, useFormContext, useWatch } from 'react-hook-form'
import { Minus, Plus, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react'
import { CONDITIONS, type TradeinInput } from '../domain'
import { PhotoPicker } from './photo-picker'
import { amountInWords, digitsOnly, groupThousands } from '../money'
import type { LocalPhoto } from '../hooks/use-tradein-photos'

interface Props { index: number; canRemove: boolean; photos: LocalPhoto[]; total: number; disabled: boolean; onRemove: () => void; onAddPhotos: (files: FileList | File[]) => void; onRemovePhoto: (id: string) => void }

/** One item: name, condition as tappable cards, quantity stepper, expected price and photos. */
export function ItemCard({ index, canRemove, photos, total, disabled, onRemove, onAddPhotos, onRemovePhoto }: Props) {
  const id = useId(); const { register, control, setValue, formState: { errors } } = useFormContext<TradeinInput>()
  const item = useWatch({ control, name: `items.${index}` }); const error = errors.items?.[index]
  const qty = Number.isFinite(item?.qty) ? Number(item.qty) : 1
  const step = (delta: number) => setValue(`items.${index}.qty`, Math.min(999, Math.max(1, qty + delta)), { shouldValidate: true, shouldDirty: true })
  const title = `Vật phẩm ${index + 1}`

  return <article className="tx-item" aria-label={title}>
    <div className="tx-item-head">
      <span className="tx-item-tag">{title}</span>
      <span className="tx-item-name">{item?.name?.trim() || 'Chưa có tên'}</span>
      {canRemove ? <button type="button" className="tx-item-remove" disabled={disabled} onClick={onRemove} aria-label={`Xóa ${title.toLowerCase()}`}><Trash2 size={16} aria-hidden="true" /><span>Xóa</span></button> : null}
    </div>
    <div className="tx-item-body">
      <label className="tx-field" htmlFor={`${id}-name`}>
        <span className="tx-label">Tên thẻ hoặc vật phẩm <em>*</em></span>
        <input id={`${id}-name`} className="tx-input" placeholder="Ví dụ: Charizard ex · Obsidian Flames #125" autoComplete="off" maxLength={200} aria-invalid={!!error?.name} aria-describedby={error?.name ? `${id}-name-error` : `${id}-name-hint`} {...register(`items.${index}.name`)} />
        {error?.name ? <small className="tx-error" id={`${id}-name-error`}>{error.name.message}</small> : <small className="tx-hint" id={`${id}-name-hint`}>Ghi cả tên bộ, số thẻ và ngôn ngữ nếu có.</small>}
      </label>

      <fieldset className="tx-field tx-conditions">
        <legend className="tx-label">Tình trạng hiện tại <em>*</em></legend>
        <div className="tx-choice-grid">
          {CONDITIONS.map((c) => <label key={c.value} className="tx-choice">
            <input type="radio" value={c.value} {...register(`items.${index}.condition`)} />
            <span><b>{c.label}</b><small>{c.detail}</small></span>
          </label>)}
        </div>
      </fieldset>

      {item?.condition === 'OTHER' ? <label className="tx-field" htmlFor={`${id}-note`}>
        <span className="tx-label">Mô tả tình trạng <em>*</em></span>
        <textarea id={`${id}-note`} className="tx-input" rows={3} maxLength={500} placeholder="Ví dụ: thẻ hơi cong, góc phải có vết xước nhỏ, chưa sửa chữa…" aria-invalid={!!error?.condition_note} aria-describedby={`${id}-note-hint`} {...register(`items.${index}.condition_note`)} />
        <small id={`${id}-note-hint`} className={error?.condition_note ? 'tx-error' : 'tx-hint'}>{error?.condition_note?.message ?? `${item.condition_note?.length ?? 0}/500 ký tự`}</small>
      </label> : null}

      <div className="tx-row">
        <div className="tx-field">
          <label className="tx-label" htmlFor={`${id}-qty`}>Số lượng <em>*</em></label>
          <div className="tx-stepper">
            <button type="button" onClick={() => step(-1)} disabled={disabled || qty <= 1} aria-label="Giảm số lượng"><Minus size={18} aria-hidden="true" /></button>
            <input id={`${id}-qty`} type="number" inputMode="numeric" min={1} max={999} step={1} aria-invalid={!!error?.qty} aria-describedby={error?.qty ? `${id}-qty-error` : undefined} {...register(`items.${index}.qty`, { valueAsNumber: true })} />
            <button type="button" onClick={() => step(1)} disabled={disabled || qty >= 999} aria-label="Tăng số lượng"><Plus size={18} aria-hidden="true" /></button>
          </div>
          {error?.qty ? <small className="tx-error" id={`${id}-qty-error`}>{error.qty.message}</small> : null}
        </div>
        <PriceField id={`${id}-expected`} index={index} />
      </div>

      <PhotoPicker photos={photos} total={total} itemName={item?.name ?? ''} disabled={disabled} onAdd={onAddPhotos} onRemove={onRemovePhoto} />
    </div>
  </article>
}

/** Expected price: stored as plain digits, shown as 1.000.000 while typing, with the amount in words underneath. */
function PriceField({ id, index }: { id: string; index: number }) {
  const { control } = useFormContext<TradeinInput>()
  const { field, fieldState } = useController({ control, name: `items.${index}.expected` })
  const input = useRef<HTMLInputElement | null>(null)
  const digits = digitsOnly(String(field.value ?? ''))
  const words = amountInWords(digits)
  const onChange = (event: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const el = event.target; const caret = el.selectionStart ?? el.value.length
    const before = digitsOnly(el.value.slice(0, caret)).length
    const next = digitsOnly(el.value); field.onChange(next)
    // Put the caret back after the same number of digits once the dots are re-inserted.
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      const node = input.current; if (!node || document.activeElement !== node) return
      const shown = groupThousands(next); let pos = 0; let seen = 0
      while (pos < shown.length && seen < before) { if (/\d/.test(shown.charAt(pos))) seen++; pos++ }
      node.setSelectionRange(pos, pos)
    })
  }
  return <div className="tx-field">
    <label className="tx-label" htmlFor={id}>Giá mong muốn <small>Không bắt buộc</small></label>
    <span className="tx-money">
      <input id={id} className="tx-input" inputMode="numeric" autoComplete="off" placeholder="Ví dụ: 450.000" maxLength={15}
        ref={(node) => { input.current = node; field.ref(node) }} name={field.name} value={groupThousands(digits)} onChange={onChange} onBlur={field.onBlur}
        aria-invalid={!!fieldState.error} aria-describedby={`${id}-words`} />
      <b aria-hidden="true">₫</b>
    </span>
    <small id={`${id}-words`} className={fieldState.error ? 'tx-error' : 'tx-hint tx-words'} aria-live="polite">{fieldState.error?.message ?? (words || 'Số tiền bằng chữ sẽ hiện ở đây.')}</small>
  </div>
}

'use client'
import { useId, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { Camera, Expand, ImagePlus, X } from 'lucide-react'
import { ShopDialog } from '@/components/shop/dialog'
import { MAX_PHOTOS } from '../domain'
import type { LocalPhoto } from '../hooks/use-tradein-photos'
interface Props { photos: LocalPhoto[]; total: number; itemName: string; disabled: boolean; onAdd: (files: FileList | File[]) => void; onRemove: (id: string) => void }

/** Photos for one item: a drop zone with shooting tips, then thumbnails that open larger. */
export function PhotoPicker({ photos, total, itemName, disabled, onAdd, onRemove }: Props) {
  const input = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null); const id = useId(); const [selected, setSelected] = useState<LocalPhoto | null>(null)
  const [dragging, setDragging] = useState(false)
  const full = total >= MAX_PHOTOS; const label = itemName || 'vật phẩm'
  return <div className="tx-field tx-photos">
    <div className="tx-photo-head"><span className="tx-label">Ảnh thực tế <small>Không bắt buộc</small></span><span className="tx-hint">{total}/{MAX_PHOTOS} ảnh cho cả yêu cầu</span></div>
    <input ref={input} id={id} className="sr-only" type="file" accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp" multiple disabled={disabled || full} aria-label={`Chọn ảnh cho ${label}`} onChange={(e) => { if (e.target.files) onAdd(e.target.files); e.target.value = '' }} />
    <div className={`tx-drop${dragging ? ' is-dragging' : ''}`} onDragOver={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); if (!disabled) setDragging(true) }} onDragLeave={() => setDragging(false)} onDrop={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); setDragging(false); if (!disabled) onAdd(e.dataTransfer.files) }}>
      {photos.length ? <div className="tx-photo-grid">
        {photos.map((p, index) => <div className="tx-photo" key={p.id}>
          <button type="button" className="tx-photo-open" aria-label={`Xem ảnh ${index + 1} của ${label}`} onClick={() => setSelected(p)}><img src={p.url} alt={`Ảnh thực tế ${index + 1} của ${label}`} width={180} height={180} loading="lazy" decoding="async" /><span><Expand size={14} aria-hidden="true" /></span></button>
          <button type="button" className="tx-photo-remove" disabled={disabled} onClick={() => onRemove(p.id)} aria-label={`Xóa ảnh ${index + 1} của ${label}`}><X size={16} aria-hidden="true" /></button>
        </div>)}
        <button type="button" className="tx-photo-more" disabled={disabled || full} onClick={() => input.current?.click()}><ImagePlus size={22} aria-hidden="true" /><span>Thêm ảnh</span></button>
      </div> : <div className="tx-photo-empty">
        <span className="tx-photo-icon"><Camera size={24} strokeWidth={1.6} aria-hidden="true" /></span>
        <div><b>Kéo ảnh vào đây hoặc chọn từ máy</b><p>Nên chụp mặt trước, mặt sau và các góc có vết xước.</p></div>
        <button type="button" className="btn btn-secondary" disabled={disabled || full} onClick={() => input.current?.click()}><ImagePlus size={17} aria-hidden="true" />Chọn ảnh</button>
      </div>}
    </div>
    <small className="tx-hint">JPG, PNG hoặc WebP, mỗi ảnh tối đa 2 MB.</small>
    <ShopDialog open={!!selected} onClose={() => setSelected(null)} title="Ảnh vật phẩm đã chọn" wide><div className="tx-preview">{selected ? <img src={selected.url} alt={`Ảnh thực tế của ${label}`} width={800} height={800} /> : null}</div><p className="tx-caption">{selected?.file.name}</p></ShopDialog>
  </div>
}

import { useFormContext, useWatch } from 'react-hook-form'
import { ArrowRight, Loader2, ShieldCheck } from 'lucide-react'
import { MAX_PHOTOS, type TradeinInput } from '../domain'

const METHOD = { store: 'Mang đến cửa hàng', ship: 'Gửi qua vận chuyển' } as const

/** Sticky summary on desktop, last block on phones: what is being sent, and the submit button. */
export function TradeinSummary({ quoteHours, photos, pending, error, progress }: { quoteHours: number; photos: number; pending: boolean; error: string; progress: string }) {
  const { control } = useFormContext<TradeinInput>()
  const [items, method, payout] = useWatch({ control, name: ['items', 'method', 'payout'] })
  const list = items ?? []
  const named = list.filter((i) => (i?.name ?? '').trim().length >= 2).length
  const qty = list.reduce((sum, i) => sum + (Number.isFinite(i?.qty) ? Number(i.qty) : 0), 0)

import { z } from 'zod'

export const MAX_PHOTOS = 14
export const MAX_PHOTO_BYTES = 2 * 1024 * 1024
export const PHOTO_BUCKET = 'tradein-photos'
export const PHOTO_TYPES = ['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp'] as const
export const CONDITIONS = [
  { value: 'NM', label: 'Gần như mới', detail: 'Bề mặt, góc và cạnh còn đẹp' },
  { value: 'LP', label: 'Xước nhẹ', detail: 'Có dấu sử dụng nhẹ' },
  { value: 'MP', label: 'Xước rõ', detail: 'Có nhiều dấu sử dụng' },
  { value: 'HP', label: 'Hư hại / xước nhiều', detail: 'Cong, móp hoặc hư hại dễ thấy' },
  { value: 'Seal', label: 'Còn nguyên niêm phong', detail: 'Chưa mở sản phẩm' },
  { value: 'Grading', label: 'Đã được chấm điểm', detail: 'Thẻ trong hộp của đơn vị chấm điểm' },
  { value: 'OTHER', label: 'Khác', detail: 'Tự mô tả tình trạng bên dưới' }
] as const

export const itemSchema = z.object({
  client_id: z.string().regex(/^item-[a-zA-Z0-9-]{1,64}$/),
  name: z.string().trim().min(2, 'Nhập tên vật phẩm, ít nhất 2 ký tự.').max(200, 'Tên tối đa 200 ký tự.'),
  condition: z.enum(['NM', 'LP', 'MP', 'HP', 'Seal', 'Grading', 'OTHER']),
  condition_note: z.string().trim().max(500, 'Mô tả tối đa 500 ký tự.'),
  qty: z.number({error:'Nhập số lượng hợp lệ.'}).int('Số lượng phải là số nguyên.').min(1, 'Số lượng ít nhất là 1.').max(999, 'Số lượng tối đa là 999.'),
  expected: z.string().regex(/^\d{0,12}$/, 'Chỉ nhập số, tối đa 12 chữ số.')
}).superRefine((item, ctx) => {
  if (item.condition === 'OTHER' && item.condition_note.length < 5) ctx.addIssue({ code: 'custom', path: ['condition_note'], message: 'Mô tả tình trạng ít nhất 5 ký tự.' })
})
export const tradeinSchema = z.object({
  items: z.array(itemSchema).min(1, 'Thêm ít nhất một vật phẩm.').max(50, 'Tối đa 50 vật phẩm.').refine(a => new Set(a.map(i => i.client_id)).size === a.length, 'Mã vật phẩm bị trùng.'),
  name: z.string().trim().min(2, 'Nhập họ tên để shop liên hệ.').max(120),
  phone: z.string().transform(v => v.replace(/[\s.()-]/g, '')).pipe(z.string().regex(/^(0|\+84)[0-9]{9,10}$/, 'Số điện thoại chưa đúng, ví dụ 0901234567.')),
  email: z.union([z.literal(''), z.email('Email chưa đúng.')]),
  method: z.enum(['store', 'ship']), payout: z.enum(['cash', 'credit']),
  note: z.string().trim().max(1000, 'Ghi chú tối đa 1.000 ký tự.')
})
export type TradeinInput = z.input<typeof tradeinSchema>
export type TradeinValues = z.output<typeof tradeinSchema>
export const photoDescriptorSchema = z.object({
  item_id: itemSchema.shape.client_id,
  name: z.string().min(1).max(180),
  size: z.number().int().min(1).max(MAX_PHOTO_BYTES),
  mime: z.enum(PHOTO_TYPES),
  sha256: z.string().regex(/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/)
})
export type PhotoDescriptor = z.infer<typeof photoDescriptorSchema>
export const ticketSchema = z.object({ id: z.uuid(), token: z.string().regex(/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/) })
export type UploadTicket = z.infer<typeof ticketSchema>
export const storedPhotoSchema = photoDescriptorSchema.extend({ slot: z.number().int().min(0).max(13), path: z.string().regex(/^[a-f0-9-]{36}\/(?:[0-9]|1[0-3])\.(?:jpg|png|webp)$/) })
export type StoredPhoto = z.infer<typeof storedPhotoSchema>
export function parsePhotos(value: unknown): StoredPhoto[] { const r = z.array(storedPhotoSchema).max(MAX_PHOTOS).safeParse(value); return r.success ? r.data : [] }
export function conditionLabel(value?: string) { return CONDITIONS.find(c => c.value === value)?.label ?? value ?? '' }
export function blankItem(client_id = 'item-1'): TradeinInput['items'][number] { return { client_id, name: '', condition: 'NM', condition_note: '', qty: 1, expected: '' } }
export function photoFileError(file: Pick<File, 'name' | 'size' | 'type'>) {
  if (!PHOTO_TYPES.includes(file.type as typeof PHOTO_TYPES[number])) return `${file.name}: chỉ nhận ảnh JPG, PNG hoặc WebP.`
  if (file.size <= 0) return `${file.name}: ảnh trống hoặc không đọc được.`
  if (file.size > MAX_PHOTO_BYTES) return `${file.name}: vượt 2 MB. Hãy giảm dung lượng trước khi thêm.`
  return null
}
export function serializeTradein(v: TradeinValues) {
  return { ...v, items: v.items.map(i => ({ client_id: i.client_id, name: i.name, condition: i.condition, condition_note: i.condition === 'OTHER' ? i.condition_note : '', qty: i.qty, expected: i.expected ? Number(i.expected) : null })) }
}

'use client'
import { useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { useFieldArray, useForm } from 'react-hook-form'
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod'
import { prepareTradein, submitTradein } from '@/lib/actions/tradein'
import { isDemo } from '@/lib/env'
import { blankItem, tradeinSchema, type TradeinInput, type TradeinValues, type UploadTicket } from '../domain'
import { photoDescriptors, uploadPhotos } from '../client-upload'
import { useTradeinPhotos } from './use-tradein-photos'
interface Attempt {signature:string;ticket:UploadTicket;uploaded:Set<number>;createdAt:number;demo:boolean}
const defaults=():TradeinInput=>({items:[blankItem()],name:'',phone:'',email:'',method:'store',payout:'cash',note:''})
export function useTradeinForm() {
  const form=useForm<TradeinInput,unknown,TradeinValues>({resolver:zodResolver(tradeinSchema),defaultValues:defaults(),mode:'onBlur',reValidateMode:'onChange'})
  const fields=useFieldArray({control:form.control,name:'items'})
  const media=useTradeinPhotos();const attempt=useRef<Attempt|null>(null)
  const [error,setError]=useState('');const [progress,setProgress]=useState('');const [success,setSuccess]=useState<string|null>(null)
  const submit=form.handleSubmit(async values=>{
    setError('');setProgress('Đang chuẩn bị yêu cầu…')
    const signature=JSON.stringify([values,media.photos.map(p=>p.id)])
    try {
      let current=attempt.current
      if(!current||current.signature!==signature||Date.now()-current.createdAt>115*60000){
        const descriptors=await photoDescriptors(media.photos)
        const result=await prepareTradein(values,descriptors)
        if(!result.ok||!result.data)throw new Error(!result.ok?result.error:'Chưa tạo được phiên gửi.')
        current={signature,ticket:{id:result.data.id,token:result.data.token},uploaded:new Set(),createdAt:Date.now(),demo:!!result.data.demo}
        attempt.current=current
      }
      if(!current.demo&&media.photos.length){
        setProgress(`Đang tải ảnh ${current.uploaded.size}/${media.photos.length}…`)
        await uploadPhotos(current.ticket,media.photos,current.uploaded,n=>setProgress(`Đang tải ảnh ${n}/${media.photos.length}…`))
      }
      setProgress('Đang xác nhận yêu cầu…')
      const result=await submitTradein(current.ticket)
      if(!result.ok||!result.data)throw new Error(!result.ok?result.error:'Chưa nhận được xác nhận.')
      setSuccess(result.data.code);media.reset();attempt.current=null
    }catch(e){if(e instanceof Error&&e.name==='UploadExpired')attempt.current=null;setError(e instanceof Error&&e.name!=='AbortError'?e.message:'Kết nối bị gián đoạn. Bấm gửi lại để tiếp tục tải ảnh còn thiếu.')}finally{setProgress('')}
  })
  function addItem(){fields.append(blankItem(`item-${crypto.randomUUID()}`))}
  function removeItem(index:number){media.removeItem(form.getValues(`items.${index}.client_id`));fields.remove(index)}
  function reset(){form.reset(defaults());media.reset();attempt.current=null;setSuccess(null);setError('')}
  return {form,fields,media,submit,addItem,removeItem,error,progress,success,reset,isDemo}
}

File: src/features/tradein/hooks/use-tradein-photos.ts

'use client'
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { MAX_PHOTOS, photoFileError } from '../domain'
export interface LocalPhoto { id: string; itemId: string; file: File; url: string }
export function useTradeinPhotos() {
  const [photos,setPhotos] = useState<LocalPhoto[]>([])
  const [errors,setErrors] = useState<string[]>([])
  const current = useRef<LocalPhoto[]>([])
  useEffect(() => () => current.current.forEach(p => URL.revokeObjectURL(p.url)),[])
  const replace = useCallback((next: LocalPhoto[]) => { current.current=next; setPhotos(next) },[])
  const add = useCallback((itemId: string, files: FileList | File[]) => {
    const picked=Array.from(files); const existing=current.current
    if (picked.length>MAX_PHOTOS-existing.length) {setErrors([`Bạn chỉ có thể thêm ${MAX_PHOTOS-existing.length} ảnh nữa. Tối đa 14 ảnh cho toàn bộ yêu cầu.`]);return}
    const messages:string[]=[]; const next=[...existing]
    for (const file of picked) {
      const error=photoFileError(file)
      if(error){messages.push(error);continue}
      if(next.some(p=>p.itemId===itemId&&p.file.name===file.name&&p.file.size===file.size&&p.file.lastModified===file.lastModified)){messages.push(`${file.name}: ảnh đã được chọn cho vật phẩm này.`);continue}
      next.push({id:crypto.randomUUID(),itemId,file,url:URL.createObjectURL(file)})
    }
    replace(next);setErrors(messages)
  },[replace])
  const remove = useCallback((id:string)=>{const p=current.current.find(p=>p.id===id);if(p)URL.revokeObjectURL(p.url);replace(current.current.filter(p=>p.id!==id));setErrors([])},[replace])
  const removeItem = useCallback((itemId:string)=>{current.current.filter(p=>p.itemId===itemId).forEach(p=>URL.revokeObjectURL(p.url));replace(current.current.filter(p=>p.itemId!==itemId));setErrors([])},[replace])
  const reset = useCallback(()=>{current.current.forEach(p=>URL.revokeObjectURL(p.url));replace([]);setErrors([])},[replace])
  return {photos,errors,add,remove,removeItem,reset,clearErrors:()=>setErrors([])}
}

/** Price helpers for the trade-in form: 1000000 ↔ "1.000.000" and the amount in Vietnamese words. */
export const digitsOnly = (value: string) => value.replace(/\D/g, '').replace(/^0+(?=\d)/, '').slice(0, 12)
export const groupThousands = (digits: string) => digits.replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, '.')

const DIGITS: readonly string[] = ['không', 'một', 'hai', 'ba', 'bốn', 'năm', 'sáu', 'bảy', 'tám', 'chín']
const UNITS: readonly string[] = ['', ' nghìn', ' triệu', ' tỷ']

const digit = (n: number) => DIGITS[n] ?? ''

function readTriple(n: number, full: boolean): string {
  const h = Math.floor(n / 100), t = Math.floor((n % 100) / 10), u = n % 10
  const parts: string[] = []
  if (h || full) parts.push(`${digit(h)} trăm`)
  if (t === 0) { if (u && (h || full)) parts.push('linh') }
  else if (t === 1) parts.push('mười')
  else parts.push(`${digit(t)} mươi`)
  if (u) parts.push(u === 1 && t > 1 ? 'mốt' : u === 5 && t > 0 ? 'lăm' : u === 4 && t > 1 ? 'tư' : digit(u))
  return parts.join(' ')
}

/** "1000000" → "Một triệu đồng". Empty for empty or zero input. */
export function amountInWords(digits: string): string {
  const value = digits.replace(/\D/g, '').replace(/^0+/, '')
  if (!value) return ''
  const groups: number[] = []
  for (let end = value.length; end > 0; end -= 3) groups.unshift(Number(value.slice(Math.max(0, end - 3), end)))
  const words: string[] = []
  groups.forEach((g, i) => {
    const unit = UNITS[groups.length - 1 - i] ?? ''
    if (!g) return
    words.push(readTriple(g, words.length > 0) + unit)
  })
  const text = words.join(' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim()
  return text ? `${text.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}${text.slice(1)} đồng` : ''
}

import 'server-only'
import { tradeinServiceClient as serviceClient } from './client'
import { PHOTO_BUCKET, parsePhotos } from '../domain'
/** Bounded daily job. Never removes photos attached to completed requests. */
export async function cleanupTradeinUploads() {
  const sb = serviceClient()
  const {data,error} = await sb.from('tradein_upload_sessions').select('id,manifest').is('completed_code',null).lt('expires_at',new Date(Date.now()-3600000).toISOString()).order('expires_at').limit(30)
  if (error) return {ok:false,removed:0}
  let removed = 0
  for (const session of data ?? []) {
    const paths = parsePhotos(session.manifest).map(p => p.path)
    if (paths.length) { const result = await sb.storage.from(PHOTO_BUCKET).remove(paths); if (result.error) continue }
    const result = await sb.from('tradein_upload_sessions').delete().eq('id',session.id).is('completed_code',null)
    if (!result.error) removed++
  }
  const result = await sb.from('tradein_upload_sessions').delete().not('completed_code','is',null).lt('created_at',new Date(Date.now()-86400000).toISOString())
  return {ok:!result.error,removed}
}

import { MAX_PHOTO_BYTES } from '../domain'
export function imageMime(bytes: Uint8Array): 'image/jpeg' | 'image/png' | 'image/webp' | null {
  if (bytes.length >= 3 && bytes[0] === 0xff && bytes[1] === 0xd8 && bytes[2] === 0xff) return 'image/jpeg'
  if (bytes.length >= 8 && [137,80,78,71,13,10,26,10].every((n,i) => bytes[i] === n)) return 'image/png'
  if (bytes.length >= 12 && String.fromCharCode(...bytes.slice(0,4)) === 'RIFF' && String.fromCharCode(...bytes.slice(8,12)) === 'WEBP') return 'image/webp'
  return null
}
/** Bound the stream before parsing multipart, including chunked requests. */
export async function boundedFormData(request: Request) {
  const max = MAX_PHOTO_BYTES + 64 * 1024
  const length = Number(request.headers.get('content-length') ?? 0)
  if (length > max) throw new Error('PHOTO_TOO_LARGE')
  const reader = request.body?.getReader()
  if (!reader) throw new Error('EMPTY_BODY')
  const chunks: Uint8Array[] = []; let total = 0
  try {
    for (;;) { const {done,value} = await reader.read(); if (done) break; total += value.byteLength; if (total > max) { await reader.cancel(); throw new Error('PHOTO_TOO_LARGE') }; chunks.push(value) }
  } finally { reader.releaseLock() }
  return new Response(Buffer.concat(chunks), { headers: { 'content-type': request.headers.get('content-type') ?? '' } }).formData()
}

File: src/features/tradein/server/submissions.ts

import 'server-only'
import { createHash, createHmac, randomBytes } from 'node:crypto'
import { headers } from 'next/headers'
import { z } from 'zod'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server'
import { tradeinServiceClient as serviceClient } from './client'
import { hasServiceRole, isDemo } from '@/lib/env'
import type { ActionResult } from '@/lib/types'
import { MAX_PHOTOS, photoDescriptorSchema, serializeTradein, ticketSchema, tradeinSchema, type PhotoDescriptor, type TradeinInput, type UploadTicket } from '../domain'

export const tokenHash = (token: string) => createHash('sha256').update(token).digest('hex')
export function tradeinError(error: { message?: string } | null) {
  const message = error?.message ?? ''
  if (message.includes('RATE_LIMIT')) return 'Bạn đã gửi nhiều yêu cầu gần đây. Vui lòng thử lại sau một giờ.'
  if (message.includes('UPLOAD_EXPIRED')) return 'Phiên tải ảnh đã hết hạn. Bấm gửi lại để tạo phiên mới; ảnh bạn chọn vẫn được giữ.'
  if (message.includes('MODULE_OFF')) return 'Cửa hàng đang tạm dừng nhận thu mua.'
  if (message.includes('PHOTOS_INCOMPLETE')) return 'Chưa tải đủ ảnh. Bấm gửi lại để tiếp tục từ những ảnh còn thiếu.'
  return 'Chưa gửi được yêu cầu lúc này. Thông tin và ảnh bạn chọn vẫn được giữ để thử lại.'
}
export async function prepare(input: TradeinInput, files: PhotoDescriptor[]): Promise<ActionResult<UploadTicket & { demo?: boolean }>> {
  const values = tradeinSchema.safeParse(input)
  const photos = z.array(photoDescriptorSchema).max(MAX_PHOTOS).safeParse(files)
  if (!values.success) return { ok: false, error: values.error.issues[0]?.message ?? 'Kiểm tra lại thông tin.' }
  if (!photos.success) return { ok: false, error: 'Tối đa 14 ảnh JPG, PNG hoặc WebP; mỗi ảnh không quá 2 MB.' }
  if (photos.data.some(p => !values.data.items.some(i => i.client_id === p.item_id))) return { ok: false, error: 'Ảnh chưa được gắn đúng vật phẩm.' }
  if (isDemo) return { ok: true, data: { id: '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000', token: '0'.repeat(64), demo: true } }
  if (!hasServiceRole) return { ok: false, error: 'Cửa hàng chưa bật nhận yêu cầu kèm ảnh. Vui lòng liên hệ shop để được hỗ trợ.' }
  try {
    const sb = await createClient(); const { data: { user } } = await sb.auth.getUser()
    const h = await headers(); const ip = h.get('x-forwarded-for')?.split(',')[0]?.trim() || h.get('x-real-ip') || 'unknown'
    const fingerprint = createHmac('sha256', process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY!).update(`tradein:${ip}`).digest('hex')
    const token = randomBytes(32).toString('hex')
    const { data, error } = await serviceClient().rpc('prepare_tradein_upload', { p_payload: serializeTradein(values.data), p_files: photos.data, p_user_id: user?.id ?? null, p_fingerprint: fingerprint, p_token_hash: tokenHash(token) })
    if (error || !data) return { ok: false, error: tradeinError(error) }
    return { ok: true, data: { id: data, token } }
  } catch { return { ok: false, error: tradeinError(null) } }
}
export async function finish(input: UploadTicket): Promise<ActionResult<{ code: string }>> {
  const v = ticketSchema.safeParse(input)
  if (!v.success) return { ok: false, error: 'Phiên gửi không hợp lệ. Vui lòng thử lại.' }
  if (isDemo) return { ok: true, data: { code: 'TM-DEMO' } }
  if (!hasServiceRole) return { ok: false, error: tradeinError(null) }
  try {
    const {data,error} = await serviceClient().rpc('complete_tradein_upload', { p_session: v.data.id, p_token_hash: tokenHash(v.data.token) })
    if (error || !data) return { ok: false, error: tradeinError(error) }
    return { ok: true, data: { code: data } }
  } catch { return { ok: false, error: tradeinError(null) } }
}
