'use server'
import { revalidatePath, revalidateTag } from 'next/cache'
import { z } from 'zod'
import { settingSchemas } from '@/lib/schemas/settings'
import { productSchema, type ProductInput } from '@/lib/schemas/product'
import { getStaff } from '@/lib/auth'
import { CATALOG_TAG, SETTINGS_TAG } from '@/lib/catalog'
import { DEMO_MESSAGE, hasServiceRole, isDemo, SITE_URL } from '@/lib/env'
import { dbError } from '@/lib/labels'
import { serviceClient } from '@/lib/supabase/admin'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server'
import type { Database } from '@/lib/database.types'
import type { ActionResult, OrderStatus, StaffRole, TradeinStatus } from '@/lib/types'

type Fail = { ok: false; error: string }

async function guard(roles?: StaffRole[]): Promise<Fail | null> {
  if (isDemo) return { ok: false, error: DEMO_MESSAGE }
  const s = await getStaff()
  if (!s) return { ok: false, error: 'Phiên đăng nhập đã hết, vui lòng đăng nhập lại.' }
  if (roles && !roles.includes(s.role)) return { ok: false, error: 'Tài khoản không có quyền thực hiện thao tác này.' }
  return null
}
const MANAGER: StaffRole[] = ['owner', 'manager']
const OWNER: StaffRole[] = ['owner']

function catalogChanged() {
  revalidateTag(CATALOG_TAG, 'max')
  revalidatePath('/', 'layout')
}

// ============================================================== Đơn hàng
export async function setOrderStatus(orderId: string, status: OrderStatus, note?: string): Promise<ActionResult> {
  const g = await guard()
  if (g) return g
  const sb = await createClient()
  const { error } = await sb.rpc('admin_set_order_status', { p_order_id: orderId, p_status: status, p_note: note ?? null })
  if (error) return { ok: false, error: dbError(error) }
  if (status === 'cancelled') catalogChanged()
  revalidatePath('/admin/don-hang')
  return { ok: true }
}

// ============================================================== Sản phẩm
export type { ProductInput } from '@/lib/schemas/product'

export async function saveProduct(input: ProductInput): Promise<ActionResult<{ id: string }>> {
  const g = await guard(MANAGER)
  if (g) return g
  const p = productSchema.safeParse(input)
  if (!p.success) return { ok: false, error: p.error.issues[0]?.message ?? 'Dữ liệu chưa hợp lệ' }
  const skus = p.data.variants.map((v) => v.sku.toLowerCase())
  if (new Set(skus).size !== skus.length) return { ok: false, error: 'SKU của các biến thể bị trùng nhau.' }

  const sb = await createClient()
  // Kiểm tra thuộc tính bắt buộc theo loại sản phẩm
  const { data: defs } = await sb.from('attribute_defs').select('code,name,required').eq('type_id', p.data.type_id)
  const missing = (defs ?? []).find((d) => d.required && (p.data.attrs[d.code as string] === undefined || p.data.attrs[d.code as string] === ''))
  if (missing) return { ok: false, error: `Vui lòng nhập thuộc tính "${missing.name}".` }

  const { data, error } = await sb.rpc('admin_save_product', { p: p.data })
  if (error) return { ok: false, error: dbError(error) }
  catalogChanged()
  return { ok: true, data: { id: data as string } }
}

export async function setProductStatus(id: string, status: 'active' | 'hidden' | 'archived' | 'draft'): Promise<ActionResult> {
  const g = await guard(MANAGER)
  if (g) return g
  const sb = await createClient()
  const { error } = await sb.from('products').update({ status }).eq('id', id)
  if (error) return { ok: false, error: dbError(error) }
  catalogChanged()
  return { ok: true }
}

export async function deleteProduct(id: string): Promise<ActionResult> {
  const g = await guard(MANAGER)
  if (g) return g
  const sb = await createClient()
  const { error } = await sb.from('products').delete().eq('id', id)
  if (error) return { ok: false, error: dbError(error) }
  catalogChanged()
  return { ok: true }
}

// ============================================================== Loại sản phẩm
const typeSchema = z.object({
  id: z.string().optional(),
  code: z.string().trim().regex(/^[a-z0-9-]{2,40}$/, 'Mã loại chỉ gồm chữ thường không dấu, số, dấu gạch'),
  name: z.string().trim().min(2, 'Vui lòng nhập tên loại').max(80),
  description: z.string().max(300),
  track_inventory: z.boolean(),
  is_unique: z.boolean(),
  has_variants: z.boolean(),
  allow_preorder: z.boolean(),
  allow_tradein: z.boolean(),
  hold_in_cart: z.boolean(),
  attributes: z
    .array(z.object({
      id: z.string().optional(),
      code: z.string().trim().regex(/^[a-z0-9_]{1,40}$/, 'Mã thuộc tính chỉ gồm chữ thường không dấu, số, gạch dưới'),
      name: z.string().trim().min(1, 'Thuộc tính cần tên').max(60),
      kind: z.enum(['text', 'number', 'select', 'boolean', 'date']),
      options: z.array(z.string().trim().min(1).max(60)).max(100),
      required: z.boolean(),
      filterable: z.boolean(),
      visible: z.boolean()
    }))
    .max(40)
})
export type ProductTypeInput = z.infer<typeof typeSchema>

export async function saveProductType(input: ProductTypeInput): Promise<ActionResult<{ id: string }>> {
  const g = await guard(MANAGER)
  if (g) return g
  const p = typeSchema.safeParse(input)
  if (!p.success) return { ok: false, error: p.error.issues[0]?.message ?? 'Dữ liệu chưa hợp lệ' }
  const codes = p.data.attributes.map((a) => a.code)
  if (new Set(codes).size !== codes.length) return { ok: false, error: 'Mã thuộc tính bị trùng.' }
  const bad = p.data.attributes.find((a) => a.kind === 'select' && a.options.length === 0)
  if (bad) return { ok: false, error: `Thuộc tính "${bad.name}" là danh sách chọn, cần ít nhất 1 giá trị.` }

  const sb = await createClient()
  const { attributes, id, ...type } = p.data
  const res = id
    ? await sb.from('product_types').update(type).eq('id', id).select('id').single()
    : await sb.from('product_types').insert(type).select('id').single()
  if (res.error) return { ok: false, error: dbError(res.error) }
  const typeId = res.data.id as string

  const keep = attributes.filter((a) => a.id).map((a) => a.id as string)
  let del = sb.from('attribute_defs').delete().eq('type_id', typeId)
  if (keep.length) del = del.not('id', 'in', `(${keep.join(',')})`)
  const d = await del
  if (d.error) return { ok: false, error: dbError(d.error) }
  const rows = attributes.map((a, i) => ({ ...a, type_id: typeId, sort: i, options: a.kind === 'select' ? a.options : [] }))
  // Tách cập nhật và thêm mới: upsert hàng loạt yêu cầu mọi dòng cùng cột.
  const updates = rows.filter((r) => r.id)
  const inserts = rows.filter((r) => !r.id).map(({ id: _id, ...r }) => r)
  if (updates.length) {
    const u = await sb.from('attribute_defs').upsert(updates, { onConflict: 'id' })
    if (u.error) return { ok: false, error: dbError(u.error) }
  }
  if (inserts.length) {
    const ins = await sb.from('attribute_defs').insert(inserts)
    if (ins.error) return { ok: false, error: dbError(ins.error) }
  }
  catalogChanged()
  return { ok: true, data: { id: typeId } }
}

export async function deleteProductType(id: string): Promise<ActionResult> {
  const g = await guard(MANAGER)

}

// ============================================================== Thu mua
export async function updateTradein(id: string, input: { status: TradeinStatus; quoted_total: number | null; staff_note: string }): Promise<ActionResult> {
  const g = await guard()
  if (g) return g
  const sb = await createClient()
  const { data: rules } = await sb.from('settings').select('value').eq('key', 'rules').maybeSingle()
  const hours = Number((rules?.value as Record<string, unknown> | undefined)?.tradein_quote_hours ?? 48)
  const limit = Number((rules?.value as Record<string, unknown> | undefined)?.tradein_approval_limit ?? 5_000_000)
  const staff = await getStaff()
  if (input.quoted_total && input.quoted_total > limit && staff && !MANAGER.includes(staff.role)) {
    return { ok: false, error: `Báo giá trên ${limit.toLocaleString('vi-VN')}₫ cần quản lý duyệt.` }
  }
  const patch: Database['public']['Tables']['tradein_requests']['Update'] = { status: input.status, quoted_total: input.quoted_total, staff_note: input.staff_note || null, handled_by: staff?.id }
  if (input.status === 'quoted') patch.quote_expires_at = new Date(Date.now() + hours * 3600_000).toISOString()
  const { error } = await sb.from('tradein_requests').update(patch).eq('id', id)
  if (error) return { ok: false, error: dbError(error) }
  revalidatePath('/admin/thu-mua')
  return { ok: true }
}

  const sb = await createClient()

  const { error } = await sb.from('staff').insert({ email, full_name: p.data.full_name, role: p.data.role, allow_google: p.data.allow_google })
  if (error) return { ok: false, error: dbError(error) }
  let message = 'Đã thêm. Nhân viên đăng nhập bằng Google với đúng email này.'
  if (p.data.send_invite) {
    if (!hasServiceRole) {
      message = 'Đã thêm. Chưa gửi được email đặt mật khẩu vì thiếu SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY.'
    } else {
      const inv = await serviceClient().auth.admin.inviteUserByEmail(email, { redirectTo: `${SITE_URL}/admin/dang-nhap` })
      message = inv.error ? 'Đã thêm, nhưng gửi email mời chưa được (email có thể đã có tài khoản).' : 'Đã thêm và gửi email mời đặt mật khẩu.'
    }
  }
  revalidatePath('/admin/nhan-vien')
  return { ok: true, message }
}

export async function posSearch(q: string) {
  const term = q.replace(/[%_,()"\\]/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, 60)
  if (!term) return []
  if (isDemo) {
    const { demo } = await import('@/lib/demo')
    const { unaccent } = await import('@/lib/utils')
    const t = unaccent(term.toLowerCase())
    return demo.variants
      .map((v) => ({ v, p: demo.products.find((x) => x.id === v.product_id)! }))
      .filter(({ v, p }) => p && v.active && (unaccent(`${p.name} ${v.sku}`.toLowerCase()).includes(t)))
      .slice(0, 20)
      .map(({ v, p }) => ({ variant_id: v.id, name: p.name, title: v.title, sku: v.sku, price: v.price ?? p.price, stock: v.stock, image: v.image_url ?? p.thumbnail }))
  }
  const staff = await getStaff()
  if (!staff) return []
  const sb = await createClient()
  const { unaccent } = await import('@/lib/utils')
  const cols = 'id,sku,title,price,stock,image_url,product_id'
  const [bySku, byName] = await Promise.all([
    sb.from('variants').select(cols).eq('active', true).ilike('sku', `%${term}%`).limit(20),
    sb.from('products').select('id').eq('pos', true).neq('status', 'archived').ilike('search_text', `%${unaccent(term.toLowerCase())}%`).limit(20)
  ])
  const pids = (byName.data ?? []).map((r) => r.id as string)
  const byProduct = pids.length ? await sb.from('variants').select(cols).eq('active', true).in('product_id', pids).limit(40) : { data: [] }
  type V = { id: string; sku: string; title: string; price: number | null; stock: number; image_url: string | null; product_id: string }
  const vs = new Map<string, V>()
  for (const v of [...((bySku.data ?? []) as V[]), ...((byProduct.data ?? []) as V[])]) vs.set(v.id, v)
  const allPids = [...new Set([...vs.values()].map((v) => v.product_id))]
  if (!allPids.length) return []
  const { data: prods } = await sb.from('products').select('id,name,price,thumbnail,pos,status').in('id', allPids)
  type P = { id: string; name: string; price: number; thumbnail: string | null; pos: boolean; status: string }
  const pm = new Map(((prods ?? []) as P[]).map((p) => [p.id, p]))
  return [...vs.values()]
    .filter((v) => { const p = pm.get(v.product_id); return p && p.pos && p.status !== 'archived' })
    .slice(0, 20)
    .map((v) => {
      const p = pm.get(v.product_id)!
      return { variant_id: v.id, name: p.name, title: v.title, sku: v.sku, price: v.price ?? p.price, stock: v.stock, image: v.image_url ?? p.thumbnail }
    })
}

}

'use server'
import { redirect } from 'next/navigation'
import { z } from 'zod'
import { isDemo } from '@/lib/env'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server'

const schema = z.object({ email: z.email(), password: z.string().min(6).max(200) })

export async function adminLogin(_prev: { error: string } | null, formData: FormData): Promise<{ error: string } | null> {
  if (isDemo) redirect('/admin')
  const p = schema.safeParse({ email: String(formData.get('email') ?? '').trim().toLowerCase(), password: formData.get('password') })
  if (!p.success) return { error: 'Email hoặc mật khẩu chưa đúng định dạng.' }
  const sb = await createClient()
  const { error } = await sb.auth.signInWithPassword(p.data)
  if (error) return { error: 'Email hoặc mật khẩu không đúng.' }
  const { data: role } = await sb.rpc('claim_staff')
  if (!role) {
    await sb.auth.signOut()
    return { error: 'Tài khoản này chưa được mời vào trang quản trị. Liên hệ chủ shop.' }
  }
  const next = String(formData.get('next') ?? '/admin')
  redirect(next.startsWith('/admin') || next.startsWith('/pos') ? next : '/admin')
}

'use server'
import { z } from 'zod'
import { DEMO_MESSAGE, hasServiceRole, isDemo } from '@/lib/env'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server'
import { serviceClient } from '@/lib/supabase/admin'
import { dbError } from '@/lib/labels'
import type { ActionResult } from '@/lib/types'

const checkoutSchema = z.object({
  items: z.array(z.object({ variant_id: z.uuid(), qty: z.number().int().min(1).max(99) })).min(1).max(50),
  customer: z.object({
    name: z.string().trim().min(2, 'Vui lòng nhập họ tên').max(120),
    phone: z.string().trim().regex(/^(0|\+84)[0-9]{9,10}$/, 'Số điện thoại chưa đúng, ví dụ 0901234567'),
    email: z.union([z.literal(''), z.email('Email chưa đúng')]),
    province: z.string().trim().max(80),
    address: z.string().trim().max(300)
  }),
  fulfillment: z.enum(['delivery', 'pickup']),
  note: z.string().trim().max(500)
})

export type CheckoutInput = z.infer<typeof checkoutSchema>

/** Đặt hàng: giá, tồn kho, phí ship tính lại ở database (RPC place_order), client chỉ gửi id biến thể và số lượng. */
export async function placeOrder(input: CheckoutInput): Promise<ActionResult<{ url: string }>> {
  const parsed = checkoutSchema.safeParse(input)
  if (!parsed.success) return { ok: false, error: parsed.error.issues[0]?.message ?? 'Thông tin chưa hợp lệ' }
  const v = parsed.data
  if (v.fulfillment === 'delivery' && (v.customer.address.length < 5 || !v.customer.province)) {
    return { ok: false, error: 'Vui lòng nhập đủ địa chỉ và tỉnh, thành phố.' }
  }
  if (isDemo) return { ok: true, data: { url: '/don-hang/DP100118?t=demo' }, message: DEMO_MESSAGE }

  const sb = await createClient()
  const { data, error } = await sb.rpc('place_order', {
    p_items: v.items,
    p_customer: v.customer,
    p_fulfillment: v.fulfillment,
    p_note: v.note || null
  })
  if (error) return { ok: false, error: dbError(error) }
  const row = (Array.isArray(data) ? data[0] : data) as { order_code: string; order_token: string } | undefined
  if (!row) return { ok: false, error: 'Không tạo được đơn, vui lòng thử lại.' }
  return { ok: true, data: { url: `/don-hang/${row.order_code}?t=${row.order_token}` } }
}

const tokenSchema = z.object({ code: z.string().regex(/^DP\d{4,12}$/), token: z.uuid() })

export async function confirmTransfer(code: string, token: string): Promise<ActionResult> {
  if (isDemo) return { ok: true, message: DEMO_MESSAGE }
  const p = tokenSchema.safeParse({ code, token })
  if (!p.success) return { ok: false, error: 'Đơn hàng không hợp lệ.' }
  const sb = await createClient()
  const { error } = await sb.rpc('confirm_transfer', { p_code: code, p_token: token })
  if (error) return { ok: false, error: dbError(error) }
  return { ok: true, message: 'Đã ghi nhận. Shop sẽ đối soát và báo cho bạn sớm.' }
}

/** Khách tải ảnh chuyển khoản. Dùng service role sau khi kiểm tra mã đơn + token. */
export async function uploadProof(formData: FormData): Promise<ActionResult> {
  if (isDemo) return { ok: true, message: DEMO_MESSAGE }
  if (!hasServiceRole) return { ok: false, error: 'Shop chưa bật tải ảnh chuyển khoản. Bạn gửi ảnh qua Zalo giúp shop nhé.' }
  const p = tokenSchema.safeParse({ code: formData.get('code'), token: formData.get('token') })
  const file = formData.get('file')
  if (!p.success || !(file instanceof File)) return { ok: false, error: 'Dữ liệu không hợp lệ.' }
  if (file.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024) return { ok: false, error: 'Ảnh tối đa 5MB.' }
  if (!/^image\/(jpeg|png|webp|heic)$/.test(file.type)) return { ok: false, error: 'Chỉ nhận ảnh JPG, PNG, WEBP hoặc HEIC.' }

  const admin = serviceClient()
  const { data: order } = await admin.from('orders').select('id,code').eq('code', p.data.code).eq('access_token', p.data.token).maybeSingle()
  if (!order) return { ok: false, error: 'Không tìm thấy đơn hàng.' }
  const ext = file.type.split('/')[1]
  const path = `${order.code}/${Date.now()}.${ext}`
  const up = await admin.storage.from('payment-proofs').upload(path, file, { contentType: file.type, upsert: false })
  if (up.error) return { ok: false, error: 'Tải ảnh chưa được, vui lòng thử lại.' }
  await admin.from('orders').update({ proof_path: path }).eq('id', order.id)
  await admin.from('order_events').insert({ order_id: order.id, message: 'Khách tải ảnh chuyển khoản', actor: 'customer' })
  return { ok: true, message: 'Đã nhận ảnh chuyển khoản.' }
}

    })
    return { revenue_today: 7_900_000, orders_today: 6, pending_payment: 2, to_pack: 1, tradein_new: 1, low_stock: 3, revenue_7d: days }
  }
  const sb = await createClient()
  const { data, error } = await sb.rpc('admin_dashboard')
  if (error) throw new Error(error.message)
  return z.object({revenue_today:z.number(),orders_today:z.number(),pending_payment:z.number(),to_pack:z.number(),tradein_new:z.number(),low_stock:z.number(),revenue_7d:z.array(z.object({day:z.string(),total:z.number()}))}).parse(data)
})

export interface OrderFilter {
  status?: OrderStatus | 'all'
  kind?: 'order' | 'preorder'
  channel?: 'online' | 'pos'
  q?: string
  page?: number
  sort?: 'newest' | 'oldest' | 'total-desc'
}

const ORDER_COLS = 'id,code,access_token,kind,channel,status,payment_method,fulfillment,customer_name,phone,email,province,address,note,subtotal,shipping_fee,discount,total,amount_due,paid_amount,proof_path,customer_confirmed_at,expires_at,created_at'

export type OrderListRow = Pick<AdminOrder, 'id' | 'code' | 'kind' | 'channel' | 'status' | 'customer_name' | 'phone' | 'total' | 'amount_due' | 'paid_amount' | 'created_at' | 'customer_confirmed_at'>
const ORDER_LIST_COLS = 'id,code,kind,channel,status,customer_name,phone,total,amount_due,paid_amount,created_at,customer_confirmed_at'
function orderListRow(o: AdminOrder): OrderListRow {
  return { id:o.id, code:o.code, kind:o.kind, channel:o.channel, status:o.status, customer_name:o.customer_name, phone:o.phone, total:o.total, amount_due:o.amount_due, paid_amount:o.paid_amount, created_at:o.created_at, customer_confirmed_at:o.customer_confirmed_at }
}
export async function listRecentOrders(): Promise<OrderListRow[]> {
  if (isDemo) return DEMO_ORDERS.slice(0,6).map(orderListRow)
  const sb = await createClient()
  const { data, error } = await sb.from('orders').select(ORDER_LIST_COLS).order('created_at',{ ascending:false }).limit(6)
  if (error) throw new Error(error.message)
  return (data ?? []) as OrderListRow[]
}

export async function listOrders(f: OrderFilter): Promise<{ rows: OrderListRow[]; count: number; counts: Record<string, number> }> {
  const page = adminPage(f.page)
  const q = unaccent(clean(f.q).toLowerCase())
  if (isDemo) {
    let rows = DEMO_ORDERS as AdminOrder[]
    if (f.kind) rows = rows.filter((o) => o.kind === f.kind)
    if (f.channel) rows = rows.filter((o) => o.channel === f.channel)
    if (q) rows = rows.filter((o) => unaccent(`${o.code} ${o.phone} ${o.customer_name} ${o.email ?? ''}`.toLowerCase()).includes(q))
    const counts: Record<string, number> = { all: rows.length }
    for (const o of rows) counts[o.status] = (counts[o.status] ?? 0) + 1
    if (f.status && f.status !== 'all') rows = rows.filter((o) => o.status === f.status)
    const [from,to] = range(page)
    return { rows: [...rows].sort((a,b) => f.sort === 'total-desc' ? b.total-a.total : f.sort === 'oldest' ? a.created_at.localeCompare(b.created_at) : b.created_at.localeCompare(a.created_at)).slice(from,to+1).map(orderListRow), count: rows.length, counts }
  }
  const sb = await createClient()
  let query = sb.from('orders').select(ORDER_LIST_COLS, { count: 'exact' })
  if (f.kind) query = query.eq('kind', f.kind)
  if (f.channel) query = query.eq('channel', f.channel)
  if (f.status && f.status !== 'all') query = query.eq('status', f.status)
  if (q) query = query.ilike('search_text', `%${q}%`)
  const [from, to] = range(page)
  const [res, counter] = await Promise.all([
    query.order(f.sort === 'total-desc' ? 'total' : 'created_at', { ascending: f.sort === 'oldest' }).order('id', { ascending: false }).range(from, to),
    sb.rpc('admin_order_counts_v1', { p_kind: f.kind ?? null, p_channel: f.channel ?? null, p_search: q })
  ])
  if (res.error || counter.error) throw new Error('Cần áp dụng migration 20261104000300_admin_experience.sql trước khi dùng bộ lọc đơn hàng.')
  return { rows: (res.data ?? []) as OrderListRow[], count: res.count ?? 0, counts: counter.data as Record<string, number> }
}

export async function getOrder(code: string): Promise<(AdminOrder & { items: OrderItem[]; events: OrderEvent[]; proof_url: string | null }) | null> {
  if (isDemo) {
    const o = DEMO_ORDERS.find((x) => x.code === code)
    return o ? { ...o, proof_url: null } : null
  }
  const sb = await createClient()
  const { data } = await sb.from('orders').select(`${ORDER_COLS}, order_items(*), order_events(status,message,actor,created_at)`).eq('code', code).maybeSingle()
  if (!data) return null
  const { order_items, order_events, ...o } = data as unknown as AdminOrder & { order_items: OrderItem[]; order_events: OrderEvent[] }
  let proof_url: string | null = null
  if (o.proof_path) {
    const s = await sb.storage.from('payment-proofs').createSignedUrl(o.proof_path, 600)
    proof_url = s.data?.signedUrl ?? null
  }
  return { ...o, items: order_items, events: [...order_events].sort((a, b) => a.created_at.localeCompare(b.created_at)), proof_url }
}

export interface ProductFilter {
  type?: string
  status?: string
  q?: string
  low?: boolean
  page?: number
  preorder?: boolean
  sort?: string
}

export type AdminProductRow = Pick<Product, 'id' | 'name' | 'sku' | 'slug' | 'type_id' | 'category_id' | 'price' | 'min_price' | 'max_price' | 'stock_total' | 'min_stock' | 'variant_count' | 'status' | 'online' | 'thumbnail' | 'allow_preorder' | 'preorder_slots'>

export async function listAdminProducts(f: ProductFilter): Promise<{ rows: AdminProductRow[]; count: number }> {
  const page = adminPage(f.page)
  const status=productStatus(f.status)
  const q = unaccent(clean(f.q).toLowerCase())
  if (isDemo) {
    let rows = demo.products as AdminProductRow[]
    if (f.type) rows = rows.filter((p) => demo.types.find((t) => t.id === p.type_id)?.code === f.type)
    if (status) rows = rows.filter((p) => p.status === status)
    else rows = rows.filter((p) => p.status !== 'archived')
    if (f.preorder) rows = rows.filter((p) => p.allow_preorder)
    if (f.low) rows = rows.filter((p) => p.status === 'active' && p.stock_total <= p.min_stock && !p.allow_preorder && demo.types.some((t) => t.id === p.type_id && t.track_inventory && !t.is_unique))
    if (q) rows = rows.filter((p) => unaccent(`${p.name} ${p.sku}`.toLowerCase()).includes(q))
    const sort = productSort(f.sort)
    rows = [...rows].sort((a,b) => sort === 'name-asc' ? a.name.localeCompare(b.name,'vi') : sort === 'price-asc' ? (a.min_price ?? a.price)-(b.min_price ?? b.price) : sort === 'price-desc' ? (b.min_price ?? b.price)-(a.min_price ?? a.price) : sort === 'stock-asc' ? a.stock_total-b.stock_total : 0)
    const [from, to] = range(page)
    return { rows: rows.slice(from, to + 1), count: rows.length }
  }
  const sb = await createClient()
  let query = sb.from('admin_product_inventory').select('id,name,sku,slug,type_id,category_id,price,min_price,max_price,stock_total,min_stock,variant_count,status,online,thumbnail,allow_preorder,preorder_slots', { count: 'exact' })
  if (f.type) {
    const { data: t } = await sb.from('product_types').select('id').eq('code', f.type).maybeSingle()
    query = query.eq('type_id', t?.id ?? '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
  }
  query = status ? query.eq('status', status) : query.neq('status', 'archived')
  if (f.low) query = query.eq('is_low_stock', true)
  if (f.preorder) query = query.eq('allow_preorder', true)
  for (const term of q.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean)) query = query.ilike('search_text', `%${term}%`)
  const [from, to] = range(page)
  const [sortColumn, ascending] = PRODUCT_SORTS[productSort(f.sort)]
  const { data, count, error } = await query.order(sortColumn, { ascending }).order('id', { ascending: false }).range(from, to)
  if (error) throw new Error(error.message)
  return { rows: (data ?? []) as AdminProductRow[], count: count ?? 0 }
}

export async function getAdminProduct(id: string): Promise<ProductDetail | null> {
  if (isDemo) {
    const p = demo.products.find((x) => x.id === id)
    if (!p) return null
    return {
      ...p,
      variants: demo.variants.filter((v) => v.product_id === id),
      images: demo.images.filter((i) => i.product_id === id),
      options: demo.options.filter((o) => o.product_id === id),
      collection_ids: demo.product_collections.filter((x) => x.product_id === id).map((x) => x.collection_id)
    }
  }
  const sb = await createClient()
  const { data } = await sb.from('products').select('*, variants(*), product_images(*), product_options(*), product_collections(collection_id)').eq('id', id).maybeSingle()
  return data ? toDetail(data as Record<string, unknown>) : null
}

export async function listTradeins(status?: TradeinStatus, page = 1): Promise<{ rows: TradeinRequest[]; count: number }> {
  page = adminPage(page)
  if (isDemo) {
    const rows = status ? DEMO_TRADEINS.filter((t) => t.status === status) : DEMO_TRADEINS
    const [from,to] = range(page)
    return { rows: rows.slice(from,to+1), count: rows.length }
  }
  const sb = await createClient()
  let q = sb.from('tradein_requests').select('*', { count: 'exact' })
  if (status) q = q.eq('status', status)
  const [from, to] = range(page)
  const { data, count, error } = await q.order('created_at', { ascending: false }).range(from, to)
  if (error) throw new Error(error.message)
  const itemsSchema=z.array(z.object({name:z.string(),condition:z.string().optional(),qty:z.number().optional(),expected:z.number().optional(),note:z.string().optional()}))
  const rows=(data ?? []).map<TradeinRequest>((r)=>({...r,method:r.method==='ship'?'ship':'store',payout:r.payout==='credit'?'credit':'cash',items:itemsSchema.parse(r.items)}))
  return { rows, count:count ?? 0 }
}

export async function listCustomers(q?: string, page = 1): Promise<{ rows: CustomerSummary[]; count: number }> {
  page = adminPage(page)
  const s = clean(q)
  if (isDemo) {
    const rows = s ? DEMO_CUSTOMERS.filter((c) => `${c.phone} ${unaccent(c.customer_name.toLowerCase())}`.includes(unaccent(s.toLowerCase()))) : DEMO_CUSTOMERS
    const [from,to] = range(page)
    return { rows: rows.slice(from,to+1), count: rows.length }
  }
  const sb = await createClient()
  let query = sb.from('customer_summary').select('*', { count: 'exact' })
  if (s) query = query.or(`phone.ilike.%${s}%,customer_name.ilike.%${s}%,email.ilike.%${s}%`)
  const [from, to] = range(page)
  const { data, count, error } = await query.order('last_order_at', { ascending: false }).range(from, to)
  if (error) throw new Error(error.message)
  return { rows: (data ?? []) as CustomerSummary[], count: count ?? 0 }
}

import type { ProductStatus } from '@/lib/types'
/** Shared, dependency-free query validation. The server owns pagination and sort. */
export const ADMIN_PAGE_SIZE = 20
export function adminPage(value: unknown) { const n = Number(value); return Number.isFinite(n) && n >= 1 ? Math.min(100_000, Math.floor(n)) : 1 }
export const PRODUCT_SORTS = { newest: ['created_at', false], 'name-asc': ['name', true], 'price-asc': ['min_price', true], 'price-desc': ['min_price', false], 'stock-asc': ['stock_total', true] } as const
export type ProductSort = keyof typeof PRODUCT_SORTS
export function productSort(value?: string): ProductSort { return value && Object.hasOwn(PRODUCT_SORTS,value) ? value as ProductSort : 'newest' }
export function csvCell(value: unknown) { let s = String(value ?? ''); if (/^[\s]*[=+@\-]/.test(s)) s = "'" + s; return '"' + s.replaceAll('"','""') + '"' }

export function productStatus(value?:string): ProductStatus | undefined { return value && ['draft','active','hidden','archived'].includes(value) ? value as ProductStatus : undefined }

import 'server-only'
import { cache } from 'react'
import { redirect } from 'next/navigation'
import { isDemo } from '@/lib/env'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server'
import { DEMO_STAFF } from '@/lib/demo'
import type { Staff, StaffRole } from '@/lib/types'

/** Người dùng đang đăng nhập (khách hoặc nhân viên). Xác thực chữ ký JWT bằng getClaims. */
export const getCurrentUser = cache(async () => {
  if (isDemo) return null
  const sb = await createClient()
  const { data } = await sb.auth.getClaims()
  const c = data?.claims
  if (!c?.sub) return null
  return { id: c.sub as string, email: (c.email as string | undefined) ?? '' }
})

/** Nhân viên đang đăng nhập, null nếu không phải nhân viên. Chế độ demo: trả về chủ shop mẫu để xem giao diện. */
export const getStaff = cache(async (): Promise<Staff | null> => {
  if (isDemo) return DEMO_STAFF[0] ?? null
  const user = await getCurrentUser()
  if (!user) return null
  const sb = await createClient()
  const { data } = await sb.from('staff').select('*').eq('user_id', user.id).eq('active', true).maybeSingle()
  return (data as Staff | null) ?? null
})

export async function requireStaff(roles?: StaffRole[]) {
  const staff = await getStaff()
  if (!staff) redirect('/admin/dang-nhap?error=not_staff')
  if (roles && !roles.includes(staff.role)) redirect('/admin?error=forbidden')
  return staff
}

export const canManage = (s: Staff | null) => s?.role === 'owner' || s?.role === 'manager'

'use client'
import { useSyncExternalStore } from 'react'

export interface CartLine {
  variantId: string
  productId: string
  slug: string
  name: string
  variantTitle: string
  price: number
  image: string | null
  qty: number
  max: number
  isPreorder: boolean
}

const KEY = 'dp-cart-v1'
const EMPTY: CartLine[] = []
let lines: CartLine[] = EMPTY
let loaded = false
const listeners = new Set<() => void>()

function load() {
  if (loaded || typeof window === 'undefined') return
  loaded = true
  try {
    const raw = window.localStorage.getItem(KEY)
    const parsed = raw ? (JSON.parse(raw) as CartLine[]) : []
    lines = Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed.filter((l) => l && typeof l.variantId === 'string' && l.qty > 0) : []
  } catch {
    lines = []
  }
}

function save(next: CartLine[]) {
  lines = next
  try {
    window.localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(next))
  } catch {}
  listeners.forEach((l) => l())
}

function subscribe(cb: () => void) {
  load()
  listeners.add(cb)
  const onStorage = (e: StorageEvent) => {
    if (e.key === KEY) {
      loaded = false
      load()
      cb()
    }
  }
  window.addEventListener('storage', onStorage)
  return () => {
    listeners.delete(cb)
    window.removeEventListener('storage', onStorage)
  }
}

export const cart = {
  add(line: Omit<CartLine, 'qty'>, qty = 1) {
    load()
    const found = lines.find((l) => l.variantId === line.variantId)
    if (found) {
      save(lines.map((l) => (l.variantId === line.variantId ? { ...l, ...line, qty: Math.min(l.qty + qty, line.max) } : l)))
    } else {
      // Hàng pre-order đặt riêng: thêm pre-order thì bỏ hàng có sẵn và ngược lại.
      const kept = lines.filter((l) => l.isPreorder === line.isPreorder)
      save([...kept, { ...line, qty: Math.min(qty, line.max) }])
    }
  },
  setQty(variantId: string, qty: number) {
    load()
    save(lines.map((l) => (l.variantId === variantId ? { ...l, qty: Math.max(1, Math.min(qty, l.max)) } : l)))
  },
  remove(variantId: string) {
    load()
    save(lines.filter((l) => l.variantId !== variantId))
  },
  clear() {
    save([])
  }
}

export function useCart() {
  return useSyncExternalStore(
    subscribe,
    () => {
      load()
      return lines
    },
    () => EMPTY
  )
}

export function cartCount(l: CartLine[]) {
  return l.reduce((s, x) => s + x.qty, 0)
}
export function cartSubtotal(l: CartLine[]) {
  return l.reduce((s, x) => s + x.qty * x.price, 0)
}

export const getCatalogMeta = unstable_cache(
  async (): Promise<CatalogMeta> => {
    if (isDemo) {
      return { types: demo.types, attributes: demo.attributes, categories: demo.categories, brands: demo.brands, collections: demo.collections }
    }
    const sb = publicClient()
    const [types, attributes, categories, brands, collections] = await Promise.all([
      sb.from('product_types').select('*').order('sort'),
      sb.from('attribute_defs').select('*').order('sort'),
      sb.from('categories').select('id,parent_id,name,slug,depth,sort,visible').order('sort'),
      sb.from('brands').select('id,name,slug').order('name'),
      sb.from('collections').select('*').order('sort')
    ])
    const err = types.error ?? attributes.error ?? categories.error ?? brands.error ?? collections.error
    if (err) throw new Error(err.message)
    return {
      types: types.data as ProductType[],
      attributes: attributes.data as AttributeDef[],
      categories: categories.data as Category[],
      brands: brands.data as Brand[],
      collections: collections.data as Collection[]
    }
  },
  ['catalog-meta'],
  { tags: [CATALOG_TAG], revalidate: 600 }
)

export const getSettings = unstable_cache(
  async (): Promise<ShopSettings> => {
    if (isDemo) return DEFAULT_SETTINGS
    const { data, error } = await publicClient().from('settings').select('key,value').eq('is_public', true)
    if (error) throw new Error(error.message)
    const merged = structuredClone(DEFAULT_SETTINGS) as unknown as Record<string, Record<string, unknown>>
    for (const row of data ?? []) {
      const key = row.key as string
      merged[key] = { ...(merged[key] ?? {}), ...(row.value as Record<string, unknown>) }
    }
    return merged as unknown as ShopSettings
  },
  ['settings'],
  { tags: [SETTINGS_TAG], revalidate: 600 }
)

/** Id của danh mục và toàn bộ danh mục con (cây tối đa 3 cấp). */
export function descendantIds(categories: Category[], rootId: string) {
  const out = new Set([rootId])
  let added = true
  while (added) {
    added = false
    for (const c of categories) {
      if (c.parent_id && out.has(c.parent_id) && !out.has(c.id)) {
        out.add(c.id)
        added = true
      }
    }
  }
  return [...out]
}

function encodeCursor(v: string | number, id: string) {
  return Buffer.from(JSON.stringify([v, id])).toString('base64url')
}
function decodeCursor(c: string): [string | number, string] | null {
  try {
    const v = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(c, 'base64url').toString()) as unknown
    if (Array.isArray(v) && v.length === 2 && typeof v[1] === 'string') return [v[0] as string | number, v[1]]
  } catch {}
  return null
}

function searchTerms(q?: string) {
  return unaccent((q ?? '').toLowerCase())
    .replace(/[%_,()"\\]/g, ' ')
    .split(/\s+/)
    .filter((t) => t.length > 0)
    .slice(0, 5)
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Danh sách sản phẩm: phân trang theo con trỏ (keyset), dùng index products_listing_idx / products_price_idx
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
async function queryProducts(query: ProductQuery): Promise<ProductPage> {
  const limit = Math.min(Math.max(query.limit ?? PAGE_SIZE, 1), 48)
  const sort: SortKey = query.sort ?? 'new'
  const meta = await getCatalogMeta()
  const cursor = query.cursor ? decodeCursor(query.cursor) : null

  const category = query.category ? meta.categories.find((c) => c.slug === query.category) : undefined
  const type = query.type ? meta.types.find((t) => t.code === query.type) : undefined
  const brand = query.brand ? meta.brands.find((b) => b.slug === query.brand) : undefined
  const collection = query.collection ? meta.collections.find((c) => c.slug === query.collection) : undefined
  if ((query.category && !category) || (query.type && !type) || (query.brand && !brand) || (query.collection && !collection)) {
    return { items: [], nextCursor: null }
  }
  const catIds = category ? descendantIds(meta.categories, category.id) : null
  const terms = searchTerms(query.q)
  const attrs = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(query.attrs ?? {}).filter(([, v]) => v !== ''))

  if (isDemo) {
    const colIds = collection ? new Set(demo.product_collections.filter((x) => x.collection_id === collection.id).map((x) => x.product_id)) : null
    let rows = demo.products.filter((p) => p.status === 'active' && p.online)
    if (catIds) rows = rows.filter((p) => p.category_id && catIds.includes(p.category_id))
    if (type) rows = rows.filter((p) => p.type_id === type.id)
    if (brand) rows = rows.filter((p) => p.brand_id === brand.id)
    if (colIds) rows = rows.filter((p) => colIds.has(p.id))
    if (query.inStock) rows = rows.filter((p) => p.stock_total > 0)
    if (query.preorder) rows = rows.filter((p) => p.allow_preorder)
    if (query.featured) rows = rows.filter((p) => p.is_featured)
    if (terms.length) rows = rows.filter((p) => terms.every((t) => unaccent(`${p.name} ${p.sku}`.toLowerCase()).includes(t)))
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(attrs)) rows = rows.filter((p) => String(p.attrs[k] ?? '') === v)
    const priceOf = (p: Product) => p.min_price ?? p.price
    rows.sort((a, b) => {
      if (sort === 'new') return b.created_at.localeCompare(a.created_at) || b.id.localeCompare(a.id)
      const d = sort === 'price_asc' ? priceOf(a) - priceOf(b) : priceOf(b) - priceOf(a)
      return d || (sort === 'price_asc' ? a.id.localeCompare(b.id) : b.id.localeCompare(a.id))
    })
    if (cursor) {
      const i = rows.findIndex((p) => p.id === cursor[1])
      rows = i >= 0 ? rows.slice(i + 1) : []
    }
    const page = rows.slice(0, limit)
    const last = page[page.length - 1]
    return {
      items: page,
      nextCursor: rows.length > limit && last ? encodeCursor(sort === 'new' ? last.created_at : priceOf(last), last.id) : null
    }
  }

  const sb = publicClient()
  let q = sb.from('products').select(CARD_COLUMNS).eq('status', 'active').eq('online', true)
  if (catIds) q = q.in('category_id', catIds)
  if (type) q = q.eq('type_id', type.id)
  if (brand) q = q.eq('brand_id', brand.id)
  if (collection) {
    const { data } = await sb.from('product_collections').select('product_id').eq('collection_id', collection.id).limit(1000)
    q = q.in('id', (data ?? []).map((r) => r.product_id as string))
  }
  if (query.inStock) q = q.gt('stock_total', 0)
  if (query.preorder) q = q.eq('allow_preorder', true)
  if (query.featured) q = q.eq('is_featured', true)
  for (const t of terms) q = q.ilike('search_text', `%${t}%`)
  if (Object.keys(attrs).length) q = q.contains('attrs', attrs)

  if (sort === 'new') {
    if (cursor) q = q.or(`created_at.lt."${cursor[0]}",and(created_at.eq."${cursor[0]}",id.lt.${cursor[1]})`)
    q = q.order('created_at', { ascending: false }).order('id', { ascending: false })
  } else {
    const asc = sort === 'price_asc'
    if (cursor) {
      const op = asc ? 'gt' : 'lt'
      q = q.or(`min_price.${op}.${Number(cursor[0])},and(min_price.eq.${Number(cursor[0])},id.${op}.${cursor[1]})`)
    }
    q = q.order('min_price', { ascending: asc }).order('id', { ascending: asc })
  }

  const { data, error } = await q.limit(limit + 1)
  if (error) throw new Error(error.message)
  const rows = (data ?? []) as unknown as ProductCard[]
  const page = rows.slice(0, limit)
  const last = page[page.length - 1]
  return {
    items: page,
    nextCursor: rows.length > limit && last ? encodeCursor(sort === 'new' ? last.created_at : (last.min_price ?? last.price), last.id) : null
  }
}

export const listProducts = unstable_cache(queryProducts, ['products-list'], { tags: [CATALOG_TAG], revalidate: 120 })

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Chi tiết sản phẩm
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
export const getProductBySlug = unstable_cache(
  async (slug: string): Promise<ProductDetail | null> => {
    if (isDemo) {
      const p = demo.products.find((x) => x.slug === slug && x.status === 'active')
      if (!p) return null
      return {
        ...p,
        variants: demo.variants.filter((v) => v.product_id === p.id).sort((a, b) => a.sort - b.sort),
        images: demo.images.filter((i) => i.product_id === p.id).sort((a, b) => a.sort - b.sort),
        options: demo.options.filter((o) => o.product_id === p.id).sort((a, b) => a.sort - b.sort),
        collection_ids: demo.product_collections.filter((x) => x.product_id === p.id).map((x) => x.collection_id)
      }
    }
    const { data, error } = await publicClient()
      .from('products')
      .select('*, variants(*), product_images(*), product_options(*), product_collections(collection_id)')
      .eq('slug', slug)
      .maybeSingle()
    if (error) throw new Error(error.message)
    if (!data) return null
    return toDetail(data as Record<string, unknown>)
  },
  ['product-by-slug'],
  { tags: [CATALOG_TAG], revalidate: 300 }
)

export function toDetail(row: Record<string, unknown>): ProductDetail {
  const { variants, product_images, product_options, product_collections, ...rest } = row as Record<string, unknown> & {
    variants?: ProductDetail['variants']
    product_images?: ProductDetail['images']
    product_options?: ProductDetail['options']
    product_collections?: { collection_id: string }[]
  }
  return {
    ...(rest as unknown as Product),
    variants: [...(variants ?? [])].sort((a, b) => a.sort - b.sort),
    images: [...(product_images ?? [])].sort((a, b) => a.sort - b.sort),
    options: [...(product_options ?? [])].sort((a, b) => a.sort - b.sort),
    collection_ids: (product_collections ?? []).map((c) => c.collection_id)
  }
}

export async function getFeaturedSlugs(limit = 24) {
  if (isDemo) return demo.products.map((p) => p.slug)
  const { data } = await publicClient()
    .from('products')
    .select('slug')
    .eq('status', 'active')
    .eq('online', true)
    .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
    .limit(limit)
  return (data ?? []).map((r) => r.slug as string)
}

/** Đổi lỗi từ Postgres/PostgREST sang câu tiếng Việt dễ hiểu. */
export function dbError(err: { message?: string; code?: string } | null | undefined): string {
  const msg = err?.message ?? ''
  const [key, detail] = msg.split(':')
  if (key === 'OUT_OF_STOCK') return `${detail?.trim() || 'Sản phẩm'} không đủ hàng.`
  if (key === 'OVER_LIMIT') return `${detail?.trim() || 'Sản phẩm'} vượt giới hạn mua mỗi đơn.`
  if (key === 'PREORDER_CLOSED') return `${detail?.trim() || 'Sản phẩm'} đã đóng đặt trước.`
  if (key && DB_ERRORS[key]) return DB_ERRORS[key]
  if (err?.code === '23505') return 'Giá trị bị trùng (SKU, đường dẫn hoặc email đã tồn tại).'
  if (err?.code === '23503') return 'Đang có dữ liệu khác dùng mục này nên chưa xóa được.'
  if (err?.code === '42501') return 'Tài khoản không có quyền thực hiện thao tác này.'
  return 'Có lỗi xảy ra, vui lòng thử lại.'
}

================
File: src/lib/query.ts
================
import type { ProductQuery, SortKey } from '@/lib/catalog'

type SP = Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>
const one = (v: string | string[] | undefined) => (Array.isArray(v) ? v[0] : v) ?? ''

/** Đọc bộ lọc từ URL. Thuộc tính lọc dùng tiền tố a_ (ví dụ a_condition=NM). */
export function parseProductQuery(sp: SP | URLSearchParams): ProductQuery {
  const get = (k: string) => (sp instanceof URLSearchParams ? (sp.get(k) ?? '') : one(sp[k]))
  const keys = sp instanceof URLSearchParams ? [...sp.keys()] : Object.keys(sp)
  const attrs: Record<string, string> = {}
  for (const k of keys) {
    if (k.startsWith('a_') && /^a_[a-z0-9_]{1,40}$/.test(k)) {
      const v = get(k).slice(0, 80)
      if (v) attrs[k.slice(2)] = v
    }
  }
  const sort = get('sort')
  return {
    q: get('q').slice(0, 80) || undefined,
    type: get('type') || undefined,
    category: get('category') || undefined,
    brand: get('brand') || undefined,
    collection: get('collection') || undefined,
    sort: (['new', 'price_asc', 'price_desc'].includes(sort) ? sort : 'new') as SortKey,
    inStock: get('instock') === '1',
    preorder: get('preorder') === '1',
    attrs
  }
}

/** Chuỗi query ổn định (dùng làm khóa cache cho lưới cuộn vô hạn). */
export function queryString(q: ProductQuery) {
  const p = new URLSearchParams()
  if (q.q) p.set('q', q.q)
  if (q.type) p.set('type', q.type)
  if (q.category) p.set('category', q.category)
  if (q.brand) p.set('brand', q.brand)
  if (q.collection) p.set('collection', q.collection)
  if (q.sort && q.sort !== 'new') p.set('sort', q.sort)
  if (q.inStock) p.set('instock', '1')
  if (q.preorder) p.set('preorder', '1')
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(q.attrs ?? {}).sort()) p.set(`a_${k}`, v)
  return p.toString()
}

import { z } from 'zod'

export const productSchema = z.object({
  id: z.string().optional(),
  type_id: z.uuid('Vui lòng chọn loại sản phẩm'),
  category_id: z.string(),
  brand_id: z.string(),
  name: z.string().trim().min(2, 'Tên sản phẩm cần ít nhất 2 ký tự').max(200),
  slug: z.string().trim().regex(/^[a-z0-9-]{2,120}$/, 'Đường dẫn chỉ gồm chữ thường không dấu, số và dấu gạch'),
  sku: z.string().trim().min(2, 'Vui lòng nhập SKU').max(60),
  description: z.string().max(5000),
  unit: z.string().max(20),
  price: z.number().int().min(0, 'Giá không hợp lệ'),
  compare_at_price: z.number().int().min(0).nullable(),
  cost: z.number().int().min(0).nullable(),
  stock: z.number().int().min(0),
  status: z.enum(['draft', 'active', 'hidden', 'archived']),
  online: z.boolean(),
  pos: z.boolean(),
  is_featured: z.boolean(),
  attrs: z.record(z.string(), z.union([z.string(), z.number(), z.boolean()])),
  tags: z.array(z.string().max(40)).max(30),
  images: z.array(z.object({ url: z.string().min(1).max(1000), alt: z.string().max(200) })).max(20),
  options: z.array(z.object({ name: z.string().trim().min(1).max(40), values: z.array(z.string().trim().min(1).max(60)).min(1).max(30) })).max(3),
  variants: z
    .array(z.object({
      id: z.string().optional(),
      sku: z.string().trim().min(2, 'Mỗi biến thể cần SKU').max(60),
      title: z.string().max(120),
      option_values: z.array(z.string()),
      price: z.number().int().min(0).nullable(),
      stock: z.number().int().min(0),
      active: z.boolean()
    }))
    .max(100),
  collection_ids: z.array(z.uuid()).max(50),
  min_stock: z.number().int().min(0),
  purchase_limit: z.number().int().min(1).nullable(),
  weight_g: z.number().int().min(0).nullable(),
  allow_preorder: z.boolean(),
  preorder_deposit_pct: z.number().int().min(1).max(100).nullable(),
  preorder_release_date: z.string().nullable(),
  preorder_slots: z.number().int().min(0).nullable(),
  preorder_closes_at: z.string().nullable(),
  seo_title: z.string().max(120),
  seo_description: z.string().max(300)
})
export type ProductInput = z.infer<typeof productSchema>

import 'server-only'
import type { Database } from '@/lib/database.types'
import { createClient as createSupabaseClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js'
import { SUPABASE_URL } from '@/lib/env'

/** Client service role: bỏ qua RLS. CHỈ dùng ở server cho webhook, cron, tải ảnh chuyển khoản, mời nhân viên. */
export function serviceClient() {
  const key = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
  if (!key) throw new Error('Thiếu SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')
  return createSupabaseClient<Database>(SUPABASE_URL, key, { auth: { persistSession: false, autoRefreshToken: false } })
}

================
File: src/lib/supabase/proxy.ts

import type { Database } from '@/lib/database.types'
import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from 'next/server'
import { createServerClient } from '@supabase/ssr'

/** Làm mới phiên đăng nhập và chặn sớm khu vực quản trị khi chưa đăng nhập (kiểm tra quyền thật ở layout). */
export async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {
  const url = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
  const key = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
  if (!url || !key) return NextResponse.next({ request })

  let response = NextResponse.next({ request })
  const supabase = createServerClient<Database>(url, key, {
    cookies: {
      getAll: () => request.cookies.getAll(),
      setAll: (list, headers) => {
        list.forEach(({ name, value }) => request.cookies.set(name, value))
        response = NextResponse.next({ request })
        list.forEach(({ name, value, options }) => response.cookies.set(name, value, options))
        Object.entries(headers ?? {}).forEach(([k, v]) => response.headers.set(k, v))
      }
    }
  })

  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims()
  const path = request.nextUrl.pathname
  const needsStaff = (path.startsWith('/admin') && !path.startsWith('/admin/dang-nhap')) || path.startsWith('/pos')
  if (needsStaff && !data?.claims) {
    const to = request.nextUrl.clone()
    to.pathname = '/admin/dang-nhap'
    to.search = `?next=${encodeURIComponent(path)}`
    return NextResponse.redirect(to)
  }
  if (path.startsWith('/tai-khoan') && !data?.claims) {
    const to = request.nextUrl.clone()
    to.pathname = '/dang-nhap'
    to.search = ''
    return NextResponse.redirect(to)
  }
  return response
}

File: src/lib/supabase/server.ts

import 'server-only'
import type { Database } from '@/lib/database.types'
import { cookies } from 'next/headers'
import { createServerClient } from '@supabase/ssr'
import { SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, SUPABASE_URL } from '@/lib/env'

/** Client theo phiên đăng nhập của người dùng (đọc cookie). Dùng trong Server Component, Server Action, Route Handler. */
export async function createClient() {
  const cookieStore = await cookies()
  return createServerClient<Database>(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, {
    cookies: {
      getAll: () => cookieStore.getAll(),
      setAll: (list) => {
        try {
          list.forEach(({ name, value, options }) => cookieStore.set(name, value, options))
        } catch {
          // Gọi từ Server Component: bỏ qua, proxy.ts đã làm mới phiên.
        }
      }
    }
  })
}

import { clsx, type ClassValue } from 'clsx'
import { twMerge } from 'tailwind-merge'

export function cn(...inputs: ClassValue[]) {
  return twMerge(clsx(inputs))
}

/** Bỏ dấu tiếng Việt, khớp với hàm f_unaccent(lower()) trong Postgres. */
export function unaccent(s: string) {
  return s
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[̀-ͯ]/g, '')
    .replace(/đ/g, 'd')
    .replace(/Đ/g, 'D')
}

export function slugify(s: string) {
  return unaccent(s)
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')
    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '')
    .slice(0, 100)
}

const vnd = new Intl.NumberFormat('vi-VN')
export function formatVND(n: number | null | undefined) {
  if (n === null || n === undefined) return 'Liên hệ'
  return `${vnd.format(n)}₫`
}

const dt = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('vi-VN', { timeZone: 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh', day: '2-digit', month: '2-digit', year: 'numeric', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })
const d = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('vi-VN', { timeZone: 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh', day: '2-digit', month: '2-digit', year: 'numeric' })
export function formatDateTime(s: string | null | undefined) {
  return s ? dt.format(new Date(s)) : ''
}
export function formatDate(s: string | null | undefined) {
  return s ? d.format(new Date(s)) : ''
}

export function priceRange(p: { price: number; min_price: number | null; max_price: number | null }) {
  const min = p.min_price ?? p.price
  const max = p.max_price ?? p.price
  return min === max ? formatVND(min) : `từ ${formatVND(min)}`
}

/** Nội dung chuyển khoản: mã đơn + tên không dấu (ngân hàng thường bỏ dấu). */
export function transferContent(template: string, code: string, name: string) {
  return (template || '{code}')
    .replace('{code}', code)
    .replace('{name}', unaccent(name).toUpperCase())
    .replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9 -]/g, '')
    .trim()
    .slice(0, 50)
}

export function isPlaceholder(v: string | null | undefined) {
  return !v || /^\[.*\]$/.test(v.trim())
}

import { isPlaceholder } from '@/lib/utils'
import type { ShopSettings } from '@/lib/types'

/** Ảnh VietQR theo chuẩn Napas, tạo bằng dịch vụ img.vietqr.io (miễn phí, không cần khóa). */
export function vietQrUrl(bank: ShopSettings['bank'], amount: number, content: string) {
  if (isPlaceholder(bank.account_no) || isPlaceholder(bank.bank_bin)) return null
  const params = new URLSearchParams({ amount: String(amount), addInfo: content, accountName: bank.account_name })
  return `https://img.vietqr.io/image/${encodeURIComponent(bank.bank_bin)}-${encodeURIComponent(bank.account_no)}-compact2.png?${params}`
}

returns text
language sql
immutable parallel safe strict
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select extensions.unaccent('extensions.unaccent'::regdictionary, $1)
$$;

-- Các hàm kiểm tra quyền dùng trong RLS (security definer để tránh đệ quy RLS trên bảng staff).
create or replace function public.current_staff_role()
returns public.staff_role
language sql
stable security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select s.role from public.staff s
  where s.user_id = (select auth.uid()) and s.active
  limit 1
$$;

create or replace function public.is_staff()
returns boolean
language sql
stable security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select exists (select 1 from public.staff s where s.user_id = (select auth.uid()) and s.active)
$$;

returns boolean
language sql
stable security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$

    where s.user_id = (select auth.uid()) and s.active and s.role in ('owner', 'manager')
  )

create or replace function public.is_owner()
returns boolean
language sql
stable security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select exists (

    where s.user_id = (select auth.uid()) and s.active and s.role = 'owner'
  )

-- Tạo hồ sơ khi có tài khoản mới (đăng nhập Google lần đầu).
create or replace function public.handle_new_user()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
begin
  insert into public.profiles (id, full_name, email, avatar_url)
  values (
    new.id,
    coalesce(new.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'full_name', new.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'name'),
    new.email,
    new.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'avatar_url'
  )
  on conflict (id) do nothing;
  return new;
end;
$$;

create trigger on_auth_user_created
  after insert on auth.users
  for each row execute function public.handle_new_user();

-- Gắn tài khoản đang đăng nhập với lời mời nhân viên theo email. Trả về vai trò hoặc null.
create or replace function public.claim_staff()
returns public.staff_role
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_email text := lower(coalesce((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'email', ''));
  v_provider text := coalesce((select auth.jwt()) -> 'app_metadata' ->> 'provider', 'email');
  v_staff public.staff;
begin
  if (select auth.uid()) is null or v_email = '' then
    return null;
  end if;

  select * into v_staff from public.staff where email = v_email and active;
  if not found then
    return null;
  end if;
  if v_provider = 'google' and not v_staff.allow_google then
    return null;
  end if;
  if v_staff.user_id is null then
    update public.staff set user_id = (select auth.uid()) where id = v_staff.id;
  elsif v_staff.user_id <> (select auth.uid()) then
    return null;
  end if;
  return v_staff.role;
end;
$$;

-- Tự tính cấp (tối đa 3 cấp) và chặn vòng lặp cha con.
create or replace function public.tg_categories_depth()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_parent_depth smallint;
begin
  if new.parent_id is null then
    new.depth := 0;
    return new;
  end if;
  if new.parent_id = new.id then
    raise exception 'CATEGORY_CYCLE' using errcode = 'P0001';
  end if;
  select depth into v_parent_depth from public.categories where id = new.parent_id;
  new.depth := coalesce(v_parent_depth, 0) + 1;
  if new.depth > 2 then
    raise exception 'CATEGORY_TOO_DEEP' using errcode = 'P0001';
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$$;
create trigger categories_depth before insert or update of parent_id on public.categories
  for each row execute function public.tg_categories_depth();

create table public.brands (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  name text not null,
  slug text not null unique,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create table public.collections (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  name text not null,
  slug text not null unique,
  description text not null default '',
  visible boolean not null default true,
  sort int not null default 0,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Sản phẩm và biến thể. Mỗi sản phẩm luôn có ít nhất 1 biến thể (biến thể mặc định),
-- giỏ hàng, đơn hàng và tồn kho đều tính theo biến thể.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------
create table public.products (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  type_id uuid not null references public.product_types (id) on delete restrict,
  category_id uuid references public.categories (id) on delete set null,
  brand_id uuid references public.brands (id) on delete set null,
  name text not null check (length(name) between 2 and 200),
  slug text not null unique check (slug ~ '^[a-z0-9-]{2,120}$'),
  sku text not null unique,
  description text not null default '',
  unit text not null default 'Cái',
  price bigint not null check (price >= 0),
  compare_at_price bigint check (compare_at_price is null or compare_at_price >= 0),
  cost bigint check (cost is null or cost >= 0),
  status public.product_status not null default 'draft',
  online boolean not null default true,
  pos boolean not null default true,
  is_featured boolean not null default false,
  attrs jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb check (jsonb_typeof(attrs) = 'object'),
  tags text[] not null default '{}',
  thumbnail text,
  weight_g int,
  min_stock int not null default 0,
  purchase_limit int check (purchase_limit is null or purchase_limit > 0),
  -- pre-order
  allow_preorder boolean not null default false,
  preorder_deposit_pct smallint check (preorder_deposit_pct is null or preorder_deposit_pct between 1 and 100),
  preorder_release_date date,
  preorder_slots int check (preorder_slots is null or preorder_slots >= 0),
  preorder_closes_at timestamptz,
  -- tổng hợp từ biến thể (trigger cập nhật), giúp trang danh sách không phải join
  stock_total int not null default 0,
  min_price bigint,
  max_price bigint,
  variant_count int not null default 0,
  seo_title text,
  seo_description text,
  search_text text generated always as (public.f_unaccent(lower(name || ' ' || sku))) stored,
  published_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
create trigger products_updated_at before update on public.products
  for each row execute function public.tg_set_updated_at();

create index products_attrs_gin on public.products using gin (attrs jsonb_path_ops);

create index products_search_trgm on public.products using gin (search_text extensions.gin_trgm_ops);

  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),

-- Cập nhật số liệu tổng hợp của sản phẩm khi biến thể thay đổi.
create or replace function public.refresh_product_rollup(p_product_id uuid)
returns void
language sql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
  update public.products p set
    stock_total = coalesce((select sum(v.stock) from public.variants v where v.product_id = p.id and v.active), 0),
    min_price = (select min(coalesce(v.price, p.price)) from public.variants v where v.product_id = p.id and v.active),
    max_price = (select max(coalesce(v.price, p.price)) from public.variants v where v.product_id = p.id and v.active),
    variant_count = (select count(*) from public.variants v where v.product_id = p.id)
  where p.id = p_product_id
$$;

create or replace function public.tg_variants_rollup()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
begin
  if tg_op = 'DELETE' then
    perform public.refresh_product_rollup(old.product_id);
  else
    perform public.refresh_product_rollup(new.product_id);
    if tg_op = 'UPDATE' and old.product_id <> new.product_id then
      perform public.refresh_product_rollup(old.product_id);
    end if;
  end if;
  return null;
end;
$$;
create trigger variants_rollup after insert or update or delete on public.variants
  for each row execute function public.tg_variants_rollup();

create or replace function public.tg_products_price_rollup()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
set search_path = ''
as $$
begin
  new.min_price := coalesce((select min(coalesce(v.price, new.price)) from public.variants v where v.product_id = new.id and v.active), new.price);
  new.max_price := coalesce((select max(coalesce(v.price, new.price)) from public.variants v where v.product_id = new.id and v.active), new.price);
  if new.status = 'active' and new.published_at is null then
    new.published_at := now();
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$$;
create trigger products_price_rollup before insert or update of price, status on public.products
  for each row execute function public.tg_products_price_rollup();
